```js
// node --test tests/wn5-flag.test.js
// National v5 F4α Tasks T3/T10 — the switch is born closed (principle 5) and the old board has ONE seam:
//   - FEATURES.WN_V5 is 'off' until day L: F5 changes this assertion in the same commit as the flag (owner decision);
//   - modules/weekly_natl.js gains exactly one line, the first statement of renderWeeklyNatl(), before _wnLoadAll:
//     v5 owns its load, and with the switch off that line is false and nothing else of the old board runs differently.
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = process.env.TMS_ROOT ? path.resolve(process.env.TMS_ROOT) : path.join(__dirname, '..');
const read = (f) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), 'utf8');
function config() {
  const ctx = { console: { log() {}, warn() {}, error() {} }, document: { querySelector: () => null, getElementById: () => null },
    localStorage: { getItem: () => null, setItem() {}, removeItem() {} } };
  ctx.window = ctx;
  vm.createContext(ctx);
  vm.runInContext(read('config.js'), ctx, { filename: 'config.js' });
  return (e) => vm.runInContext(e, ctx);
}
// The text of `[async] function name(…){…}` (brace counter), or a loud «not found».
function grab(src, name, file) {
  const m = new RegExp('(?:^|\\n)[ \\t]*(?:async[ \\t]+)?function[ \\t]+' + name.replace(/\$/g, '\\$') + '[ \\t]*\\(').exec(src);
  assert.ok(m, `${name} not found in ${file}`);
  const i = m.index + (m[0].startsWith('\n') ? 1 : 0);
  let depth = 0;
  for (let k = src.indexOf('{', i); k < src.length; k++) {
    if (src[k] === '{') depth++;
    else if (src[k] === '}' && --depth === 0) return src.slice(i, k + 1);
  }
  throw new Error('unbalanced ' + name);
}
const SEAM = "if (typeof WN5 !== 'undefined' && WN5.active()) { ++_wnLoadId; return WN5.render(); }";

test("F4α-T3: FEATURES.WN_V5 is 'off' until day L (F5 changes this line with the flag)", () => {
  const v = config();
  assert.strictEqual(v('FEATURES.WN_V5'), 'off', 'FEATURES.WN_V5 undefined or open: ' + v('String(FEATURES.WN_V5)'));
  assert.strictEqual(v('JSON.stringify(WN_V5_USERS)'), '[]', 'WN_V5_USERS must exist and name nobody');
});

test('F4α-T3: weekly_natl.js has exactly one v5 line, first statement of renderWeeklyNatl, before _wnLoadAll', () => {
  const src = read('modules/weekly_natl.js');
  const fn = grab(src, 'renderWeeklyNatl', 'modules/weekly_natl.js');
  const body = fn.slice(fn.indexOf('{') + 1).split('\n').map((s) => s.trim()).filter((s) => s && !s.startsWith('//'));
  assert.strictEqual(body[0], SEAM, 'WN5 seam not found as the first statement of renderWeeklyNatl');
  assert.ok(fn.indexOf(SEAM) < fn.indexOf('_wnLoadAll()'), 'the seam must come before _wnLoadAll');
  assert.strictEqual(src.split('\n').filter((l) => /\bWN5\b/.test(l)).length, 1, 'only ONE line of weekly_natl.js may name WN5');
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Γράψε το rig του board, `tests/critics/wn5-board-rig.js`**

```js
// Rig — National v5 board (F4α, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-26-f4a-national-v5-screens.md, Tasks T3–T8).
//
// Why: v5 owns its data (GET /plan/board) and its writes (/plan/*). A screenshot or a green toast proves nothing
// about either (CLAUDE.md «η απόδειξη είναι ο πίνακας»). This rig drives the REAL app against a fake /plan/* and
// judges every scenario by what reached it — method, path, query, raw body, count: S.plan is «the table» of this rig —
// and by what the page shows. Synthetic data only (the repo is public).
//
// The fake answers with THE ONE error shape of /plan/* (worker/src/index.js planError) and SENTINEL messages
// («rig sentinel <code>»): the screen must show exactly the body's message, which also proves it holds no Greek
// copy of a Worker text. Default for every non-dry write: 409 WRITES_CLOSED/writes_closed, as deployed until day L.
//
// Usage (Playwright; this worktree has node_modules — else cwd = the main repo, memory note «Κριτές από worktree»):
//   node tests/critics/wn5-board-rig.js [scenario …] [--shots <dir>]
//   WN5_TREE=<tree> node tests/critics/wn5-board-rig.js …      plain-main proof: WN5_TREE=<git archive origin/main>
// The flag lives in config.js; it is rewritten in memory (WN_V5 'on' unless a scenario says otherwise), never on
// disk. A tree without the key (plain main) is a ✗ line of the preflight, never a crash: every scenario still runs
// and says what is missing. Nothing leaves the machine. Clock frozen at Tue 13/10/2026 09:30 Athens (W42, the «now»
// of Figma 2035:7735), role dispatcher, 1920×1080.
// Exit: 0 all green · 1 a check failed · 2 usage (unknown scenario).
'use strict';
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const http = require('http');

const WT = path.join(__dirname, '../..');
const TREE = path.resolve(process.env.WN5_TREE || WT);
const HOST = 'petras-tms-backend-staging.petrasgroup.workers.dev';
const NOW = '2026-10-13T09:30:00+03:00';
const WEEK = '2026-10-10';                  // the Saturday of W42
const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const shotsAt = argv.indexOf('--shots');
const OUT = shotsAt >= 0 ? argv[shotsAt + 1] : null;
const want = argv.filter((a, i) => !a.startsWith('--') && !(shotsAt >= 0 && i === shotsAt + 1));
const clone = (o) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
const EMPTY = (week) => ({ week, cycles: [], waiting: [], hub: [], notices: [] });

let fails = 0;
function ok(scn, name, cond, detail) {
  if (!cond) fails++;
  console.log(`${cond ? '✓' : '✗'} ${scn} ${name}${cond || detail === undefined ? '' : '  → ' + String(typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail)).slice(0, 500)}`);
  return !!cond;
}

const MIME = { '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
  '.json': 'application/json', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.woff2': 'font/woff2',
  '.webmanifest': 'application/manifest+json' };
function serve() {
  const srv = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    const u = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
    const file = path.join(TREE, decodeURIComponent(u.pathname === '/' ? '/app.html' : u.pathname));
    if (!file.startsWith(TREE) || !fs.existsSync(file) || fs.statSync(file).isDirectory()) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end(); }
    res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': MIME[path.extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream', 'cache-control': 'no-store' });
    fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res);
  });
  return new Promise((r) => srv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => r(srv)));
}

// Runs in the page before any script: a demo_* roster user (config.js USERS), or the tamper guard bounces.
function initScript(role) {
  localStorage.setItem('tms_user', JSON.stringify({ name: 'Rig', role, username: 'demo_' + role, loginAt: Date.now(), expiresAt: Date.now() + 8 * 3600 * 1000 }));
  localStorage.setItem('tms_jwt', 'rig.wn5.no-real-token');
  localStorage.setItem('tms_page', 'weekly_natl');
  localStorage.setItem('tms_sidebar_v2_migrated', '1');
  localStorage.setItem('tms_sidebar_collapsed', 'true');
}

// The one error shape of /plan/*. Texts are SENTINELS, never Greek copies.
const planErr = (status, type, code) => [status, { error: { type, code, message: `rig sentinel ${code}` } }];
function defaultPlan(e, S) {
  if (e.m === 'GET' && e.path === '/plan/board') return [200, Object.assign(clone(S.board), { week: e.q.week })];
  if (e.m === 'GET' && e.path === '/plan/notices') return [200, { desk: e.q.desk, unread: [], recent: [] }];
  return planErr(409, 'WRITES_CLOSED', 'writes_closed');   // PLAN_WRITES_OPEN = false until day L
}
const routeKey = (m, p) => `${m} ${p.replace(/\/\d+(?=\/|$)/g, '/:id')}`;

// opts: role · flag ('on' | 'pilot' | 'off') · board · plan { 'POST /plan/x/:id/y': (entry, S) => [status, body] } · viewport
async function openBoard(browser, origin, opts = {}) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: origin + '/', viewport: opts.viewport || { width: 1920, height: 1080 },
    serviceWorkers: 'block', timezoneId: 'Europe/Athens', locale: 'el-GR' });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date(NOW));                         // BEFORE the session is stamped
  const S = { plan: [], pageErrors: [], preflight: [], board: clone(opts.board || EMPTY(WEEK)), routes: opts.plan || {}, n: {} };
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => S.pageErrors.push(String(e).slice(0, 300)));
  page.on('dialog', (d) => d.accept());
  await page.addInitScript(initScript, opts.role || 'dispatcher');
  await page.route((u) => !u.href.startsWith(origin) && !u.href.includes(HOST), (route) => route.abort());
  await page.route((u) => u.href.startsWith(origin) && new URL(u.href).pathname === '/config.js', async (route) => {
    const r = await route.fetch(); let body = await r.text();
    const re = /WN_V5:\s*(?:false|true|'(?:off|pilot|on)')/;
    if (re.test(body)) body = body.replace(re, `WN_V5: '${opts.flag || 'on'}'`);
    else S.preflight.push('FEATURES.WN_V5 not found in config.js');
    await route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', body });
  });
  const json = (route, body, status = 200) => route.fulfill({ status, contentType: 'application/json',
    headers: { 'access-control-allow-origin': '*' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  await page.route(`**/${HOST}/**`, async (route) => {
    const req = route.request(); const u = new URL(req.url()); const m = req.method();
    if (m === 'OPTIONS') return route.fulfill({ status: 204, headers: { 'access-control-allow-origin': '*', 'access-control-allow-headers': '*', 'access-control-allow-methods': '*' } });
    if (u.pathname.startsWith('/plan/')) {
      const raw = req.postData();
      let body = null;
      try { body = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; } catch (_) { body = '<<not json>>'; }
      const entry = { m, path: u.pathname, q: Object.fromEntries(u.searchParams), raw, body, headers: req.headers() };
      S.plan.push(entry);
      const fn = S.routes[routeKey(m, u.pathname)] || defaultPlan;
      const [status, out] = fn(entry, S);
      entry.status = status;
      return json(route, out, status);
    }
    return json(route, m === 'GET' ? { records: [] } : { ok: true });   // the facade: masters, the old board's reads
  });
  await page.goto('app.html');
  // v5 settled (any state but loading) or the old board painted. Never a throw: plain main must reach the checks.
  await page.waitForFunction(() => {
    const r = document.querySelector('#content .wn5');
    return (r && r.dataset.state !== 'loading') || !!document.querySelector('#content .wn4');
  }, null, { timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
  await instrument(page);
  return { page, S };
}
// After load: wrap what the screen may call, to read back what it did. copyPlates is not run (no clipboard here).
async function instrument(page) {
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const E = window.__ev = [];
    const snap = (x) => { try { return x instanceof Error ? { message: x.message, kind: x.kind, code: x.code } : (x && typeof x === 'object' ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)) : String(x).slice(0, 300)); } catch (_) { return String(x); } };
    const wrap = (name, k, call = true) => { const fn = window[name]; if (typeof fn !== 'function') return;
      window[name] = function () { E.push({ k, a: [...arguments].map(snap) }); return call ? fn.apply(this, arguments) : undefined; }; };
    wrap('toast', 'toast'); wrap('showErrorToast', 'errtoast'); wrap('logError', 'logError');
    wrap('copyPlates', 'copy', false); wrap('tmsSessionExpired', 'expired', false);
  }).catch(() => {});
}
// Wait until the page satisfies fn (evaluated in the page), quietly: a timeout is a ✗ of the caller, not a crash.
const until = (page, fn, arg, ms = 8000) => page.waitForFunction(fn, arg, { timeout: ms }).then(() => true, () => false);
// logError rows of this page (core/utils.js keeps them in localStorage.tms_errors, also from before instrument()).
const errRows = (page) => page.evaluate(() => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tms_errors') || '[]'); } catch (_) { return []; } });
async function shot(page, name) { if (!OUT) return; fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true }); await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(OUT, name + '.png'), fullPage: false }); }
const boardReads = (S) => S.plan.filter((x) => x.m === 'GET' && x.path === '/plan/board');

async function preflight(browser, origin) {
  const scn = 'preflight';
  const { page, S } = await openBoard(browser, origin);
  const st = await page.evaluate(() => ({ api: typeof planFetch === 'function', root: !!document.querySelector('#content .wn5') }));
  ok(scn, 'FEATURES.WN_V5 exists in config.js', !S.preflight.length, S.preflight);
  ok(scn, 'core/plan-api.js loaded (planFetch)', st.api, st);
  ok(scn, 'the v5 board painted (#content .wn5)', st.root, st);
  ok(scn, 'board read through GET /plan/board?week=<Saturday>', boardReads(S).some((x) => x.q.week === WEEK), S.plan.map((x) => `${x.m} ${x.path} ${JSON.stringify(x.q)}`));
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await page.context().close();
}

const SCN = {};

// Δ12 πλακ. 1: an empty week is said in words, never with a 0.
SCN['paint-empty'] = async (browser, origin) => {
  const scn = 'paint-empty';
  const { page, S } = await openBoard(browser, origin, { board: EMPTY(WEEK) });
  const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const r = document.querySelector('#content .wn5');
    if (!r) return null;
    const leaves = [...r.querySelectorAll('*')].filter((e) => !e.children.length).map((e) => e.textContent.trim());
    return { state: r.dataset.state, week: r.dataset.week,
      days: [...r.querySelectorAll('.wn5-day')].map((d) => ({ date: d.dataset.date, head: d.querySelector('.wn5-dayh').textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), today: d.classList.contains('today') })),
      q: (r.querySelector('.wn5-q .wi4-q-hd') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), zeros: leaves.filter((t) => t === '0').length };
  });
  ok(scn, 'state empty, data-week = the Saturday', !!st && st.state === 'empty' && st.week === WEEK, st && { state: st.state, week: st.week });
  const heads = ['ΣΑΒΒΑΤΟ 10/10', 'ΚΥΡΙΑΚΗ 11/10', 'ΔΕΥΤΕΡΑ 12/10', 'ΤΡΙΤΗ 13/10', 'ΤΕΤΑΡΤΗ 14/10', 'ΠΕΜΠΤΗ 15/10', 'ΠΑΡΑΣΚΕΥΗ 16/10'];
  ok(scn, 'seven days Sat–Fri, each «· καμία φόρτωση»', !!st && st.days.length === 7 && st.days.every((d, i) => d.head.startsWith(heads[i]) && d.head.endsWith('· καμία φόρτωση')), st && st.days);
  ok(scn, 'today (Τρί 13/10) marked «· σήμερα»', !!st && !!st.days[3] && st.days[3].today && /· σήμερα/.test(st.days[3].head), st && st.days[3]);
  ok(scn, '«ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ · κανένα»', !!st && /^ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ · κανένα/.test(st.q), st && st.q);
  ok(scn, 'no counter shows «0» (Δ12 πλακ. 1: empty is said in words)', !!st && st.zeros === 0, st && st.zeros);
  ok(scn, 'one board read, nothing else sent to /plan/*', S.plan.length === 1 && S.plan[0].m === 'GET', S.plan.map((x) => x.m + ' ' + x.path));
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await shot(page, 'paint-empty');
  await page.context().close();
};

// Δ12 πλακ. 3: a failed read is NOT an empty week — the Worker's message, «—», «Ανανέωση ↻», no automatic retry.
SCN['read-error'] = async (browser, origin) => {
  const scn = 'read-error';
  const plan = { 'GET /plan/board': (e, S) => ((S.n.board = (S.n.board || 0) + 1) === 1 ? planErr(500, 'SERVER', 'plan_failed') : [200, EMPTY(e.q.week)]) };
  const { page, S } = await openBoard(browser, origin, { plan });
  await page.waitForTimeout(3500);                                       // longer than _atRetry's 1 s + 2 s: a retry would show
  const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const r = document.querySelector('#content .wn5');
    if (!r) return null;
    const strip = r.querySelector('.wn5-strip[data-kind="failed"]');
    return { state: r.dataset.state, strip: strip ? strip.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : null,
      reload: !!(strip && strip.querySelector('[data-act="reload"]')), q: (r.querySelector('.wn5-q .wi4-q-hd') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      text: r.textContent };
  });
  ok(scn, 'state err', !!st && st.state === 'err', st && st.state);
  ok(scn, 'the strip shows the Worker message as it came (sentinel)', !!st && !!st.strip && st.strip.includes('rig sentinel plan_failed'), st && st.strip);
  ok(scn, 'counters say «—», never 0 (ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ · —)', !!st && /^ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ · —/.test(st.q), st && st.q);
  ok(scn, 'never «καμία φόρτωση» or «κενή εβδομάδα» on a failed read', !!st && !/καμία φόρτωση|κενή εβδομάδα/.test(st.text), st && st.text.slice(0, 200));
  ok(scn, 'exactly one GET, no automatic retry', boardReads(S).length === 1, boardReads(S).length);
  const rows = (await errRows(page)).filter((e) => String(e.ctx || '').startsWith('planFetch GET /plan/board'));
  ok(scn, 'the 500 is logged once (app_errors)', rows.length === 1, rows);
  const clicked = await page.evaluate(() => { const b = document.querySelector('#content .wn5 .wn5-strip [data-act="reload"]'); if (b) b.click(); return !!b; });
  const back = clicked && await until(page, () => { const r = document.querySelector('#content .wn5'); return r && r.dataset.state === 'empty'; });
  ok(scn, '«Ανανέωση ↻» re-reads by hand → the empty week, the strip gone', back && !(await page.$('#content .wn5 .wn5-strip')), { clicked, back });
  ok(scn, 'two board reads in total (one per press)', boardReads(S).length === 2, boardReads(S).length);
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await shot(page, 'read-error');
  await page.context().close();
};

// A paint that throws is STICKY: the old board, one banner, no v5 until the next load (v4 rule §a.4).
SCN.broken = async (browser, origin) => {
  const scn = 'broken';
  const { page, S } = await openBoard(browser, origin, { board: { week: WEEK, cycles: {}, waiting: [], hub: [], notices: [] } });

  ok(scn, 'WN5._broken is set', st.broken, st);

  const rows = (await errRows(page)).filter((e) => String(e.ctx || '').startsWith('weekly natl v5: paint failed'));

  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await page.context().close();
};

// The week stays ONE (WNATL.week): ←/→ of core/ui.js and the tabs move it; /plan/board always gets a Saturday.
SCN.week = async (browser, origin) => {
  const scn = 'week';
  const { page, S } = await openBoard(browser, origin);
  ok(scn, 'the first read is W42 (2026-10-10)', boardReads(S).length >= 1 && boardReads(S)[0].q.week === WEEK, boardReads(S).map((x) => x.q.week));
  await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur && document.activeElement.blur());
  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
  const next = await until(page, () => { const r = document.querySelector('#content .wn5'); return r && r.dataset.week === '2026-10-17' && r.dataset.state !== 'loading'; });
  ok(scn, '→ moves to W43: data-week 2026-10-17', next, await page.evaluate(() => (document.querySelector('#content .wn5') || {}).dataset));

  const tab = await page.evaluate(() => { const b = document.querySelector('#content .wn5 .wi4-tab[data-w="41"]'); if (b) b.click(); return !!b; });
  const w41 = tab && await until(page, () => { const r = document.querySelector('#content .wn5'); return r && r.dataset.week === '2026-10-03' && r.dataset.state !== 'loading'; });
  ok(scn, 'tab W41 → data-week 2026-10-03', w41, { tab });
  const weeks = boardReads(S).map((x) => x.q.week);
  ok(scn, 'every week sent is a Saturday (TmsWeek)', weeks.length === 3 && weeks.every((w) => new Date(w + 'T00:00:00Z').getUTCDay() === 6), weeks);
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await page.context().close();
};

// ── scenarios end (each Task adds its own above this line) ──

// ── main ──
(async () => {
  const unknownScn = want.filter((w) => !(w in SCN));
  if (unknownScn.length) { console.error('unknown scenario(s): ' + unknownScn.join(', ') + ' · known: ' + Object.keys(SCN).join(' ')); process.exit(2); }
  const { chromium } = require(require.resolve('playwright', { paths: [process.cwd(), WT] }));
  const srv = await serve();
  const origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${srv.address().port}`;
  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  const WATCHDOG_MS = 180000;
  try {
    await preflight(browser, origin);                                 // ✗ lines on plain main, never an early exit
    for (const [name, fn] of Object.entries(SCN)) {
      if (want.length && !want.includes(name)) continue;
      let t = null;
      try { await Promise.race([fn(browser, origin), new Promise((_, rej) => { t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error(`watchdog: still running after ${WATCHDOG_MS / 1000} s`)), WATCHDOG_MS); })]); }
      catch (e) { ok(name, 'scenario ran to the end', false, String(e && e.stack || e).slice(0, 600)); for (const c of browser.contexts()) await c.close().catch(() => {}); }
      finally { clearTimeout(t); }
    }
  } finally {
    await browser.close(); srv.close();
    console.log(fails ? `\nNO-GO: ${fails} check(s) failed` : `\nGO: the v5 board holds (${want.length ? want.join(' ') : Object.keys(SCN).join(' ')})`);
    process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);
  }
})().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });
```

```js
      const tbl = db[mm[1]] || [];

      if (m === 'GET') return json(route, { records: clone(tbl) });

function diff(a, b, at = '') {
  if (typeof a !== typeof b || Array.isArray(a) !== Array.isArray(b)) return [`${at}: ${JSON.stringify(a).slice(0, 160)} ≠ ${JSON.stringify(b).slice(0, 160)}`];
  if (a && typeof a === 'object') return [...new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)])].flatMap((k) => diff(a[k], b[k], at ? `${at}.${k}` : k));
  if (a === b) return [];
  const s1 = String(a), s2 = String(b); let i = 0; while (i < s1.length && s1[i] === s2[i]) i++;
  return [`${at}: first difference at char ${i}: «${s1.slice(Math.max(0, i - 60), i + 80)}» ≠ «${s2.slice(Math.max(0, i - 60), i + 80)}»`];
}
```

```css
/* ── Weekly National v5 (wn5-*) — FEATURES.WN_V5 ── */
/* Plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-26-f4a-national-v5-screens.md. Figma KO7l2AfucR3HJEDIg1Yptr 2011:7745 with
   the owner changes of 25/10 (H1 2120:7738), states Δ12 2069:8579.
   WHY here and like this: the v5 root is class="wi4 wn5" (Ε-15), so it inherits the Weekly International look from
   the wi4 block above — one source for bar, tabs, days, boxes, chips. Everything only national lives below, every
   selector starting with .wn5, .wn5-*, :root (tokens --wn5-*) or body.wn5-on. With the flag off nothing here can
   match an element. No text-overflow anywhere: names are never cut (DESIGN.md #6). */
:root {
  --wn5-note-bg:   #fff7eb;   /* notices strip (Figma 2011:7745 «ΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΕΙΣ») */
  --wn5-note-line: #fad199;
  --wn5-note-ink:  #b5540a;   /* 4.9:1 on --wn5-note-bg */
  --wn5-err-line:  #fecaca;   /* refusal / error strip border (Δ12) */
  --wn5-info-bg:   #eff6ff;   /* «preview» strip: writes closed until day L (H7 πλακ. 4) */
  --wn5-info-line: #bfdbfe;
}
/* The same page frame as v4 (body.wi4-on .content), while the v5 board is on screen. */
body.wn5-on .content { padding-left:28px; padding-right:28px; padding-top:8px; background:var(--surface-page); }
.wn5 .wn5-lc { text-transform:none; letter-spacing:0; }
.wn5-bar { margin-bottom:8px; }
.wn5 .wn5-upd { margin-left:10px; border:0; background:none; padding:0; font:inherit; font-size:12px; color:var(--wi4-grey-2); cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; }
.wn5 .wn5-upd:hover { color:var(--wi4-ink); }
/* Result strips (Δ12): refusal/error red, warning amber, «preview» blue. The text is the Worker's message. */
.wn5-strip { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:6px 10px; margin:0 0 8px; padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid var(--wn5-err-line);
  border-radius:6px; background:var(--wi4-red-bg); color:var(--wi4-red-ink); font-size:12px; line-height:1.4; }
.wn5-strip > b { font-weight:600; color:var(--wi4-red); }
.wn5-strip[data-kind="warning"] { border-color:var(--wn5-note-line); background:var(--wn5-note-bg); color:var(--wi4-grey-1); }
.wn5-strip[data-kind="warning"] > b { color:var(--wn5-note-ink); }
.wn5-strip:is([data-kind="closed"], [data-kind="preview"]) { border-color:var(--wn5-info-line); background:var(--wn5-info-bg); color:var(--wi4-grey-1); }
.wn5-strip:is([data-kind="closed"], [data-kind="preview"]) > b { color:var(--wi4-blue-ink); }
.wn5-strip-sub { color:var(--wi4-grey-2); }
.wn5-strip > .wi4-btn { margin-left:auto; }
.wn5 .wn5-q .wi4-q-hd > span:first-child { white-space:nowrap; }
.wn5-dayx { font-weight:400; letter-spacing:0; color:var(--wi4-grey-2); }
/* ── wn5 end ── */
```

**Acceptance:** `node --test tests/wn5-logic.test.js` πράσινο· `node tests/critics/wn5-board-rig.js --check-fixture` → `FIXTURE GO`.

Ο T4 γράφει τους καθαρούς κανόνες του board (`core/wn5-logic.js`, global `WN5L`) και το συνθετικό fixture της εβδομάδας W42 στο σχήμα του `plan_board` της 072. Ό,τι είναι κανόνας της βάσης (εκτελεσμένο, σβηστό, καθυστέρηση, όχημα) **αντιγράφεται** από το JSON· εδώ υπολογίζονται μόνο τα της εμφάνισης (ημέρα της σειράς, αρίθμηση, αθροίσματα παλετών, ώρα Αθήνας). Ένα drift test κρατά τα κλειδιά του fixture ίσα με τα κλειδιά που χτίζει η `plan_board` (072:2365) και το 071 (`v_hub_bucket`, `plan_notices`), προς τις δύο κατευθύνσεις.

**Νέα interfaces (σημειωμένα, ελάχιστα):** `WN5L.hubFromBoard(board, errors?)`, `WN5L.athensDay(iso)`, `WN5L.athensTime(iso)`, `WN5L.CAP`· στο `Model` τα `today`, `hubId`· στη `Row` τα `pieceIds`, `group`, `vs`, `clients`, `refs`, `sortAt` (και το εσωτερικό `_parts` που διαβάζει το `searchParts`)· στη `Side` το `toDay` («→ Τρί 13/10»)· στο `Point` τα `clients`, `day`· στο `end` τα `stopId`, `dim`· στο `local[]` τα `dim`, `stopName`, `stopN`· στο `HubItem` το `reference`. Το `model(board, opts)` δέχεται και `opts.hubId` (η 072 δεν σημαδεύει τη στάση της Βέροιας· βλ. σχόλιο του `hubFromBoard`). Το `core/wn5-logic.js` φορτώνεται **μετά το `core/wi4-presence.js`** (όχι αμέσως μετά το `core/wi4-logic.js`: το `tests/wi4-contract.test.js` κρατά το `wi4-presence.js` αμέσως μετά το `wi4-logic.js`).

**Πέντε ερωτήσεις:** καθαρό module, χωρίς endpoint· διαβάζει μόνο το JSON του `GET /plan/board` (072 `plan_board`)· δεν γράφει τίποτα· αποτυχία: σχήμα που δεν σχεδιάζεται (`cycles`/`waiting`/`hub`/`notices` όχι λίστα, `segments` όχι μη-κενή λίστα, `stops` όχι λίστα) → `WN5L.ShapeError` (η ζωγραφική του T5 πέφτει τότε στο παλιό board με banner)· στάση με άγνωστη πλευρά → γραμμή στο `model.errors` (ορατή στον T5), ποτέ σιωπηλή απόρριψη· εβδομάδα με κύκλους χωρίς αναγνωρισμένη Βέροια → η γραμμή `WN5L.HUB_UNKNOWN` στο ίδιο `model.errors` (Ε-44)· δικαίωμα: —.

- [ ] **Step 1: Γράψε το test που αποτυγχάνει, `tests/wn5-logic.test.js`**

```js
// node --test tests/wn5-logic.test.js
// National v5 F4α Task T4 — core/wn5-logic.js (WN5L): the board model from the JSON of GET /plan/board.
//   - every rule of the base (dim / side_dim / cycle_dim / has_late / has_vehicle / overdue) is COPIED, never
//     computed (spec §3 Board, S-89): a past stop with dim:false stays bold;
//   - days by the Veroia loading day of ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ, the Veroia window on the side (never on the vehicle, owner 25/10);
//   - an absent `segments` key = one tile from the cycle, a malformed one is loud (OPEN-9);
//   - the fixture is the shape of 072 plan_board, key for key, and carries no money key (drift test, principle 3).
// The module is require()d (UMD) and also run in a vm to prove it adds only WN5L.
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = process.env.TMS_ROOT ? path.resolve(process.env.TMS_ROOT) : path.join(__dirname, '..');
const L = require(path.join(ROOT, 'core/wn5-logic.js'));
const FIX_TEXT = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures/wn5-week.json'), 'utf8');
const fix = () => JSON.parse(FIX_TEXT);
// The Ε-26 keys the live 072 hub[] does NOT carry (072:2450): a variant adds them, as the Worker chain would.
const E26 = { 4101: [2, ['2026-10-12', '14:00', '17:00'], ['2026-10-13', '06:00', '08:00']], 4102: [3, ['2026-10-12', '14:00', '17:00'], ['2026-10-13', '07:00', '09:00']],
  4103: [4, ['2026-10-12', '18:00', '20:00'], ['2026-10-13', '09:00', '11:00']], 4104: [2, ['2026-10-16', '10:00', '12:00'], ['2026-10-17', '06:00', '08:00']] };
function withE26(b = fix()) {
  const t = (d, hm) => `${d}T${hm}:00+03:00`;
  for (const h of b.hub) {
    const e = E26[h.piece_id];
    if (e) Object.assign(h, { nat_to_location_id: e[0], load_from: t(e[1][0], e[1][1]), load_to: t(e[1][0], e[1][2]), deliver_from: t(e[2][0], e[2][1]), deliver_to: t(e[2][0], e[2][2]) });
  }
  return b;
}
const TODAY = '2026-10-13';
const M = (b = fix()) => L.model(b, { today: TODAY });
const rowOf = (m, key) => m.days.flatMap((d) => d.rows).find((r) => r.key === key);
const dayOf = (m, key) => (m.days.find((d) => d.rows.some((r) => r.key === key)) || {}).date;

test("F4α-T4: rows sorted by the Veroia loading day of KATHODOS; ANODOS-only cycle on its ANODOS day with 'Χωρίς κάθοδο'", () => {
  const m = M();
  assert.deepStrictEqual(m.days.map((d) => d.head), ['ΣΑΒΒΑΤΟ 10/10', 'ΚΥΡΙΑΚΗ 11/10', 'ΔΕΥΤΕΡΑ 12/10', 'ΤΡΙΤΗ 13/10', 'ΤΕΤΑΡΤΗ 14/10', 'ΠΕΜΠΤΗ 15/10', 'ΠΑΡΑΣΚΕΥΗ 16/10']);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(m.days.map((d) => d.rows.map((r) => r.key)), [
    ['rt:101'], [], ['rt:102', 'rt:103', 'rt:104', 'wait:4101', 'wait:4103'], [],
    ['rt:105', 'rt:106', 'wait:4105'], ['rt:107'], ['rt:108', 'wait:4104']]);
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:106').kath, null, 'an ANODOS-only cycle has no ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ («Χωρίς κάθοδο»)');
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:105').dayKey, '2026-10-14', 'the Veroia loading day, not the first (Thessaloniki) stop');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(m.days.map((d) => d.empty), [false, true, false, true, false, false, false]);
  // VS-T133 comes without nat_ready_day (orders.cross_dock_date empty, a live 072 state): the day before its
  // nat_due_day (owner rule for an import VS, 23/8), never the week's Saturday
  assert.strictEqual(fix().hub.find((h) => h.piece_id === 4104).nat_ready_day, null);
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'wait:4104').dayKey, '2026-10-16');
});

test('F4α-T4: cycle numbering «κύκλος 1» alone, «1/2» «2/2» for two cycles of one truck', () => {
  const m = M();
  assert.deepStrictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:101').cycleNo, { n: 1, m: 2 });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:107').cycleNo, { n: 2, m: 2 });
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:101').tiles[0].line2, 'Driver Test 01 · κύκλος 1/2');
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:103').tiles[0].line2, 'Driver Test 03 · κύκλος 1');
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:104').cycleNo, null, 'a partner is not numbered');
  assert.deepStrictEqual([...L.cycleNumbers(fix().cycles).keys()].sort(), [101, 102, 103, 105, 106, 107]);
});

test('F4α-T4: Veroia window lives on the side (side.veroia), never on the tile', () => {
  const m = M();
  assert.deepStrictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:102').kath.veroia, { stopId: 1101, from: '16:00', to: '18:00' });
  // live 072: the VS sits in hub[] without load_from/load_to (Ε-26) — «Βέροια» with «—», never an invented time
  assert.deepStrictEqual(rowOf(m, 'wait:4101').kath.veroia, { stopId: null, from: null, to: null }, 'a VS at the hub says «Βέροια» before its window is on the board');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(rowOf(M(withE26()), 'wait:4101').kath.veroia, { stopId: null, from: '14:00', to: '17:00' }, 'and its Veroia time once the Ε-26 keys come');
  for (const r of m.days.flatMap((d) => d.rows)) {
    assert.ok(!/\d{1,2}:\d{2}/.test(JSON.stringify(r.tiles)), `${r.key}: a time inside the ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ tile: ${JSON.stringify(r.tiles)}`);
  }
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:101').end.place, 'Βέροια');
  assert.strictEqual(L.athensTime(rowOf(m, 'rt:101').end.by), '22:00');
});

test("F4α-T4: a VS no truck took (hub[] of the live 072) → row kind 'unassigned', rail red, never dims; «—» and a miss line without the Ε-26 keys", () => {
  const m = M();
  const r = rowOf(m, 'wait:4101');
  assert.ok(r, 'VS-T118 is in hub[] (071:419 at_hub, 072:2443) and must still be a «ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» row');
  assert.deepStrictEqual({ kind: r.kind, rail: r.rail, rowDim: r.rowDim, pallets: r.kath.pallets, points: r.kath.to.length, group: r.group, pieces: r.pieceIds },
    { kind: 'unassigned', rail: 'red', rowDim: false, pallets: 27, points: 2, group: { order_id: 2101 }, pieces: [4101, 4102] });
  assert.ok(r.kath.to.every((p) => p.dim === false && p.from === null && p.to === null) && r.kath.headDim === false, 'no invented window');
  assert.ok(/προορισμ/.test(r.miss || ''), 'the missing destination is said on the row: ' + r.miss);
  assert.strictEqual(r.tiles[0].type, 'un');
  assert.ok(!m.hub.split.some((x) => [4101, 4102, 4103, 4104].includes(x.pieceId)), 'a never-assigned VS is never «για μοίρασμα»');
  const r2 = rowOf(M(withE26()), 'wait:4101');
  assert.strictEqual(r2.miss, null, 'with the Ε-26 keys the line goes');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(r2.kath.to.map((p) => [p.from, p.to]), [['06:00', '08:00'], ['07:00', '09:00']]);
  // a national that loads at Veroia without a truck sits in hub[] too (same 071 rule): a row, never ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ, never «σπάσιμο»
  const b = fix();
  b.hub.push(Object.assign({}, b.hub.find((h) => h.piece_id === 4101), { piece_id: 4190, shipment_id: 4290, kind: 'national', order_id: null, nat_order_id: 3290, order_stop_id: null, reference: 'N-T090', pallets: 6 }));
  const m3 = M(b);
  assert.strictEqual((rowOf(m3, 'wait:4190') || {}).kind, 'unassigned');
  assert.ok(!m3.hub.split.some((x) => x.pieceId === 4190) && !m3.queue.some((q) => q.pieceId === 4190));
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:108').rail, 'red', 'a cycle without a vehicle is «ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» too');
  // one national order that loads at Veroia (hub[]) AND at Lamia (waiting[]), Ε-19 N×1: ONE row, as the base assigns
  // it (plan_put_group takes the order's waiting pieces whole), with the «Βέροια» head AND the Lamia loading point —
  // the lowest piece does not decide alone
  const b4 = fix();
  b4.hub.push(Object.assign({}, b4.hub.find((h) => h.piece_id === 4101), { piece_id: 4191, shipment_id: 4291, kind: 'national', order_id: null, nat_order_id: 3291, order_stop_id: null, reference: 'N-T091', pallets: 5 }));
  b4.waiting.push(Object.assign({}, b4.waiting[0], { piece_id: 4192, shipment_id: 4292, nat_order_id: 3291, reference: 'N-T091', pallets: 7 }));
  const m4 = M(b4), r4 = rowOf(m4, 'wait:4191');
  assert.ok(r4 && !rowOf(m4, 'wait:4192'), 'one row for the order');
  assert.deepStrictEqual({ veroia: r4.kath.veroia, from: r4.kath.from.map((p) => [p.name, p.from, p.to, p.pallets]), pieces: r4.pieceIds, group: r4.group, pallets: r4.kath.pallets, day: r4.dayKey },
    { veroia: { stopId: null, from: null, to: null }, from: [['—', '08:00', '10:00', 7]], pieces: [4191, 4192], group: { nat_order_id: 3291 }, pallets: 12, day: '2026-10-12' });
});

test('F4α-T4: dim/headDim/sideDim/rowDim copied from dim/side_dim/cycle_dim; the model computes no date rule', () => {
  const m = M();
  const r101 = rowOf(m, 'rt:101'), r102 = rowOf(m, 'rt:102');
  assert.strictEqual(r101.rowDim, true);
  assert.deepStrictEqual({ head: r102.kath.headDim, side: r102.kath.sideDim, row: r102.rowDim, to: r102.kath.to.map((p) => p.dim) },
    { head: true, side: false, row: false, to: [false, false, false] });
  // S-89: a stop whose day has passed but the base says dim:false stays bold — and the reverse.
  const b = fix();
  b.cycles.find((c) => c.rt_id === 101).stops.find((s) => s.stop_id === 1002).dim = false;
  b.cycles.find((c) => c.rt_id === 105).stops.find((s) => s.stop_id === 1403).dim = true;
  const m2 = M(b);
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m2, 'rt:101').kath.to.find((p) => p.stopId === 1002).dim, false);
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m2, 'rt:105').kath.to.find((p) => p.stopId === 1403).dim, true, 'a future stop the base calls dim is dim');
  // and «today» changes no flag
  assert.deepStrictEqual(JSON.stringify(L.model(fix(), { today: '2026-12-31' }).days.map((d) => d.rows.map((r) => r.rowDim))),
    JSON.stringify(M().days.map((d) => d.rows.map((r) => r.rowDim))));
});

test('F4α-T4: capacity sums load legs of the side; over = pallets − 33', () => {
  const c101 = fix().cycles.find((c) => c.rt_id === 101);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(L.capacity(c101.stops.filter((s) => s.side === 'KATHODOS')), { pallets: 31, over: 0 });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(L.capacity(c101.stops.filter((s) => s.side === 'ANODOS')), { pallets: 14, over: 0 });
  const big = [{ legs: [{ act: 'load', pallets: 20.5 }, { act: 'load', pallets: 15.6 }, { act: 'unload', pallets: 99 }] }];
  assert.deepStrictEqual(L.capacity(big), { pallets: 36.1, over: 3.1 });
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(M(), 'rt:108').kath.over, 0, '33 is full, not over');
});

test('F4α-T4: queue = the VS of the «ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» rows (hub[] never-assigned + waiting[]); late = overdue; no stock, no national, no VS already on a truck', () => {
  const q = M().queue;
  assert.deepStrictEqual(q.map((x) => [x.code, x.reason, x.pallets, x.day]),
    [['VS-T118', 'no_truck', 27, '2026-10-12'], ['VS-T121', 'late', 3, '2026-10-12'], ['VS-T133', 'no_truck', 33, '2026-10-16']]);
  assert.ok(!q.some((x) => x.code === 'N-T020'), 'a national load is not in ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ');
  const b = fix();
  b.hub.push(Object.assign({}, b.hub.find((h) => h.piece_id === 4101), { piece_id: 4199, shipment_id: 4299, order_id: 2199, reference: 'VS-T199', is_stock: true }));
  assert.ok(!M(b).queue.some((x) => x.code === 'VS-T199'), 'stock never enters the queue');
  // «late» = the base's overdue of a VS still WITHOUT a truck (v_piece_state.overdue). A VS on a cycle that delivers
  // after its day is that row's amber rail (has_late), never an ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ card: it already has a truck.
  const b2 = fix();
  b2.cycles.find((c) => c.rt_id === 102).stops.find((s) => s.stop_id === 1103).has_late = true;   // VS-T102 delivers late on RT-T102
  const m2 = M(b2);
  assert.ok(rowOf(m2, 'rt:102').late && !m2.queue.some((x) => x.code === 'VS-T102'), 'a VS on a truck that is late stays on its row');
});

test('F4α-T4: hub split = unloaded at Veroia by a cycle (inbound_rt_id) or for_split, never a never-assigned piece; stock; overdue → red; nothing to split or hold → hub.empty', () => {
  const h = M().hub;
  assert.deepStrictEqual({ day: h.day, split: h.split.map((x) => x.pieceId), stock: h.stock.map((x) => [x.pieceId, x.overdue, x.leave_by]), pallets: h.pallets, empty: h.empty },
    { day: TODAY, split: [4302], stock: [[4301, true, '2026-10-12']], pallets: { split: 20, stock: 13 }, empty: false });
  // the Ε-41 key (not in 072): what ✈ «Σπάσιμο» sent back is «για μοίρασμα», and leaves the rows and the queue
  const b = fix();
  for (const x of b.hub) if (x.order_id === 2101) x.for_split = true;
  const m2 = M(b);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(m2.hub.split.map((x) => x.pieceId), [4101, 4102, 4302]);
  assert.ok(!rowOf(m2, 'wait:4101') && !m2.queue.some((x) => x.code === 'VS-T118'), 'for_split: the Veroia board only');
  const b3 = fix(); b3.hub = b3.hub.filter((x) => x.is_stock !== true && x.inbound_rt_id == null);
  assert.strictEqual(M(b3).hub.empty, true, 'only never-assigned pieces: rows, and the Veroia line stays hidden');
  const b4 = fix(); b4.hub = [];
  assert.strictEqual(M(b4).hub.empty, true);
});

test('F4α-T4: the hub id from base facts; a week with no VS on a truck still says «Βέροια» on hub[] rows, cycles take opts.hubId', () => {
  assert.strictEqual(M().hubId, 1);
  const b = fix();
  for (const c of b.cycles) for (const s of c.stops) s.legs = s.legs.filter((l) => !String(l.kind).startsWith('vs_'));
  const m = M(b);
  assert.strictEqual(m.hubId, null, 'no VS leg, no vs_export waiting: nothing on the 072 board names the hub (Ε-27)');
  assert.ok(rowOf(m, 'wait:4101').kath.veroia, 'a hub[] row is at Veroia by the base rule (071 at_hub), whatever the id');
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(m, 'rt:102').kath.veroia, null, 'without an id a cycle cannot name its Veroia stop');
  // ... and the board SAYS so (principle 1, Ε-44): the Veroia times are missing and Veroia reads as an ordinary stop
  assert.deepStrictEqual(m.errors, [L.HUB_UNKNOWN], 'a week whose hub is not identified carries one visible line');
  assert.ok(/Βέροια δεν αναγνωρίστηκε/.test(L.HUB_UNKNOWN), L.HUB_UNKNOWN);
  const mh = L.model(b, { today: TODAY, hubId: 1 });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(rowOf(mh, 'rt:102').kath.veroia, { stopId: 1101, from: '16:00', to: '18:00' }, 'opts.hubId (PlanIds.hub) names it');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(mh.errors, [], 'with opts.hubId the line goes');
  const be = fix(); be.cycles = [];
  assert.deepStrictEqual([M(be).hubId, M(be).errors], [null, [L.HUB_UNKNOWN]],
    'no cycle but a waiting national: its side needs the hub, so the line stays');
  const bn = fix(); bn.cycles = []; bn.waiting = bn.waiting.filter((w) => w.kind !== 'national');
  assert.deepStrictEqual([M(bn).hubId, M(bn).errors], [null, []], 'no cycle and no waiting national: nothing to place, no line');
});

test('F4α-T4: WN5L.CAP = the over_33 threshold of 072', () => {
  // principle 3: the x/33 of the screen and the base's warning are one number; a change in 072 breaks the build here
  const m = /'over_33'[\s\S]{0,600}?having\s+sum\(pp\.pallets\)\s*>\s*(\d+)/.exec(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'worker/migrations/072_plan_functions.sql'), 'utf8'));
  assert.ok(m, 'the over_33 HAVING of 072 not found');

});

test("F4α-T4: no segments key → one tile from the cycle (segSource 'cycle'); segments [] or non-array → ShapeError", () => {
  const c = fix().cycles[0];
  assert.deepStrictEqual(L.segmentsOf(c).source, 'cycle');
  assert.strictEqual(L.segmentsOf(c).segments.length, 1);
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(M(), 'rt:101').segSource, 'cycle');
  for (const bad of [[], 'x', null, {}]) {
    assert.throws(() => L.segmentsOf(Object.assign({}, c, { segments: bad })), L.ShapeError, JSON.stringify(bad));
  }
  const b = fix(); b.cycles[0].segments = [];
  assert.throws(() => M(b), L.ShapeError);
  for (const k of ['cycles', 'waiting', 'hub', 'notices']) {
    const x = fix(); x[k] = {};
    assert.throws(() => M(x), (e) => e instanceof L.ShapeError && e.what === k, k);
  }
});

test('F4α-T4: partner_rate null → rates.missing (open item, never 0)', () => {
  const r = rowOf(M(), 'rt:104');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(r.rates, { partner_rate: null, missing: true });
  // one-segment cycle = F0 7745 / H1 rows 2–6: line 2 is the partner's plate, which the 072 board does not carry
  // (Ε-35, Ε-36) → «—»; the rate / «κόμιστρο λείπει» lives in Δ1, the move list and the H3 segment tiles (Ε-13)
  assert.deepStrictEqual([r.tiles[0].line1, r.tiles[0].line2, r.tiles[0].missing], ['Partner Test Pelagos', '—', false]);
  const b = fix(); b.cycles.find((c) => c.rt_id === 104).partner_rate = 300;
  const r2 = rowOf(M(b), 'rt:104');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(r2.rates, { partner_rate: 300, missing: false });
  assert.deepStrictEqual([r2.tiles[0].line2, r2.tiles[0].partnerRate], ['—', 300], 'the rate stays data, never on the one-segment tile');
  const segs = (rate) => [{ segment_id: 1, label: 'initial', trip_type: 'OWNED', truck: 'TST-2104', driver: 'Driver Test 01', has_vehicle: true, stop_ids: [] },
    { segment_id: 2, label: 'final', trip_type: 'PARTNER', partner: 'Partner Test Pelagos', partner_rate: rate, has_vehicle: true, stop_ids: [] }];
  const b2 = fix(); b2.cycles.find((c) => c.rt_id === 104).segments = segs(null);
  assert.deepStrictEqual([rowOf(M(b2), 'rt:104').tiles[1].line2, rowOf(M(b2), 'rt:104').tiles[1].missing], ['κόμιστρο λείπει', true], 'H3 segment tile');
  b2.cycles.find((c) => c.rt_id === 104).segments = segs(300);
  assert.strictEqual(rowOf(M(b2), 'rt:104').tiles[1].line2, '300 €');
});

test('F4α-T4: the module never calls Date.now() / new Date() without an argument', () => {
  const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'core/wn5-logic.js'), 'utf8').replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g, '');
  assert.ok(!/Date\.now\s*\(/.test(src), 'Date.now() in core/wn5-logic.js');
  assert.ok(!/new Date\(\s*\)/.test(src), 'new Date() without an argument in core/wn5-logic.js');
  const ctx = {}; ctx.window = ctx;
  const before = new Set(Object.keys(ctx));
  vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'core/wn5-logic.js'), 'utf8'), ctx);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(Object.keys(ctx).filter((k) => !before.has(k)), ['WN5L']);
});

// ── drift: the fixture's keys are the jsonb_build_object keys of 072 plan_board (and of the 071 view / table it
//    serialises whole), both ways. A key the base adds or drops fails here, at build time, not on the screen.
const SQL072 = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'worker/migrations/072_plan_functions.sql'), 'utf8');
const SQL071 = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'worker/migrations/071_plan_schema.sql'), 'utf8');
function seg(text, from, to, what) {
  const a = text.indexOf(from); assert.ok(a >= 0, `${what}: «${from}» not found`);
  const b = text.indexOf(to, a); assert.ok(b > a, `${what}: «${to}» not found`);
  return text.slice(a, b);
}
const keysIn = (s) => [...new Set([...s.matchAll(/'([a-z_]+)',/g)].map((m) => m[1]))];
function boardShape() {
  const fn = seg(SQL072, 'CREATE FUNCTION public.plan_board(', 'CREATE FUNCTION public.plan_vs_state(', 'plan_board');
  const view = seg(SQL071, 'CREATE VIEW public.v_hub_bucket', 'WHERE ps.at_hub', 'v_hub_bucket');
  const viewCols = view.slice(view.indexOf('SELECT') + 6, view.indexOf('FROM')).split(',').map((c) => c.trim().split(/\s+AS\s+|\./i).pop().trim());
  const table = seg(SQL071, 'CREATE TABLE public.plan_notices (', 'CONSTRAINT', 'plan_notices');
  return {
    top: ['week', 'cycles', 'waiting', 'hub', 'notices'],
    cycle: [...keysIn(seg(fn, "'rt_id', vc.rt_id", "'stops', coalesce((", 'cycle')), 'stops', 'partner_rate'],
    stop: [...keysIn(seg(fn, "'stop_id', ss.stop_id", "'local_loading', (", 'stop')), 'local_loading', 'legs'],
    local: keysIn(seg(fn, "'local_move_id', lm.id", 'from local_moves lm', 'local_loading')).concat(['time_to']),
    leg: keysIn(seg(fn, "'leg_id', l.id", 'from piece_legs l', 'legs')).concat(['temperature_c']),
    waiting: keysIn(seg(fn, "'piece_id', ps.piece_id", 'from v_piece_state ps', 'waiting')).concat(['deliver_to']),
    hub: [...viewCols, ...keysIn(seg(fn, "jsonb_build_object('client_id', vs.client_id", 'order by hb.nat_due_day', 'hub')), 'temperature_c'],
    notice: [...table.matchAll(/\b([a-z_]+)\s+(?:bigint|text|timestamptz)\b/g)].map((m) => m[1]),
  };
}
const same = (got, want, what) => assert.deepStrictEqual([...new Set(got)].sort(), [...new Set(want)].sort(), what);

test('F4α-T4: fixture keys = jsonb_build_object keys of plan_board in 072; no money key', () => {
  const W = boardShape();
  const f = fix();
  same(Object.keys(f), W.top, 'top level');
  for (const c of f.cycles) {
    same(Object.keys(c), W.cycle, `cycle ${c.rt_id}`);
    for (const s of c.stops) {
      same(Object.keys(s), W.stop, `stop ${s.stop_id}`);
      if (s.local_loading) same(Object.keys(s.local_loading), W.local, `local_loading of ${s.stop_id}`);
      for (const l of s.legs) same(Object.keys(l), W.leg, `leg ${l.leg_id}`);
    }
  }
  // price only on a national waiting load (072: «|| case when ps.nat_order_id is not null then price»)
  for (const w of f.waiting) same(Object.keys(w), w.nat_order_id != null ? W.waiting : W.waiting.filter((k) => k !== 'price'), `waiting ${w.piece_id}`);
  for (const h of f.hub) same(Object.keys(h), W.hub, `hub ${h.piece_id}`);
  for (const n of f.notices) same(Object.keys(n), W.notice, `notice ${n.id}`);
  assert.ok(!/"(amount|advance|expenses|invoice_number)"/.test(FIX_TEXT), 'a money key in the dispatcher fixture');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(M().errors, [], 'the fixture draws without a shape error');
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Γράψε το fixture `tests/fixtures/wn5-week.json`**

Το fixture γράφεται **μία φορά** από αυτή τη γεννήτρια (δεν μπαίνει στο repo· μπαίνει μόνο το JSON που βγάζει). Τα `dim`/`side_dim`/`cycle_dim`/`executed` είναι ο κανόνας της βάσης (071 `v_rt_stop_state`) στο ρολόι των rigs, Τρί 13/10/2026: έτσι το fixture είναι καθρέφτης της βάσης, και το `--check-fixture` του rig το ξανασυγκρίνει. Συνθετικά δεδομένα μόνο: `TST-/TRL-` πινακίδες, «Driver Test NN», «ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Α…Ζ», «Partner Test Pelagos», τοποθεσίες «… Test».

```bash
mkdir -p tests/fixtures
node - <<'EOF'
const TODAY = '2026-10-13';
const LOC = { 1: 'ΒΕΡΟΙΑ TEST', 2: 'Rentis Test', 3: 'Aspropyrgos Test', 4: 'Oinofyta Test', 5: 'Larisa Test', 6: 'Thessaloniki Test', 7: 'Athens Test', 8: 'Lamia Test' };
const CLI = { 41: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Α', 42: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Β', 43: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Γ', 44: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Δ', 45: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Ε', 46: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Ζ' };
const ts = (day, hm) => `${day}T${hm}:00+03:00`;
let legId = 5000;
const PIECES = {}; // piece -> {kind, order_id, nat_order_id, reference, client_id, temperature_c, pallets}
const piece = (id, pallets, kind, ref, client, ord) => { PIECES[id] = { pallets, kind, ref, client, order_id: kind === 'national' ? null : ord, nat_order_id: kind === 'national' ? ord : null, temperature_c: kind === 'national' ? 4 : 2 }; };
const LEG = {}; // piece -> leg id
const legOf = (p) => (LEG[p] = LEG[p] || ++legId);
const leg = (p, act) => { const x = PIECES[p]; return { leg_id: legOf(p), piece_id: p, act, pallets: x.pallets, kind: x.kind, order_id: x.order_id, nat_order_id: x.nat_order_id, reference: x.ref, client_id: x.client, client: CLI[x.client], temperature_c: x.temperature_c }; };
function cycle(c) {
  const stops = c.stops.map((s, i) => {
    const day = s.day;
    const executed = day < TODAY;
    const has_vehicle = c.trip_type === 'OWNED' ? c.truck_id != null : c.partner_id != null;
    const has_late = !!s.late;
    return { stop_id: s.id, seq: i + 1, side: s.side, location_id: s.loc, location: LOC[s.loc], planned_from: ts(s.fromDay || day, s.from), planned_to: ts(day, s.to), stop_day: day,
      executed, has_vehicle, has_late, dim: executed && has_vehicle && !has_late, side_dim: false, cycle_dim: false, local_loading: s.local || null,
      legs: [...(s.load || []).map((p) => leg(p, 'load')), ...(s.unload || []).map((p) => leg(p, 'unload'))] };
  });
  for (const side of ['KATHODOS', 'ANODOS']) { const ss = stops.filter((s) => s.side === side); const all = ss.length > 0 && ss.every((s) => s.dim); ss.forEach((s) => { s.side_dim = all; }); }
  const cd = stops.every((s) => s.dim); stops.forEach((s) => { s.cycle_dim = cd; });
  const start = stops[0].planned_from, end = stops[stops.length - 1].planned_to;
  return { rt_id: c.rt_id, code: 'RT-T' + c.rt_id, trip_type: c.trip_type, truck_id: c.truck_id || null, truck: c.truck || null, trailer_id: c.trailer_id || null, trailer: c.trailer || null,
    driver_id: c.driver_id || null, driver: c.driver || null, partner_id: c.partner_id || null, partner: c.partner || null,
    start_at: start, end_at: end, date_start: stops[0].stop_day, date_end: stops[stops.length - 1].stop_day, ended: stops[stops.length - 1].stop_day < TODAY,
    stops, partner_rate: c.partner_rate === undefined ? null : c.partner_rate };
}
// pieces
piece(4001, 12, 'national', 'N-T001', 41, 3001); piece(4002, 9, 'vs_import', 'VS-T101', 42, 2001); piece(4003, 10, 'national', 'N-T002', 43, 3002);
piece(4011, 8, 'national', 'N-T011', 44, 3011); piece(4012, 6, 'national', 'N-T012', 45, 3012);
piece(4021, 12, 'national', 'N-T021', 41, 3021); piece(4022, 9, 'vs_import', 'VS-T102', 42, 2002); piece(4023, 6, 'national', 'N-T023', 43, 3023);
piece(4024, 8, 'national', 'N-T024', 44, 3024); piece(4025, 10, 'national', 'N-T025', 45, 3025); piece(4026, 6, 'national', 'N-T026', 46, 3026);
piece(4031, 6, 'national', 'N-T031', 41, 3031); piece(4032, 10, 'national', 'N-T032', 46, 3032); piece(4033, 12, 'vs_import', 'VS-T103', 42, 2003);
piece(4041, 18, 'national', 'N-T041', 41, 3041); piece(4042, 5, 'national', 'N-T042', 43, 3042);
piece(4051, 6, 'national', 'N-T051', 44, 3051); piece(4052, 22, 'national', 'N-T052', 41, 3052); piece(4053, 2, 'vs_import', 'VS-T105', 42, 2005);
piece(4054, 4, 'national', 'N-T054', 45, 3054);
piece(4061, 20, 'national', 'N-T061', 45, 3061); piece(4071, 9, 'national', 'N-T071', 46, 3071); piece(4081, 33, 'vs_import', 'VS-T108', 42, 2008);
const cycles = [
```

```js
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// WEEKLY NATIONAL v5 — pure logic (global WN5L)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-26-f4a-national-v5-screens.md, Task T4. Input: the JSON of GET /plan/board
// (worker/migrations/072_plan_functions.sql plan_board); the fixture tests/fixtures/wn5-week.json is held to that
// SQL by tests/wn5-logic.test.js, so a new key of the board cannot be missed here.
//
// Plain functions on plain objects: no DOM, no WNATL, no Date.now() — «today» is an argument — so the board, the
// queue and the Veroia line read ONE rule each and node --test proves them without a browser. The same file loads
// as a browser global and as a node module. At load it only defines WN5L (tests/wn5-contract.test.js).
//
// What this file does NOT decide (principle 3, spec §3 Board): whether something is executed, dimmed or late. Those
// come from the base (v_rt_stop_state.dim / side_dim / cycle_dim / has_late / has_vehicle, v_piece_state.overdue)
// and are copied as they are. What is computed here is display only: the day a row sits under, the numbering of
// cycles and points, sums of pallets, the Athens hh:mm of an instant.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function () {
'use strict';

const freeze = Object.freeze;
const DAY_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const CAP = 33;   // pallets of one trailer — the same number as the base's over_33 warning (Ε-17); display only
// Upper case is TYPED (the tonos trap of CSS text-transform).
const DOW_HEAD = freeze(['ΚΥΡΙΑΚΗ', 'ΔΕΥΤΕΡΑ', 'ΤΡΙΤΗ', 'ΤΕΤΑΡΤΗ', 'ΠΕΜΠΤΗ', 'ΠΑΡΑΣΚΕΥΗ', 'ΣΑΒΒΑΤΟ']);
const LISTS = freeze(['cycles', 'waiting', 'hub', 'notices']);
const ATH_DAY = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Europe/Athens', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' });
const ATH_TIME = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Europe/Athens', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23' });

class ShapeError extends Error {
  constructor(what) { super('plan_board shape: ' + what); this.name = 'ShapeError'; this.what = what; }
}

const r1 = (x) => Math.round(Number(x || 0) * 10) / 10;   // pallets: one decimal at most (numeric(6,1))
const _sum = (items) => r1(items.reduce((n, x) => n + Number(x.pallets || 0), 0));
const _ms = (iso) => { const t = new Date(iso).getTime(); return Number.isNaN(t) ? Infinity : t; };
function athensDay(iso) { if (!iso) return null; const d = new Date(iso); return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : ATH_DAY.format(d); }
function athensTime(iso) { if (!iso) return null; const d = new Date(iso); return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : ATH_TIME.format(d); }
function _addDays(day, n) { const [y, m, d] = day.split('-').map(Number); return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d + n)).toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
function _dowOf(day) { const [y, m, d] = day.split('-').map(Number); return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)).getUTCDay(); }
// The board's day words come from ONE place, WI4.dayLabel (core/wi4-logic.js): «Τρί 13/10».
function _wi4() {
  if (typeof WI4 !== 'undefined') return WI4;
  if (typeof require === 'function') { try { return require('./wi4-logic.js'); } catch (_) { return null; } }
  return null;
}
const _dow = (day) => { const lg = _wi4(); return lg && day ? lg.dayLabel(day).split(' ')[0] : day || ''; };
const _rate = (x) => Number(x).toLocaleString('el-GR', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });

// The Veroia hub has no flag on the board's stops (072 plan_board sends location_id only). Its id is read from the
// one fact the base guarantees about a VS (072 leg_place, «από την αφετηρία του, μέσω Βέροιας»): a vs_import starts
// at the hub, a vs_export ends there. A hub[] item IS at the hub (071 at_hub) but carries no location id, so it
// names nothing. No VS in the week → null (opts.hubId from PlanIds.hub() when the catalogue exists, Ε-27); model()
// then puts HUB_UNKNOWN on the board, never a silent ordinary «ΒΕΡΟΙΑ» stop (Ε-44).
function hubFromBoard(board, errors) {
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const w of (board && board.waiting) || []) {
    if (w.kind === 'vs_import' && w.nat_from_location_id != null) seen.add(Number(w.nat_from_location_id));
    if (w.kind === 'vs_export' && w.nat_to_location_id != null) seen.add(Number(w.nat_to_location_id));
  }
  for (const c of (board && board.cycles) || []) for (const s of c.stops || []) for (const l of s.legs || []) {
    if ((l.kind === 'vs_import' && l.act === 'load') || (l.kind === 'vs_export' && l.act === 'unload')) seen.add(Number(s.location_id));
  }
  if (seen.size > 1 && errors) errors.push('Δεν βρέθηκε ένας μόνο κόμβος Βέροιας στα δεδομένα (θέσεις ' + [...seen].join(', ') + ')');
  return seen.size === 1 ? [...seen][0] : null;
}

// 072 boards carry no `segments` key: one segment from the cycle's own vehicle, drawn exactly as today (R-59).
// With 072b the key is a non-empty list; present but not that is a shape the screen cannot draw (OPEN-9).
function segmentsOf(cycle) {
  if (!cycle || typeof cycle !== 'object') throw new ShapeError('cycle');
  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cycle, 'segments')) {
    const stops = Array.isArray(cycle.stops) ? cycle.stops : [];
    // has_vehicle is the base's (v_rt_stop_state); only a cycle without stops falls back to that view's own CASE.
    const has = stops.length ? stops[0].has_vehicle === true : cycle.trip_type === 'PARTNER' ? cycle.partner_id != null : cycle.truck_id != null;
    return { source: 'cycle', segments: [{ segment_id: null, label: null, trip_type: cycle.trip_type, truck_id: cycle.truck_id, truck: cycle.truck,
      trailer_id: cycle.trailer_id, trailer: cycle.trailer, driver_id: cycle.driver_id, driver: cycle.driver, partner_id: cycle.partner_id,
      partner: cycle.partner, partner_rate: cycle.partner_rate, has_vehicle: has, stop_ids: null }] };
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(cycle.segments) || !cycle.segments.length) throw new ShapeError(`cycles[${cycle.rt_id}].segments`);
  return { source: 'segments', segments: cycle.segments };
}

// Owned cycles of one truck in the week, by start: «κύκλος 1» alone, «1/2», «2/2» (owner 22/10). Partners: none.
function cycleNumbers(cycles) {
  const by = new Map();
  for (const c of cycles || []) {
    if (c.trip_type === 'PARTNER' || c.truck_id == null) continue;
    if (!by.has(c.truck_id)) by.set(c.truck_id, []);
    by.get(c.truck_id).push(c);
  }
  const out = new Map();
  for (const list of by.values()) {
    list.sort((a, b) => _ms(a.start_at) - _ms(b.start_at) || a.rt_id - b.rt_id);
    list.forEach((c, i) => out.set(c.rt_id, { n: i + 1, m: list.length }));
  }
  return out;
}

// x/33 of one side: the pallets its stops load (raw board stops of that side).
function capacity(sideStops) {
  const pallets = _sum((sideStops || []).flatMap((s) => (s.legs || []).filter((l) => l.act === 'load')));
  return { pallets, over: pallets > CAP ? r1(pallets - CAP) : 0 };
}

// «μπαίνει kη»: the place a new stop would take by its planned_from (display only — the base orders the stops).
function stopRank(stops, plannedFrom) {
  const at = _ms(plannedFrom);
  return 1 + (stops || []).filter((s) => _ms(s.planned_from) < at).length;
}

function searchParts(row) {
  return (row && Array.isArray(row._parts) ? row._parts : []).filter((x) => x != null && String(x).trim() !== '').map(String);
}

function _legs(s, act) { return (s.legs || []).filter((l) => l.act === act); }
function _point(s, pallets) {
  return { stopId: s.stop_id, n: 0, name: s.location || '—', city: null,
    clients: [...new Set((s.legs || []).map((l) => l.client).filter(Boolean))],
    from: athensTime(s.planned_from), to: athensTime(s.planned_to), pallets,
    dim: s.dim === true, late: s.has_late === true, segmentId: null, segLabel: null, day: s.stop_day || athensDay(s.planned_to) };

// One side of a cycle. KATHODOS: the hub stop is the Veroia loading (its window shows under «Βέροια», on the side,

  const eIdx = name === 'ANODOS' && hubIdx.length ? hubIdx[hubIdx.length - 1] : -1;

    side: {

      veroia: v ? { stopId: v.stop_id, from: athensTime(v.planned_from), to: athensTime(v.planned_to) } : null,
      headDim: dayStop.dim === true, from, to, pallets, over: pallets > CAP ? r1(pallets - CAP) : 0,

}

  const t = { type, label: s.label || null, line1: '', line2: '', segmentId: s.segment_id == null ? null : s.segment_id,

const _neverAssigned = (h) => h.is_stock !== true && h.inbound_rt_id == null && h.for_split !== true;

})();
```

```js
// per-day rule at the rig's clock (else the dim scenario would test the fixture, not the screen), and every case

function checkFixture() {

  const uniq = (xs) => new Set(xs).size === xs.length;

  ok(scn, 'cycle, stop, waiting/hub piece and notice ids are unique', uniq(F.cycles.map((c) => c.rt_id)) && uniq(stops.map((s) => s.stop_id))
    && uniq([...F.waiting, ...F.hub].map((w) => w.piece_id)) && uniq(F.notices.map((n) => n.id)));

  const badLegs = Object.entries(byLeg).filter(([, a]) => a.filter((x) => x === 'load').length !== 1 || a.filter((x) => x === 'unload').length > 1);

  const plates = F.cycles.flatMap((c) => [c.truck, c.trailer]).filter(Boolean);

  // has_vehicle ∧ ¬has_late; side_dim / cycle_dim = every stop of the side / cycle dim.

      if (s.stop_day !== day || s.executed !== exe || s.has_vehicle !== hv || s.dim !== (exe && hv && !s.has_late)) bad.push(s.stop_id);
    }
    for (const side of ['KATHODOS', 'ANODOS']) {
      const ss = c.stops.filter((s) => s.side === side);
      if (ss.some((s) => s.side_dim !== ss.every((x) => x.dim))) bad.push(`${c.rt_id}/${side}`);
    }
    if (c.stops.some((s) => s.cycle_dim !== c.stops.every((x) => x.dim))) bad.push(c.rt_id);
  }
  ok(scn, 'stop_day / executed / dim / side_dim / cycle_dim follow the base rule at the rig clock', !bad.length, bad);
  const WN5L = require(path.join(WT, 'core/wn5-logic.js'));
  const m = WN5L.model(F, { today });
  // Where a piece lives is the base's rule, not the fixture's choice: waiting[] = «waiting and not at_hub»
  // (072:2443) — nothing standing at the hub; hub[] = v_hub_bucket (071:470) with its keys only (no Ε-26 keys).
  ok(scn, 'waiting[] holds no piece standing at the hub (072:2443): an import VS no truck took is in hub[]',
    F.waiting.every((w) => w.position_location_id !== m.hubId && w.kind !== 'vs_import'), F.waiting.map((w) => [w.piece_id, w.kind, w.position_location_id]));
  ok(scn, 'hub[] items carry the v_hub_bucket keys only (no nat_to_location_id / load_* / deliver_*: Ε-26)',
    F.hub.every((h) => !['nat_to_location_id', 'load_from', 'load_to', 'deliver_from', 'deliver_to', 'position_location_id'].some((k) => k in h)));
  // overdue is the base's (071 v_piece_state: waiting ∧ coalesce(leave_by, nat_due_day) < today): a «late» piece the
  // base cannot produce would let the red point and the queue reason 'late' pass on impossible data.
  const badOver = [...F.waiting, ...F.hub].filter((w) => { const d = w.leave_by || w.nat_due_day; return w.overdue !== (d != null && d < today); })
    .map((w) => [w.piece_id, w.reference, w.leave_by, w.nat_due_day, w.overdue]);
  ok(scn, 'overdue = coalesce(leave_by, nat_due_day) < today on every waiting[] / hub[] piece (071 v_piece_state)', !badOver.length, badOver);
  // inbound_rt_id is the cycle that last unloaded the piece (or its split parent) at the hub: a cycle of THIS board
  // named there must show that order's unload at the hub.
  const badIn = F.hub.filter((h) => {
    const c = h.inbound_rt_id != null && F.cycles.find((x) => x.rt_id === h.inbound_rt_id);
    return c && !c.stops.some((s) => s.location_id === m.hubId && s.legs.some((l) => l.act === 'unload'
      && (h.order_id != null ? l.order_id === h.order_id : l.nat_order_id === h.nat_order_id)));
  }).map((h) => [h.piece_id, h.reference, h.inbound_rt_id]);
  ok(scn, 'a hub[] inbound_rt_id naming a cycle of the board has that order\'s unload at the hub on it', !badIn.length, badIn);
  const CASES = {
    'Veroia loading on ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ (time under «Βέροια»)': () => F.cycles.some((c) => c.stops[0].side === 'KATHODOS' && c.stops[0].location_id === m.hubId),
    'ΑΝΟΔΟΣ-only cycle («Χωρίς κάθοδο»)': () => F.cycles.some((c) => c.stops.every((s) => s.side === 'ANODOS')),
    'own cycle without ΑΝΟΔΟΣ («Κενό γύρισμα»)': () => F.cycles.some((c) => c.trip_type === 'OWNED' && c.truck_id != null && c.stops.every((s) => s.side === 'KATHODOS')),
    'partner without a rate («κόμιστρο λείπει»)': () => F.cycles.some((c) => c.trip_type === 'PARTNER' && c.partner_rate == null),
    'a late stop (has_late)': () => stops.some((s) => s.has_late),
    'a local loading («Φόρτωση με τοπικό»)': () => stops.some((s) => s.local_loading),
    'a cycle without a vehicle': () => F.cycles.some((c) => c.trip_type === 'OWNED' && c.truck_id == null),
    'two cycles of one truck («1/2», «2/2»)': () => [...WN5L.cycleNumbers(F.cycles).values()].some((x) => x.m === 2),
    'loading outside Veroia and at Veroia on one ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ': () => F.cycles.some((c) => { const k = c.stops.filter((s) => s.side === 'KATHODOS'); return k.length > 1 && k[0].location_id !== m.hubId && k.some((s) => s.location_id === m.hubId); }),
    'a whole cycle executed (row dimmed)': () => F.cycles.some((c) => c.stops.every((s) => s.cycle_dim)),
    'loaded before today, delivering today (head dimmed only)': () => F.cycles.some((c) => c.stops.some((s) => s.dim) && c.stops.some((s) => !s.dim && s.stop_day === today)),
    'a VS waiting with two deliveries (one row)': () => m.days.flatMap((d) => d.rows).some((r) => r.kind === 'unassigned' && r.pieceIds.length > 1),
    'a VS no truck took, in hub[] (live 072 shape)': () => F.hub.some((h) => h.kind === 'vs_import' && h.is_stock !== true && h.inbound_rt_id == null),
    'a late VS (overdue)': () => [...F.waiting, ...F.hub].some((w) => String(w.kind).startsWith('vs_') && w.overdue),
    'a hub[] VS without nat_ready_day (cross_dock_date empty: its day is nat_due_day − 1)': () => F.hub.some((h) => h.kind === 'vs_import' && h.nat_ready_day == null && h.nat_due_day != null),
    'a national waiting load (price key)': () => F.waiting.some((w) => w.kind === 'national' && 'price' in w),
    'stock overdue at the hub': () => F.hub.some((h) => h.is_stock && h.overdue),
    'a split candidate at the hub (unloaded there by a cycle)': () => F.hub.some((h) => !h.is_stock && h.inbound_rt_id != null),
    'two notices, sentinel texts': () => F.notices.length === 2 && F.notices.every((n) => /^rig sentinel notice \d+$/.test(n.message)),
    'an empty day inside the week («καμία φόρτωση»)': () => m.days.some((d) => d.empty),
  };
  for (const [name, fn] of Object.entries(CASES)) ok(scn, 'case: ' + name, fn());
  ok(scn, 'the model draws it without a shape error', !m.errors.length, m.errors);
  console.log(fails === before ? '\nFIXTURE GO: every case is in the week' : `\nFIXTURE NO-GO: ${fails - before} check(s) failed`);
  return fails === before;
}
// ── main ──
(async () => {
  if (argv.includes('--check-fixture')) process.exit(checkFixture() ? 0 : 1);
  const unknownScn = want.filter((w) => !(w in SCN));
```

Ο T5 **ξαναγράφει ολόκληρο** το `modules/weekly_natl_v5.js` (το κέλυφος του T3 + η ζωγραφική)· τα επόμενα Tasks (T6–T8, T10) κάνουν μικρά Edit πάνω σε αυτό το κείμενο.

**Νέα interfaces (σημειωμένα):** `WN5._html(model) -> string` (το σώμα του board, καθαρή συνάρτηση, για το node test)· `WN5._qMore()` («Όλα N ▾»)· στα στοιχεία του `WN5.MENU_ITEMS` το πεδίο `order` (κρατά τη σειρά του Figma 2011:8858 ό,τι σειρά κι αν έχουν τα Tasks που προσθέτουν γραμμές: 10 Άνοιγμα παραγγελιών · 20 Ανάθεση · 30 Νέα παραγγελία · 40 Φόρτωση με τοπικό · 50 Σπάσιμο · 60 Εκτύπωση · 70 Αντιγραφή πινακίδων · 90 Καθαρισμός). Ο T5 βάζει **μόνο** τη γραμμή «Αντιγραφή πινακίδων»· την «Εκτύπωση / WhatsApp ›» την προσθέτει ο T23 μαζί με το `WN5Sheet` (καμία νεκρή γραμμή μενού ως τότε). Μία γραμμή ανά στοιχείο του Figma: τα στοιχεία με `children` ζωγραφίζονται «ετικέτα ›» με υπο-μενού `role=menu` (κλικ ή → ανοίγει, ← κλείνει), το `count` ως αριθμός δεξιά· `WN5._menuItems(rtId)` (ετικέτες με τη σειρά, για το rig). Το κόκκινο «ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» και το «Ανάθεση» της ουράς έχουν `data-act="assign"` χωρίς handler ως τον T12.

```js
// node --test tests/wn5-board-html.test.js
// National v5 F4α Task T5 — the board HTML of the synthetic W42 against the owner changes of 25/10 (Figma H1
// 2120:7738, spec of the vehicle handover §7): no time in the ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ column, the Veroia loading time under «Βέροια»
// in ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ on EVERY row that loads there, the head «ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» alone, a one-segment cycle drawn as today (no
// label, no slanted edge), no hex in the module. The REAL core/wi4-logic.js, core/wn5-logic.js and
// modules/weekly_natl_v5.js run in a vm; WN5._html(model) is the board body, a pure function of the model.
// Cells hold spans and buttons only (a rule of the module), so a cell is the text up to its first </div>.
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = process.env.TMS_ROOT ? path.resolve(process.env.TMS_ROOT) : path.join(__dirname, '..');
const FIX = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures/wn5-week.json'), 'utf8'));
function load() {
  const store = new Map();
  const ctx = { console: { log() {}, warn() {}, error() {} }, location: { search: '', href: 'https://x/app.html' }, history: { state: null, replaceState() {} },
    localStorage: { getItem: (k) => (store.has(k) ? store.get(k) : null), setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)), removeItem: (k) => store.delete(k) },
    document: { querySelector: () => null, querySelectorAll: () => [], getElementById: () => null } };
  ctx.window = ctx;
  vm.createContext(ctx);
  for (const f of ['core/wi4-logic.js', 'core/wn5-logic.js', 'modules/weekly_natl_v5.js']) vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), 'utf8'), ctx, { filename: f });
  assert.ok(ctx.WN5 && typeof ctx.WN5._html === 'function', 'renderer _html not found in modules/weekly_natl_v5.js (WN5._html)');
  return ctx;
}
const html = (board = FIX) => { const c = load(); return c.WN5._html(c.WN5L.model(board, { today: '2026-10-13' })); };
// One chunk per row: from `<div class="wn5-row` to the next row (or the end of the day body).
const rows = (h) => h.split('<div class="wn5-row').slice(1).map((s) => '<div class="wn5-row' + s);
const keyOf = (chunk) => (/data-key="([^"]+)"/.exec(chunk) || [])[1];
const cell = (chunk, cls) => { const m = new RegExp(`<div class="${cls}">([\\s\\S]*?)</div>`).exec(chunk); return m ? m[1] : null; };

test('F4α-T5: no hh:mm inside any .wn5-asg', () => {
  const all = rows(html());
  assert.ok(all.length >= 10, `the board drew ${all.length} rows`);
  for (const r of all) {
    const asg = cell(r, 'wn5-asg');
    assert.ok(asg !== null, `${keyOf(r)}: no .wn5-asg cell`);
    assert.ok(!/\d{1,2}:\d{2}/.test(asg), `${keyOf(r)}: a time in ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ: ${asg}`);
  }
});

test('F4α-T5: every row loading at Veroia has .wn5-vtime inside .wn5-fl', () => {
  const c = load();
  const m = c.WN5L.model(FIX, { today: '2026-10-13' });
  const want = m.days.flatMap((d) => d.rows).filter((r) => r.kath && r.kath.veroia);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(Array.from(want, (r) => r.key), ['rt:101', 'rt:102', 'rt:103', 'rt:104', 'wait:4101', 'wait:4103', 'rt:105', 'rt:108', 'wait:4104']);
  const byKey = new Map(rows(c.WN5._html(m)).map((r) => [keyOf(r), r]));
  for (const r of want) {
    const fl = cell(byKey.get(r.key), 'wn5-fl');
    // the class list may grow (T6 adds the day dimming); the order «Βέροια» then its window may not
    assert.ok(fl && /<span class="wn5-vh[^"]*">Βέροια<\/span>/.test(fl), `${r.key}: no «Βέροια» in ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ: ${fl}`);
    // a hub[] row of 072 has no load window yet (Ε-26): «—» under «Βέροια», never «null–null»
    const win = r.kath.veroia.from ? `${r.kath.veroia.from}–${r.kath.veroia.to}` : '—';
    assert.ok(new RegExp(`<span class="wn5-vh[^"]*">Βέροια</span><span class="wn5-vtime[^"]*">${win}</span>`).test(fl), `${r.key}: no Veroia time under «Βέροια»: ${fl}`);
  }
  for (const r of rows(c.WN5._html(m))) assert.ok(!/wn5-vtime/.test(cell(r, 'wn5-asg') || ''), `${keyOf(r)}: a Veroia time in ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ`);
});

test('F4α-T5: header text is exactly «ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ»', () => {
  const h = html();
  const head = /<div class="wn5-cols" role="row">([\s\S]*?)<\/div>/.exec(h);
  assert.ok(head, 'no .wn5-cols header');
  assert.ok(head[1].includes('<span class="wn5-c-asg wn5-h-asg">ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ</span>'), head[1]);
  assert.ok(!/ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΒΕΡΟΙΑΣ/.test(head[1]), 'the F0 head «ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ · ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΒΕΡΟΙΑΣ» is back');
});

test('F4α-T5: no hex colour in the module', () => {
  const { check } = require(path.join(ROOT, 'tests/critics/static.js'));
  const unit = require(path.join(ROOT, 'tests/critics/units.js')).find((u) => u.unit === 'weekly_natl_v5');
  assert.ok(unit, 'unit weekly_natl_v5 not found in tests/critics/units.js');
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  process.chdir(ROOT);
  try { const r = check(unit, { hex: 0, truncate: 0 }); assert.strictEqual(r.pass, true, r.failures.join(' · ')); }
  finally { process.chdir(cwd); }
});

test('F4α-T5: one-segment cycle has no label and no slanted edge', () => {
  for (const r of rows(html()).filter((x) => /data-rt=/.test(x))) {
    const asg = cell(r, 'wn5-asg');
    assert.ok(!/wn5-tile|data-label|data-seg/.test(asg), `${keyOf(r)}: a segment tile on a cycle without segments: ${asg}`);
    assert.ok(!/ΑΡΧΙΚΟ|ΕΝΔΙΑΜΕΣΟ|ΤΕΛΙΚΟ/.test(asg), `${keyOf(r)}: a segment label`);
  }
});

test('F4α-T5: «Χωρίς κάθοδο», «Κενό γύρισμα», «Μόνο κάθοδος · συνεργάτης», partner tile «—», «ως Δευ 22:00», ↳ τοπικός, the hub[] miss line', () => {
  const by = new Map(rows(html()).map((r) => [keyOf(r), r]));

  assert.ok(/Μόνο κάθοδος · συνεργάτης/.test(by.get('rt:104')), 'rt:104');
  // F0 7745 / H1: a one-segment partner cycle shows the partner and its plate (the 072 board has none → «—»), never the rate (Ε-36)

  // live 072: VS-T118 is in hub[] without its destination / windows (Ε-26): «—» on the points and a visible line

  assert.ok(!/null/.test(by.get('wait:4101')), 'wait:4101 prints no «null»');
  assert.ok(/Βέροια · τέλος κύκλου<\/span><span class="wi4-l2">ως Δευ 22:00/.test(by.get('rt:101')), 'rt:101 end');
  assert.ok(/↳ <b>Φόρτωση με τοπικό<\/b> · Driver Test 11 · Δευ 12\/10 11:00–12:00 · για Oinofyta Test \(στάση 2\)/.test(by.get('rt:103')), 'rt:103 local');
  assert.ok(/class="wi4-box un" data-act="assign"/.test(by.get('wait:4101')) && /wi4-r-red/.test(by.get('wait:4101')), 'wait:4101 ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ');
```
