- [ ] **Step 4: Ξαναγράψε ολόκληρο το `modules/weekly_natl_v5.js`**

```js
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// WEEKLY NATIONAL v5 — the board of the new national model (global WN5)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-26-f4a-national-v5-screens.md (Tasks T3, T5–T8, T10). Spec:
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-21-national-v5-design.md §3. Figma KO7l2AfucR3HJEDIg1Yptr: board 2011:7745 with
// the owner changes of 25/10 (H1 2120:7738), menu 2011:8858, states Δ12 2069:8579. Behind FEATURES.WN_V5.
//
// Unlike Weekly International v4 (a second renderer over WINTL), v5 OWNS its data: one read, GET /plan/board
// ?week=<Saturday>, through planFetch (core/plan-api.js) — never the facade. The rows come from WN5L.model
// (core/wn5-logic.js): this file draws, it decides nothing the base decides. The week stays ONE: WNATL.week
// (core/ui.js ←/→ and the tabs move it, then renderWeeklyNatl() hands over through its one seam line).
//
// Rules this file keeps (each one a past incident of this project, as in modules/weekly_intl_v2.js):
//   - At load it ONLY defines WN5 (plus reading ?wn5= once): no listener, timer, observer or fetch.
//   - paint() never throws. A failure is STICKY for the session (_broken): the old board is drawn, with one
//     banner, until the next load — every hook then routes to the old board against the old board's DOM.
//   - Unknown ≠ empty: a board that did not arrive shows «—» and the Worker's message, never «καμία φόρτωση» or 0.
//   - The screen computes no rule of the base: dimming, lateness and days come from the board JSON (WN5L copies).
//   - No time in the ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ column, the Veroia loading time under «Βέροια» in ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ (owner 25/10).
//   - No Greek text of the Worker or the DB is copied here (principle 3): their messages are shown as they come.
//   - No role gate (owner 10/10, decision 41): buttons are not hidden, the Worker's 403 speaks.
//   - Rows are found by rt_id / piece_id at the moment of a click, never by a DOM index.
//   - Cells hold spans and buttons only (no nested div): tests/wn5-board-html.test.js reads the HTML by cell.
//   - No hex (static ratchet, unit weekly_natl_v5 = 0): every colour is a class of the wn5 / wi4 blocks of
//     assets/style.css.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function () {
'use strict';

const L = () => (typeof WN5L !== 'undefined' ? WN5L : null);
const DAY_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const ID_RE = /^[1-9]\d{0,14}$/;
const MONTH_GEN = Object.freeze(['Ιανουαρίου', 'Φεβρουαρίου', 'Μαρτίου', 'Απριλίου', 'Μαΐου', 'Ιουνίου', 'Ιουλίου',
  'Αυγούστου', 'Σεπτεμβρίου', 'Οκτωβρίου', 'Νοεμβρίου', 'Δεκεμβρίου']);
// Two stops per point column at 1920 (Figma 2011:7745: two ~178px stops), the rest behind «+N».
const VISIBLE_POINTS = 2;
// Inline SVG with currentColor: core/icons.js has no plane, and a colour literal here would break the ratchet.
const PLANE = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M22 2 11 13"/><path d="M22 2 15 22l-4-9-9-4 20-7z"/></svg>';
const CHEV = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>';

const _esc = (s) => (typeof escapeHtml === 'function'
  ? escapeHtml(String(s == null ? '' : s))
  : String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;'));
const _id = (x) => (ID_RE.test(String(x)) ? String(x) : '');   // safe to embed in an inline handler
function _logErr(e, where) { try { if (typeof logError === 'function') logError(e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e)), where); } catch (_) {} }
function _ls(k) { try { return localStorage.getItem(k); } catch (_) { return null; } }
function _lsSet(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, v); return true; } catch (_) { return false; } }

// ── session state (memory only) ──
let _seq = 0;            // load sequence: an older answer never paints over a newer week
let _state = 'loading';  // 'loading' | 'ok' | 'empty' | 'err'
let _sat = null;         // the Saturday on screen
let _board = null;       // the last board that ARRIVED for _sat (kept through a failed re-read: «ό,τι ήρθε μένει»)
let _m = null;           // WN5L.model(_board) of the last paint
let _okAt = null;        // when the board arrived (display only)
let _lastErr = null;     // the PlanError (or local error) of the last read
let _closed = null;      // the first writes_closed answer of the session (Ε-6; set by markClosed)
let _qAll = false;       // «Όλα N ▾» of the ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ band
let _installed = false, _bannerShown = false, _warned = false;
const _closedDays = new Set();   // days the USER folded; the board never folds a day itself (owner 12/10)
const _errLogged = new Set();    // shape lines already logged (one row per distinct line per session)

// ═══ Flag, opt-in (Ε-1: three states like WI_V2) ═══
// ?wn5= is read once at load and dropped from the address, so a copied link does not spread an opt-in.
(function _readOptInParam() {
  try {
    const m = /[?&]wn5=([01])(?:&|$)/.exec(String((typeof location !== 'undefined' && location.search) || ''));
    if (!m) return;
    _lsSet('tms_wn5', m[1]);
    const u = new URL(location.href);
    u.searchParams.delete('wn5');
    history.replaceState(history.state, '', u.pathname + u.search + u.hash);
  } catch (_) { /* no opt-in: the old board, as today */ }
})();

function _flagRaw() { return typeof FEATURES !== 'undefined' && FEATURES ? FEATURES.WN_V5 : undefined; }
function _user() { try { return (typeof user !== 'undefined' && user && user.username) || ''; } catch (_) { return ''; } }
function _pilot() { try { return typeof WN_V5_USERS !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(WN_V5_USERS) ? WN_V5_USERS : []; } catch (_) { return []; } }
function _decide() {
  const lg = typeof WI4 !== 'undefined' ? WI4 : null;
  if (!lg) return 'old';
  const raw = _flagRaw();
  // Unknown = closed (principle 5); one warning names the bad value.
  if (!_warned && lg.normFlag(raw) !== raw) { _warned = true; try { console.warn('[weekly natl v5] FEATURES.WN_V5 =', raw, "→ read as 'off'"); } catch (_) {} }
  // The same three-state rule as Weekly International (core/wi4-logic.js v2Decide): 'off' wins over every opt-in.
  return lg.v2Decide({ flag: raw, pilot: _pilot(), user: _user(), optIn: _ls('tms_wn5') }) === 'v4' ? 'v5' : 'old';
}
function active() {
  try {
    if (WN5._broken === true) return false;
    if (typeof currentPage === 'undefined' || currentPage !== 'weekly_natl') return false;
    return _decide() === 'v5';
  } catch (_) { return false; }
}
function _switch(v) {
  _lsSet('tms_wn5', v === '1' ? '1' : '0');
  if (v !== '1') _cleanup();
  if (typeof window.renderWeeklyNatl === 'function') window.renderWeeklyNatl();
}

// ═══ Week ═══
// /plan/board wants the Saturday of the TMS week (Sat–Fri, core/tms-week.js); the Worker refuses anything else.
function weekParam(week, year) {
  if (typeof TmsWeek === 'undefined') throw new Error('TmsWeek missing (core/tms-week.js)');
  return TmsWeek.startOfDate(TmsWeek.start(Number(week), year));
}
function _week(n) {
  const v = Number(n);
  if (!Number.isInteger(v) || !window.WNATL) return;
  window.WNATL.week = v;
  window.renderWeeklyNatl();
}
function _onWeekChange() { _closedDays.clear(); _qAll = false; }

// ═══ Load ═══
async function render() {
  const seq = ++_seq;
  let week;
  try { week = weekParam(window.WNATL.week); } catch (e) { _fail(e); return _fallback(); }
  if (week !== _sat) { _board = null; _m = null; _okAt = null; _onWeekChange(); }
  _sat = week; _state = 'loading'; _lastErr = null;
  if (!_board && !paint()) return _fallback();
  let board = null, err = null;
  try { board = await planFetch('GET', '/plan/board?week=' + week); } catch (e) { err = e; }
  if (seq !== _seq || !active()) return;               // a newer render, or another page, owns the screen now
  if (err && err._sessionGone) return;                  // the login page is on its way; nothing to draw
  if (!err && (!board || typeof board !== 'object' || board.week !== week)) {
    err = { kind: 'client', message: 'Η απάντηση του πίνακα ήταν για άλλη εβδομάδα (' + String(board && board.week) + ') — ενημέρωσε τον Δημήτρη' };
    _logErr(new Error(err.message), 'weekly natl v5: board week');
  }
  if (err) { _state = 'err'; _lastErr = err; }
  else { _board = board; _okAt = new Date(); _state = _isEmpty(board) ? 'empty' : 'ok'; }
  if (!paint()) return _fallback();
}
// Empty = the three lists that make rows came back empty (a malformed list is not «empty»: WN5L.model refuses it).
function _isEmpty(b) {
  const n = (k) => (Array.isArray(b[k]) ? b[k].length : 1);
  return n('cycles') === 0 && n('waiting') === 0 && n('hub') === 0;
}
// reason names the caller (a write, the user's «Ανανέωση», a reuse check) for the trace; the read is the same.
async function reload(reason) {
  void reason;
  await render();
  return _state === 'ok' || _state === 'empty' ? _m : null;
}
// request_reused (F2 note 1): the first send WAS saved but no ids came back — read the board again and find it.
// pred receives the WHOLE re-read board JSON ({week, cycles, waiting, hub, notices}) and returns the found
// object or null: the callers (T17, T19, T20, T23, T25) know where their record lives; findAfterReuse((b) => b)
// is the one way to get a fresh board snapshot when a form, sheet or card opens.
async function findAfterReuse(pred) {
  await reload('reuse');

  return pred(_board) || null;
}
function snapshot() {
  return { state: _state, week: _sat, rows: document.querySelectorAll('#content .wn5 .wn5-row').length,
    writesClosed: !!_closed, lastErr: _lastErr ? String(_lastErr.message) : null };
}
function markClosed(err) { _closed = { message: err && err.message ? String(err.message) : '' }; }
function _fallback() {
  try { if (typeof window.renderWeeklyNatl === 'function') return window.renderWeeklyNatl(); }
  catch (e) { _logErr(e, 'weekly natl v5: fallback to the old board'); }
}

// ═══ paint() ═══
function paint() {
  try { _paint(); return true; } catch (e) { _fail(e); return false; }
}
function _fail(e) {
  WN5._broken = true;   // sticky for the session
  try { _cleanup(); } catch (_) {}

  try { console.error('[weekly natl v5] paint failed:', e); } catch (_) {}
  if (_bannerShown) return;

  // The old board repaints #content after its load, so the banner sits just ABOVE #content, once, and leaves with
  // the page (the router has no leave hook).
  try {

    b.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
    b.textContent = 'Η νέα προβολή απέτυχε — δείχνουμε την παλιά μέχρι την επόμενη φόρτωση';
    content.parentNode.insertBefore(b, content);
    const gone = () => {
      if (!b.isConnected) return;
      if (typeof currentPage !== 'undefined' && currentPage !== 'weekly_natl') { b.remove(); return; }
      setTimeout(gone, 3000);

    setTimeout(gone, 3000);

}
function _paint() {
  const content = document.getElementById('content');
  if (!content) throw new Error('#content missing');
  const lg = L();
  if (!lg) throw new Error('WN5L missing (core/wn5-logic.js)');
  // A board that cannot be drawn (WN5L.ShapeError) throws here: the old board, loudly — never half a v5 board.
  // The 072 board names no hub stop: the catalogue's hub id (PlanIds.hub(), T12) when it is loaded, else WN5L reads
  // it from base facts (Ε-27). A hub[] row is at Veroia either way (071 at_hub). Neither → WN5L.HUB_UNKNOWN in
  // m.errors, which _shapeHTML shows and _logShape logs once (Ε-44): never Veroia as an ordinary stop in silence.

function _today() { return typeof localToday === 'function' ? localToday() : ''; }
// The day words come from ONE place (core/wi4-logic.js dayLabel): «Τρί 13/10» / «Τρί».
const _dl = (d) => (d && typeof WI4 !== 'undefined' ? WI4.dayLabel(d) : d || '—');

// ═══ Root, bar, states ═══
function _rootHTML() {

  // the counters say «…» / «—» (known = false), never «καμία φόρτωση» or 0 (Δ12 πλακ. 2–3).
  const m = _m || L().model({ week: _sat, cycles: [], waiting: [], hub: [], notices: [] }, { today: _today() });
  const known = !!_m;
  return `<div class="wi4 wn5" data-week="${_esc(_sat)}" data-state="${_esc(_state)}">`
    + _barHTML() + _errHTML() + (known ? _shapeHTML(m) : '') + _boardHTML(m, known) + '</div>';
}
function _barHTML() {
  const w = Number(window.WNATL && window.WNATL.week);
  const upd = _state === 'loading' ? 'Διαβάζει…' : _okAt ? 'Ενημερώθηκε ' + _hhmm(_okAt) : '—';
  return '<div class="wi4-bar wn5-bar"><div class="wi4-bar-l"><span class="wi4-title">Εβδομαδιαίο Εθνικών</span>'
    + `<span class="wi4-range" title="${_esc(_rangeText(_sat))}">${_esc(_rangeText(_sat))}</span>`
    + `<button type="button" class="wn5-upd" data-act="reload" title="Ανανέωση" onclick="WN5.reload('user')">↻ ${_esc(upd)}</button></div>`
    + `<nav class="wi4-tabs" aria-label="Εβδομάδες">${_tabsHTML(w)}</nav>`

    + '<button type="button" class="wi4-btn sm" title="Το παλιό Εβδομαδιαίο Εθνικών" onclick="WN5._switch(\'0\')">Παλιά προβολή</button></div></div>';

function _tabsHTML(w) {

  for (let d = -3; d <= 3; d++) {

  }
  h += `<button type="button" class="wi4-tab" aria-label="Επόμενη εβδομάδα" onclick="WN5._week(${w + 1})">›</button>`;

// «10–16 Οκτωβρίου», or «26 Σεπτεμβρίου – 2 Οκτωβρίου» across a month.

  return a.getUTCMonth() === b.getUTCMonth()

function _hhmm(d) { return `${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`; }

    + `<span class="wn5-strip-sub">${_board ? 'Ό,τι ήρθε πριν μένει στην οθόνη' : 'Η εβδομάδα δεν διαβάστηκε — δεν σημαίνει ότι είναι άδεια'}${last}</span>`

}

// ═══ Board body ═══
function _boardHTML(m, known) {
  const no = { n: 0 };
  const cycles = m.days.flatMap((d) => d.rows).filter((r) => r.kind === 'cycle');
  return _qbandHTML(m, known)
    + (known && typeof WN5Hub !== 'undefined' && typeof WN5Hub.shelfHTML === 'function' ? WN5Hub.shelfHTML(m) : '')
    + _colsHTML(cycles, known)

}
function _qbandHTML(m, known) {
  if (!known) return `<div class="wi4-q wn5-q"><div class="wi4-q-hd"><span>ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ · ${_state === 'loading' ? '…' : '—'}</span></div></div>`;
  const q = m.queue;
  if (!q.length) return '<div class="wi4-q wn5-q"><div class="wi4-q-hd"><span>ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ · <span class="wn5-lc">κανένα</span></span></div></div>';

  return `<div class="wi4-q wn5-q"><div class="wi4-q-hd"><span>ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ · ${q.length}</span><span class="wi4-q-n">${_esc(_qSub(q, m.today))}</span></div>`

// «2 VS σήμερα · 1 Παρ»: how many of the queue fall on each day.
function _qSub(q, today) {
  const by = new Map();

function _qcardHTML(it, today) {

    + `<span class="wi4-qcard-t"><span class="wi4-l1" title="${_esc(it.title)}">${_esc(it.title)}</span><span class="wi4-l2">${_esc(_pal(it.pallets))} · ${why}</span></span>`

// Column heads of Figma H1 2120:7738: «ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» alone (owner 25/10), no Veroia-time column anywhere.
function _colsHTML(cycles, known) {
  const kn = cycles.filter((r) => r.kath).length;
  const an = cycles.filter((r) => r.anod && !r.anod.gap).length;
  const cnt = (n) => (known ? ` · ${n} ${n === 1 ? 'κύκλος' : 'κύκλοι'}` : '');
  return '<div class="wn5-cols" role="row">'
    + '<span class="wn5-c-idx"></span><span class="wn5-c-kd">ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ</span><span class="wn5-c-kfl">ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ</span>'
    + `<span class="wn5-c-kto">ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΗ<span class="wn5-h-sub">${cnt(kn)}${known ? ' · ανά ημέρα φόρτωσης Βέροιας' : ''}</span></span>`
    + '<span class="wn5-c-kpal">ΠΑΛ.</span><span class="wn5-c-asg wn5-h-asg">ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ</span>'
    + `<span class="wn5-c-ad">ΑΝΟΔΟΣ</span><span class="wn5-c-afl">ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ<span class="wn5-h-sub">${cnt(an)}</span></span>`
    + '<span class="wn5-c-ato">ΠΡΟΣ</span><span class="wn5-c-apal">ΠΑΛ.</span></div>';

function _dayHTML(d, m, known, no) {
  const today = d.date === m.today;
  const empty = known && d.empty;
  const fold = known && !empty;
  const closed = fold && _closedDays.has(d.date);
  const [name, date] = d.head.split(' ');
  const tail = (today ? '<span class="wi4-today"> · σήμερα</span>' : '')
    + (!known ? `<span class="wn5-dayx"> · ${_state === 'loading' ? '…' : '—'}</span>` : empty ? '<span class="wn5-dayx"> · καμία φόρτωση</span>' : '');
  const head = `<div class="wi4-dayh wn5-dayh"${fold ? ` role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="${!closed}" onclick="WN5._dayTog('${d.date}')"` : ''}>`
    + (fold ? `<span class="wi4-chev">${CHEV}</span>` : '<span class="wi4-dayh-sp"></span>')
    + `<span class="wi4-dayn">${_esc(name)} <span class="wi4-dayd">${_esc(date)}</span></span>${tail}</div>`;
  const body = fold ? `<div class="wi4-day-body">${d.rows.map((r) => _rowHTML(r, m, no)).join('')}</div>` : '';
  return `<section class="wi4-day wn5-day${today ? ' today' : ''}${empty ? ' empty' : ''}${closed ? ' closed' : ''}" data-date="${d.date}">${head}${body}</section>`;
}
// Days are folded only by the user's click (owner 12/10), and stay as the user left them until the week changes.
function _dayTog(date) {
  if (!DAY_RE.test(String(date || ''))) return;
  const sec = document.querySelector(`#content .wn5 .wn5-day[data-date="${date}"]`);
  if (!sec || sec.classList.contains('empty')) return;
  if (_closedDays.has(date)) _closedDays.delete(date); else _closedDays.add(date);
  const closed = _closedDays.has(date);
  sec.classList.toggle('closed', closed);

  if (h) h.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!closed));

// ═══ Rows ═══
// A window the board did not send (hub[] of 072, Ε-26) is «—», never «null–null» and never a guess.
const _win = (f, t) => (f && t ? `${_esc(f)}–${_esc(t)}` : '—');
// «ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» whose destination / windows the 072 board does not send (hub[], Ε-26): said under the row, never
// hidden and never guessed (principle 1); the assignment window says the same and keeps «Ένωση» closed (T12).
function _missHTML(r) {
  return `<div class="wn5-sub wn5-miss" data-qi="${_esc(r.key)}" data-key="miss:${_esc(r.key)}"><span class="wn5-c-idx"></span><span class="wn5-sub-t">${_esc(r.miss)}</span></div>`;
}
function _rowHTML(r, m, no) {
  const n = r.kind === 'cycle' ? ++no.n : null;
  const rail = r.rail === 'red' ? ' wi4-r-red' : r.late ? ' wi4-r-amb' : '';
  const ids = r.rtId != null ? ` data-rt="${_id(r.rtId)}"` : ` data-piece="${_id(r.pieceIds[0])}"`;
  let h = `<div class="wn5-row${rail}" data-key="${_esc(r.key)}" data-qi="${_esc(r.key)}"${ids}>`
    + `<div class="wn5-c-idx"><span class="wi4-no">${n == null ? '' : n}</span>`
    + (r.rtId != null ? `<button type="button" class="wi4-plane" title="Ενέργειες σειράς" aria-haspopup="menu" onclick="WN5.rowMenu(event, ${_id(r.rtId)})">${PLANE}</button>` : '')
    + '</div>'
    + _kathHTML(r, m)
    + `<div class="wn5-asg">${r.tiles.map((t) => _boxHTML(t)).join('')}</div>`
    + _anodHTML(r, m)
    + '</div>';
  for (const lm of r.local) h += _localHTML(r, lm);
  if (r.miss) h += _missHTML(r);
  return h;
}
function _kathHTML(r, m) {
  const s = r.kath;
  if (!s) return r.kind === 'cycle' ? '<div class="wn5-kspan"><span class="wn5-gapbox">Χωρίς κάθοδο</span></div>' : '<div class="wn5-kspan"><span class="wn5-none">—</span></div>';
  const toDay = s.toDay && s.toDay !== s.day ? `<span class="wn5-dc2">→ ${_esc(_dl(s.toDay))}</span>` : '';
  return `<div class="wn5-kd"><span class="wi4-dc ${_chipCls(s.day, m.today)}">${_esc(_dl(s.day))}</span>${toDay}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-fl">${s.veroia ? `<span class="wn5-vh">Βέροια</span><span class="wn5-vtime">${_win(s.veroia.from, s.veroia.to)}</span>` : ''}${_ptsHTML(s.from)}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-kto">${_ptsHTML(s.to)}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-kpal">${_palHTML(s)}</div>`;
}
function _anodHTML(r, m) {
  const s = r.anod;
  if (!s) return '<div class="wn5-aspan"><span class="wn5-none">—</span></div>';
  if (s.gap) return `<div class="wn5-aspan"><span class="wn5-gapbox">${_esc(s.gap.text)}</span></div>`;
  const n = s.from.length;
  const end = r.end ? `<span class="wn5-end"><span class="wi4-l1">Βέροια · τέλος κύκλου</span><span class="wi4-l2">ως ${_esc(_dow(L().athensDay(r.end.by)))} ${_esc(L().athensTime(r.end.by))}</span></span>` : '';
  return `<div class="wn5-ad"><span class="wi4-dc ${_chipCls(s.day, m.today)}">${_esc(_dl(s.day))}</span><span class="wn5-dc2">${n} ${n === 1 ? 'φορτίο' : 'φορτία'}</span></div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-afl">${_ptsHTML(s.from)}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-ato">${_ptsHTML(s.to)}${end}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-apal">${_palHTML(s)}</div>`;
}
function _ptsHTML(pts) {
  if (!pts.length) return '';
  const one = pts.length === 1;
  const rest = pts.slice(VISIBLE_POINTS);
  const more = rest.length
    ? `<span class="wi4-more" title="${_esc(rest.map((p) => `${p.n}. ${p.name} · ${p.from && p.to ? p.from + '–' + p.to : '—'} · ${_pal(p.pallets)}`).join('\n'))}"><b>+${rest.length}</b></span>`
    : '';
  return `<span class="wi4-pts wn5-pts">${pts.slice(0, VISIBLE_POINTS).map((p) => _ptHTML(p, one)).join('')}${more}</span>`;
}
function _ptHTML(p, one) {
  return `<span class="wi4-pt wn5-pt${p.late ? ' wn5-late' : ''}" data-stop="${_id(p.stopId)}">`
    + (one ? '' : `<span class="wi4-pt-n">${p.n}</span>`)
    + `<span class="wi4-l1">${_esc(p.name)}${p.city ? `<span class="wn5-city"> · ${_esc(p.city)}</span>` : ''}</span>`
    + `<span class="wi4-l2${p.late ? ' wi4-t-amb' : ''}">${_win(p.from, p.to)} · ${_esc(_pal(p.pallets))}</span></span>`;
}
function _palHTML(s) {
  return `<span class="wi4-pal${s.over ? ' over' : ''}"${s.over ? ` title="υπέρβαση ${_esc(_pal(s.over))}"` : ''}>${_esc(String(s.pallets).replace('.', ','))}</span>`;
}
function _boxHTML(t) {
  // «ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» opens the assignment window (wired by the actions file, Task T12).
  if (t.type === 'un') return '<button type="button" class="wi4-box un" data-act="assign"><span class="wi4-l1">ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ</span></button>';
  // The tile is 28px high: a long name is cut by the wi4 rule with a visible «…» and stays whole in title.
  return `<span class="wi4-box ${t.type}"><span class="wi4-l1${t.type === 'own' ? ' wi4-plate' : ''}" title="${_esc(t.line1)}">${_esc(t.line1)}</span>`
    + `<span class="wi4-l2${t.missing ? ' wn5-missing' : ''}" title="${_esc(t.line2)}">${_esc(t.line2)}</span></span>`;
}
// «↳ Φόρτωση με τοπικό» under its row (Figma 2011:7745 row 3): who, when, for which stop.
function _localHTML(r, lm) {
  const time = [lm.time_from, lm.time_to].filter(Boolean).map((t) => String(t).slice(0, 5)).join('–');
  return `<div class="wn5-sub" data-qi="${_esc(r.key)}" data-key="local:${_id(lm.local_move_id)}" data-stop="${_id(lm.stopId)}">`
    + '<span class="wn5-c-idx"></span>'
    + `<span class="wn5-sub-t">↳ <b>Φόρτωση με τοπικό</b> · ${_esc(lm.driver || 'χωρίς οδηγό')} · ${_esc(_dl(lm.move_date))}${time ? ' ' + _esc(time) : ''}`
    + `${lm.stopName ? ` · για ${_esc(lm.stopName)}${lm.stopN ? ` (στάση ${lm.stopN})` : ''}` : ''}</span></div>`;
}
// ═══ end of rows ═══

// ═══ ✈ row menu (Figma 2011:8858) ═══
// Each Task appends its line to WN5.MENU_ITEMS; `order` keeps the Figma order whatever the order of the Tasks:
// 10 Άνοιγμα παραγγελιών · 20 Ανάθεση · 30 Νέα παραγγελία · 40 Φόρτωση με τοπικό · 50 Σπάσιμο · 60 Εκτύπωση ·
// 70 Αντιγραφή πινακίδων · 90 Καθαρισμός (danger, after a separator).
function rowMenu(ev, rtId) {
  try { if (ev && ev.stopPropagation) ev.stopPropagation(); } catch (_) {}
  _closeMenu();
  if (!active() || !ID_RE.test(String(rtId))) return;
  const row = _rowOf(rtId);
  if (!row) return;
  const items = WN5.MENU_ITEMS.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0));
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.id = 'wn5-menu';
  el.className = 'wn5-menu';
  el.setAttribute('role', 'menu');               // core/ui.js: ←/→ never change the week under an open menu
  el.setAttribute('data-wn5-overlay', 'menu');
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="wn5-m-hd"><span class="wi4-l1">${_esc(_menuTitle(row))}</span><span class="wi4-l2">${_esc(_menuSub(row))}</span></div>`
    + items.map((it) => (it.danger ? '<div class="wn5-m-sep" role="separator"></div>' : '') + _menuItemHTML(it, rtId)).join('');
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-item]');
    if (!b) return;
    const id = b.getAttribute('data-item');
    if (b.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'menu') { _subToggle(el, id); return; }   // a «›» line opens its submenu
    const it = _menuFind(items, id);
    _closeMenu();
    if (it && typeof it.run === 'function') { try { it.run(Number(rtId), e); } catch (err) { _logErr(err, 'weekly natl v5: menu ' + it.id); } }
  });
  // → opens the submenu of a «›» line, ← closes it and goes back to its line (Figma 2011:8858). Stopped here, so the
  // week never moves under an open menu (core/ui.js also checks role=menu).
  el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-item]') : null;
    if (!b) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && b.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'menu') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); _subToggle(el, b.getAttribute('data-item'), true); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && b.closest('[data-sub]')) {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const id = b.closest('[data-sub]').getAttribute('data-sub');
      _subToggle(el, id, false);
      const pb = el.querySelector(`[data-item="${id}"]`);
      if (pb) pb.focus();
    }
  });
  const a = ev && ev.currentTarget && ev.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect ? ev.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect() : { left: 120, bottom: 120 };
  el.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(a.left, window.innerWidth - el.offsetWidth - 8)) + 'px';
  el.style.top = Math.max(8, Math.min(a.bottom + 4, window.innerHeight - el.offsetHeight - 8)) + 'px';
  const first = el.querySelector('[role="menuitem"]');
  if (first) first.focus();
}
// One line per Figma item (2011:8858, 8 lines under the head): a line with `children` is «label ›» and its submenu (role=menu,
// hidden until opened), so the same label is never drawn twice; `count` is the number on the right.
function _menuItemHTML(it, rtId) {
  let n = null;
  if (typeof it.count === 'function') { try { n = it.count(rtId); } catch (err) { _logErr(err, 'weekly natl v5: menu count ' + it.id); } }
  const kids = Array.isArray(it.children) && it.children.length > 0;
  const tail = (it.sub ? `<span class="wi4-l2">${_esc(it.sub)}</span>` : '') + (Number.isFinite(n) ? `<span class="wn5-m-n">${n}</span>` : '')
    + (kids ? '<span class="wn5-m-ar" aria-hidden="true">›</span>' : '');
  let h = `<button type="button" role="menuitem" class="wn5-m-i${it.danger ? ' danger' : ''}" data-item="${_esc(it.id)}"${kids ? ' aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false"' : ''}>`
    + `<span class="wi4-l1">${_esc(it.label)}</span>${tail}</button>`;
  if (kids) {
    h += `<div class="wn5-m-sub" role="menu" data-sub="${_esc(it.id)}" hidden>`
      + it.children.map((c) => `<button type="button" role="menuitem" class="wn5-m-i" data-item="${_esc(c.id)}"><span class="wi4-l1">${_esc(c.label)}</span></button>`).join('')
      + '</div>';
  }
  return h;
}
function _menuFind(items, id) {
  for (const it of items) {
    if (it.id === id) return it;
    for (const c of it.children || []) if (c.id === id) return c;
  }
  return null;
}
// Open (true) / close (false) / toggle one submenu; any other open one closes. The flyout sits beside its line.
function _subToggle(menu, id, open) {
  const sub = menu.querySelector(`[data-sub="${id}"]`);
  const btn = menu.querySelector(`[data-item="${id}"]`);
  if (!sub || !btn) return;
  const on = open === undefined ? sub.hidden : open;
  for (const o of menu.querySelectorAll('[data-sub]')) {
    if (o === sub) continue;
    o.hidden = true;
    const ob = menu.querySelector(`[data-item="${o.getAttribute('data-sub')}"]`);
    if (ob) ob.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  }
  sub.hidden = !on;
  btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(on));
  if (on) {
    sub.style.top = btn.offsetTop + 'px';
    const f = sub.querySelector('[role="menuitem"]');
    if (f) f.focus();
  }
}
// The labels of the ✈ menu of a row, in order, «›» lines with their children — what the rigs hold to Figma.
function _menuItems(rtId) {
  return WN5.MENU_ITEMS.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0))
    .map((it) => ({ id: it.id, label: it.label, children: (it.children || []).map((c) => c.label) }));
}
function _menuTitle(row) {
  const c = _cycleOf(row.rtId);
  const who = (c && (c.truck || c.partner)) || (c && c.code) || '';
  return who + (row.cycleNo ? ` · κύκλος ${row.cycleNo.m > 1 ? `${row.cycleNo.n}/${row.cycleNo.m}` : '1'}` : '');
}
function _menuSub(row) {
  const s = row.kath || row.anod;
  if (!s || !s.day) return '';
  return _dl(s.day) + (row.kath && row.kath.veroia ? ` · Βέροια ${row.kath.veroia.from}–${row.kath.veroia.to}` : '');
}
function _closeMenu() { const m = document.getElementById('wn5-menu'); if (m) m.remove(); }
// Ε-22: only the cycle's truck and trailer — nothing of the hub, nothing of a VS (Veroia is never shown to a
// client). A partner's cycle has no plates on the board: copyPlates says so instead of copying nothing.
function copyPlatesOf(rtId) {
  const c = _cycleOf(rtId);
  const text = c && typeof platesText === 'function' ? platesText(c.truck, c.trailer, null) : '';
  return typeof copyPlates === 'function' ? copyPlates(text) : false;
}

// ═══ Session hooks (installed once, at the first paint; every one starts with the v5 guard) ═══
function _install() {
  if (_installed) return;
  _installed = true;
  const content = document.getElementById('content');
  // The router has no leave hook (as for v4): a page change replaces #content's children.
  if (content && typeof MutationObserver === 'function') {
    new MutationObserver(() => { if (!content.querySelector('.wn5')) _cleanup(); }).observe(content, { childList: true });
  }
  // A click outside the open ✈ menu closes it (capture: before any other handler acts on the click).
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!document.getElementById('wn5-menu')) return;
    if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#wn5-menu, .wi4-plane')) return;
    _closeMenu();
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', _onKey, true);
}
function _onKey(e) {
  if (!active() || !document.querySelector('#content .wn5')) return;
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.getElementById('wn5-menu')) { _closeMenu(); e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }
}
function _cleanup() {
  try { document.body.classList.remove('wn5-on'); } catch (_) {}
  // Every body-level overlay of v5 carries data-wn5-overlay: one rule removes them all when the board leaves.
  try { document.querySelectorAll('body > [data-wn5-overlay]').forEach((el) => el.remove()); } catch (_) {}
}

// ═══ Exports ═══
const WN5 = {
  _broken: false,
  active,
  render,
  paint,
  reload,
  findAfterReuse,
  snapshot,
  markClosed,
  weekParam,
  rowMenu,
  copyPlates: copyPlatesOf,
  MENU_ITEMS: [{ id: 'plates', order: 70, label: 'Αντιγραφή πινακίδων', run: (rtId) => copyPlatesOf(rtId) }],
  // The board HTML of a model, for tests/wn5-board-html.test.js (pure: model in, string out).
  _html: (m) => _boardHTML(m, true),
  _menuItems,
  _dayTog,
  _qMore,
  _week,
  _switch,
};
window.WN5 = WN5;
})();
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Οι κανόνες του board στο μπλοκ `wn5` του `assets/style.css`**

Edit (πάνω από το σημάδι του τέλους του μπλοκ):
- old: `/* ── wn5 end ── */`
- new:
```css
/* Board grid (Figma H1 2120:7738 at 1920: one 1803px row from x=88). Twelve tracks:
   # · gap · ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ day · ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ · ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΗ · ΠΑΛ. · ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ · gap · ΑΝΟΔΟΣ day · ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ · ΠΡΟΣ · ΠΑΛ.
   ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ is 266px and no Veroia-time column exists (owner 25/10: +16px taken from the ΑΝΟΔΟΣ points), so ΑΝΟΔΟΣ
   starts 266 + 16 = 282px after ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ. The two point columns share what is left (403.5px each at 1920 = two
   ~178px stops + «+N»; 165px at 1440 = one stop + «+N»). Cells shrink, never overlap, and wrap names (no cut). */
.wn5-cols, .wn5-row, .wn5-sub {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:64px 8px 78px 169px minmax(0,1fr) 86px 266px 16px 78px minmax(0,1fr) 154px 77px; align-items:center; }
.wn5 .wn5-c-idx { grid-column:1; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-kd, .wn5-kd) { grid-column:3; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-kfl, .wn5-fl) { grid-column:4; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-kto, .wn5-kto) { grid-column:5; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-kpal, .wn5-kpal) { grid-column:6; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-asg, .wn5-asg) { grid-column:7; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-ad, .wn5-ad) { grid-column:9; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-afl, .wn5-afl) { grid-column:10; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-ato, .wn5-ato) { grid-column:11; }
.wn5 :is(.wn5-c-apal, .wn5-apal) { grid-column:12; }
.wn5 .wn5-kspan { grid-column:3 / 7; }
.wn5 .wn5-aspan { grid-column:9 / 13; }
.wn5-cols { position:sticky; top:-8px; z-index:30; min-height:32px; padding:4px 1px 8px; box-sizing:border-box; background:var(--surface-page);
  font-size:10px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.5px; line-height:1.2; color:var(--wi4-grey-2); align-items:end; }
.wn5-cols > span { min-width:0; padding:0 9px; box-sizing:border-box; }
.wn5-cols > .wn5-h-asg { padding-left:9px; }
.wn5-h-sub { font-weight:400; letter-spacing:0; }
.wn5-row { position:relative; min-height:36px; padding:4px 0; box-sizing:border-box; border-top:1px solid var(--wi4-line); }
.wn5 .wi4-day-body > :first-child { border-top:0; }
.wn5-row > div, .wn5-sub > span { min-width:0; padding:0 9px; box-sizing:border-box; }
.wn5-row > .wn5-asg { padding:0; display:flex; gap:4px; }
.wn5 .wn5-asg .wi4-box { flex:1 1 0; max-width:none; }
.wn5 .wn5-c-idx { align-self:stretch; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px; padding:0 6px 0 12px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:var(--wi4-grey-1); }
.wn5-row > .wn5-c-idx { background:var(--wi4-chip); }
.wn5 .wi4-day.today .wn5-row > .wn5-c-idx { background:var(--wi4-today-hover); }
.wn5 .wn5-kd, .wn5 .wn5-ad { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:2px; }
.wn5-dc2 { font-size:10px; color:var(--wi4-grey-2); white-space:nowrap; }
/* ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ: «Βέροια» and, under it, its loading window — on every row that loads there (owner 25/10). */
.wn5 .wn5-fl { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; }
.wn5-vh { display:block; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:var(--wi4-ink); }
.wn5-vtime { display:block; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--wi4-grey-2); }
/* At 1920 two stops fit side by side; narrower (1440: 147px) they wrap to a second line instead of spilling. */
.wn5 .wn5-pts { flex-wrap:wrap; row-gap:4px; }
/* Stops and the end of the cycle WRAP (DESIGN.md #6: a place is never cut). The wi4 block cuts .wi4-l1/.wi4-l2 with a visible «…»
   (its one truncation rule); here that rule stays only on the 28px vehicle tile and the queue cards, whose full text is in title. */
.wn5 :is(.wn5-pts, .wn5-end) :is(.wi4-l1, .wi4-l2) { white-space:normal; overflow:visible; text-overflow:clip; overflow-wrap:break-word; }
/* 164px: two stops + the 34px «+N» fit the 386px of a point column at 1920 (Figma: stops 178px apart, gap included). */
.wn5 .wn5-pt { flex:0 1 164px; }
.wn5-city { font-weight:400; color:var(--wi4-grey-2); }
.wn5 .wn5-late .wi4-l2 { color:var(--wi4-amber); }
.wn5 .wn5-missing { color:var(--wi4-amber-ink); }
.wn5-none { color:var(--wi4-grey-3); }
.wn5-gapbox { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:24px; padding:2px 10px; box-sizing:border-box; border:1px dashed var(--wi4-slot);
  border-radius:5px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--wi4-grey-2); }
.wn5-end { display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
/* «↳ Φόρτωση με τοπικό» (Figma row 3): a 28px sub-row, text from the ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ day column to the end. */
.wn5-sub { min-height:28px; border-top:1px solid var(--wi4-line); }
.wn5-sub > .wn5-c-idx { background:var(--wi4-today-hover); }
.wn5-sub-t { grid-column:3 / -1; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--wi4-grey-1); }
.wn5-sub-t b { font-weight:600; color:var(--wi4-grey-1); }
.wn5-qcards { display:flex; gap:8px; flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0; }
/* Narrower than the Figma 1920 frame (1440 with the sidebar open): the fixed tracks give way so the point columns keep
   one whole stop + «+N» (ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ stays 266px, owner 25/10); the long column notes go, the column names stay. */
@media (max-width:1600px) {
  .wn5-cols, .wn5-row, .wn5-sub { grid-template-columns:48px 6px 70px 120px minmax(0,1fr) 50px 266px 16px 70px minmax(0,1fr) 120px 50px; }
  .wn5-h-sub { display:none; }
}
/* ✈ menu (Figma 2011:8858): 300px, white, the board's line colour; it lives on <body>, outside .wn5. */

.wn5-m-i.danger > .wi4-l1 { color:var(--wi4-red); }
.wn5-m-sep { height:1px; margin:4px 0; background:var(--wi4-line); }
.wn5-m-n { margin-left:auto; font-weight:600; color:var(--wi4-grey-1); }
.wn5-m-ar { margin-left:auto; color:var(--wi4-grey-1); }
.wn5-m-i > .wi4-l2 + .wn5-m-ar, .wn5-m-i > .wi4-l2 + .wn5-m-n { margin-left:6px; }
.wn5-m-i[aria-expanded="true"] { background:var(--wi4-sel); }
/* the submenu of a «›» line (Figma 2011:8858, 200px) opens beside it */
.wn5-m-sub { position:absolute; left:calc(100% - 4px); width:200px; padding:4px 0; background:var(--surface-card);

/* ── wn5 end ── */
```

```js
// node --test tests/wn5-dim.test.js
// National v5 F4α Task T6 — executed = 40% by DAY (owner 21–22/10, Figma 2035:7735, rule 2036:7735). The screen
// follows ONLY the base's flags (v_rt_stop_state.dim / side_dim / cycle_dim, copied by WN5L): a past stop the base
// calls not dim stays bold, a future one it calls dim dims — no date is compared on screen (S-89). On top, the
// owner's «ποτέ σβηστό ό,τι θέλει δουλειά»: a load waiting for a vehicle, a cycle without one and a late stop never
// dim, even when a corrupt answer says so. The REAL wi4-logic, wn5-logic and weekly_natl_v5 run in a vm.
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = process.env.TMS_ROOT ? path.resolve(process.env.TMS_ROOT) : path.join(__dirname, '..');
const FIX = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures/wn5-week.json'), 'utf8'));
const clone = (o) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
const cyc = (b, id) => b.cycles.find((c) => c.rt_id === id);
const stop = (b, rt, id) => cyc(b, rt).stops.find((s) => s.stop_id === id);
function html(board) {
  const store = new Map();
  const ctx = { console: { log() {}, warn() {}, error() {} }, location: { search: '', href: 'https://x/app.html' }, history: { state: null, replaceState() {} },
    localStorage: { getItem: (k) => (store.has(k) ? store.get(k) : null), setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)), removeItem: (k) => store.delete(k) },
    document: { querySelector: () => null, querySelectorAll: () => [], getElementById: () => null } };
  ctx.window = ctx;
  vm.createContext(ctx);
  for (const f of ['core/wi4-logic.js', 'core/wn5-logic.js', 'modules/weekly_natl_v5.js']) vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), 'utf8'), ctx, { filename: f });
  assert.ok(ctx.WN5 && typeof ctx.WN5._html === 'function', 'renderer _html not found in modules/weekly_natl_v5.js (WN5._html)');
  return ctx.WN5._html(ctx.WN5L.model(board, { today: '2026-10-13' }));
}
const byKey = (h) => new Map(h.split('<div class="wn5-row').slice(1).map((s) => '<div class="wn5-row' + s).map((r) => [(/data-key="([^"]+)"/.exec(r) || [])[1], r]));
const cell = (chunk, cls) => { const m = new RegExp(`<div class="${cls}">([\\s\\S]*?)</div>`).exec(chunk || ''); return m ? m[1] : ''; };

test('F4α-T6: dim class follows the server flags only (stop with past day and dim:false stays bold)', () => {
  const by = byKey(html(FIX));
  assert.match(by.get('rt:101'), /^<div class="wn5-row wn5-dim"/, 'row 1: the whole cycle is executed (cycle_dim)');
  const r102 = by.get('rt:102');
  assert.ok(!/^<div class="wn5-row[^"]*wn5-dim/.test(r102), 'row 102 is not wholly executed');
  assert.match(cell(r102, 'wn5-kd'), /wi4-dc past wn5-dim/, 'its Monday chip dims');
  assert.match(cell(r102, 'wn5-fl'), /<span class="wn5-vh wn5-dim">Βέροια<\/span><span class="wn5-vtime wn5-dim">16:00–18:00/, '«Βέροια» and its window dim');
  assert.ok(!/wn5-dim/.test(cell(r102, 'wn5-kto')), 'the Tuesday deliveries stay bold');
  const b = clone(FIX);
  stop(b, 102, 1101).dim = false;      // a past Veroia loading the base calls not dim
  stop(b, 105, 1403).dim = true;       // a future delivery the base calls dim
  const by2 = byKey(html(b));
  assert.ok(!/wn5-dim/.test(cell(by2.get('rt:102'), 'wn5-fl')) && !/wn5-dim/.test(cell(by2.get('rt:102'), 'wn5-kd')), 'a past stop with dim:false must stay bold');
  assert.match(cell(by2.get('rt:105'), 'wn5-kto'), /class="wi4-pt wn5-pt wn5-dim" data-stop="1403"/, 'a stop the base calls dim must dim');
});

test('F4α-T6: unassigned / late / VS without truck never get .wn5-dim even with dim:true in a corrupt fixture', () => {
  const b = clone(FIX);
  stop(b, 104, 1303).dim = true;                                                          // the late stop
  for (const s of cyc(b, 108).stops) { s.dim = true; s.side_dim = true; s.cycle_dim = true; }   // no vehicle
  const by = byKey(html(b));
  assert.match(by.get('rt:101'), /wn5-dim/, 'a legit executed row must still dim (the guard is not «never dim»)');
  assert.match(cell(by.get('rt:104'), 'wn5-kd'), /wn5-dim/, 'the Monday head of the partner row still dims');
  assert.ok(!/wn5-dim" data-stop="1303"/.test(by.get('rt:104')), 'the late stop dimmed');
  assert.ok(!/wn5-dim/.test(by.get('rt:108')), 'a cycle without a vehicle dimmed');
  for (const k of ['wait:4101', 'wait:4103', 'wait:4104', 'wait:4105']) assert.ok(!/wn5-dim/.test(by.get(k)), k + ' dimmed');
});
```

```js
// Figma 2035:7735 «εκτελεσμένα σβηστά ανά ημέρα», now = Tue 13/10 09:30: what the base flags is at 40%, nothing else.
SCN.dim = async (browser, origin) => {
  const scn = 'dim';
  const { page, S } = await openBoard(browser, origin, { board: fixture() });
  const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const op = (el) => (el ? Number(getComputedStyle(el).opacity) : null);
    const row = (k) => document.querySelector(`#content .wn5 .wn5-row[data-key="${k}"]`);
    const r = (k) => row(k) || document.createElement('div');
    const dimIn = (el) => (el ? el.querySelectorAll('.wn5-dim').length + (el.classList.contains('wn5-dim') ? 1 : 0) : -1);
    return {
      r101: { cls: r('rt:101').classList.contains('wn5-dim'), op: op(row('rt:101')) },
      heads: ['rt:102', 'rt:103', 'rt:104'].map((k) => ({ k, row: r(k).classList.contains('wn5-dim'),
        chip: op(r(k).querySelector('.wn5-kd .wi4-dc')), vh: op(r(k).querySelector('.wn5-vh')), vt: op(r(k).querySelector('.wn5-vtime')),
        tue: [...r(k).querySelectorAll('.wn5-kto .wn5-pt')].map(op) })),
      work: ['wait:4101', 'wait:4103', 'rt:108'].map((k) => ({ k, n: dimIn(row(k)) })),
      late: op(document.querySelector('#content .wn5 .wn5-pt[data-stop="1303"]')),
      future: dimIn(row('rt:105')) + dimIn(row('rt:106')) + dimIn(row('rt:107')),
    };
  });
  ok(scn, 'row 1 (RT-T101, Σάβ → Δευ, ended Δευ 22:00) dimmed whole, computed opacity 0.4', st.r101.cls && Math.abs(st.r101.op - 0.4) < 0.01, st.r101);
  ok(scn, 'rows 2–4: only the Monday head (chip, «Βέροια», its window) at 0.4, the row itself not', st.heads.every((h) => !h.row
    && [h.chip, h.vh, h.vt].every((o) => o !== null && Math.abs(o - 0.4) < 0.01)), st.heads);
  ok(scn, 'rows 2–4: the Tuesday deliveries stay bold (opacity 1)', st.heads.every((h) => h.tue.length > 0 && h.tue.every((o) => o === 1)), st.heads.map((h) => [h.k, h.tue]));
  ok(scn, 'ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ (VS-T118, VS-T121) and the cycle without a vehicle never dim', st.work.every((w) => w.n === 0), st.work);
  ok(scn, 'the late stop (RT-T104 Larisa) stays bold', st.late === 1, st.late);
  ok(scn, 'nothing of Wednesday–Friday is dimmed', st.future === 0, st.future);
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await shot(page, 'dim');
  await page.context().close();
};
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Αντικατάστησε το τμήμα «Rows» του `modules/weekly_natl_v5.js`**

Όλο το κείμενο από `// ═══ Rows ═══` ως και `// ═══ end of rows ═══` (όπως το έγραψε ο T5 Step 4) γίνεται:

```js
// ═══ Rows ═══
// Executed = 40% by DAY (owner 21–22/10, Figma 2035:7735 / rule 2036:7735): the class follows ONLY the base's flags
// (WN5L copies v_rt_stop_state.dim / side_dim / cycle_dim) — the screen never compares a date. On top of the base's
// own rule (never without a vehicle, never when late) the screen keeps the owner's «ποτέ σβηστό ό,τι θέλει δουλειά»
// as a guard: a load waiting for a vehicle, a cycle without one, and a late stop are never dimmed, even if a flag
// said so (a corrupt answer must not hide work).
function _dimOk(r) { return r.kind === 'cycle' && r.rail !== 'red'; }
const _dc = (on) => (on ? ' wn5-dim' : '');
// A window the board did not send (hub[] of 072, Ε-26) is «—», never «null–null» and never a guess (as T5).
const _win = (f, t) => (f && t ? `${_esc(f)}–${_esc(t)}` : '—');
// The «ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» line of a missing destination (as T5): a row that needs work, so it never dims.
function _missHTML(r) {
  return `<div class="wn5-sub wn5-miss" data-qi="${_esc(r.key)}" data-key="miss:${_esc(r.key)}"><span class="wn5-c-idx"></span><span class="wn5-sub-t">${_esc(r.miss)}</span></div>`;
}
function _rowHTML(r, m, no) {
  const n = r.kind === 'cycle' ? ++no.n : null;
  const ok = _dimOk(r);
  const rail = r.rail === 'red' ? ' wi4-r-red' : r.late ? ' wi4-r-amb' : '';
  const ids = r.rtId != null ? ` data-rt="${_id(r.rtId)}"` : ` data-piece="${_id(r.pieceIds[0])}"`;
  let h = `<div class="wn5-row${rail}${_dc(ok && r.rowDim)}" data-key="${_esc(r.key)}" data-qi="${_esc(r.key)}"${ids}>`
    + `<div class="wn5-c-idx"><span class="wi4-no">${n == null ? '' : n}</span>`
    + (r.rtId != null ? `<button type="button" class="wi4-plane" title="Ενέργειες σειράς" aria-haspopup="menu" onclick="WN5.rowMenu(event, ${_id(r.rtId)})">${PLANE}</button>` : '')
    + '</div>'
    + _kathHTML(r, m, ok)
    + `<div class="wn5-asg">${r.tiles.map((t) => _boxHTML(t)).join('')}</div>`
    + _anodHTML(r, m, ok)
    + '</div>';
  for (const lm of r.local) h += _localHTML(r, lm, ok);
  if (r.miss) h += _missHTML(r);
  return h;
}
function _kathHTML(r, m, ok) {
  const s = r.kath;
  if (!s) return r.kind === 'cycle' ? '<div class="wn5-kspan"><span class="wn5-gapbox">Χωρίς κάθοδο</span></div>' : '<div class="wn5-kspan"><span class="wn5-none">—</span></div>';
  // The head of the side (its day, «Βέροια», the Veroia window) dims with the day of its loading stop.
  const hd = _dc(ok && s.headDim);
  const toDay = s.toDay && s.toDay !== s.day ? `<span class="wn5-dc2${hd}">→ ${_esc(_dl(s.toDay))}</span>` : '';
  return `<div class="wn5-kd"><span class="wi4-dc ${_chipCls(s.day, m.today)}${hd}">${_esc(_dl(s.day))}</span>${toDay}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-fl">${s.veroia ? `<span class="wn5-vh${hd}">Βέροια</span><span class="wn5-vtime${hd}">${_win(s.veroia.from, s.veroia.to)}</span>` : ''}${_ptsHTML(s.from, ok)}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-kto">${_ptsHTML(s.to, ok)}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-kpal">${_palHTML(s)}</div>`;
}
function _anodHTML(r, m, ok) {
  const s = r.anod;
  if (!s) return '<div class="wn5-aspan"><span class="wn5-none">—</span></div>';
  if (s.gap) return `<div class="wn5-aspan"><span class="wn5-gapbox">${_esc(s.gap.text)}</span></div>`;
  const n = s.from.length;
  const hd = _dc(ok && s.headDim);
  const end = r.end ? `<span class="wn5-end${_dc(ok && r.end.dim)}"><span class="wi4-l1">Βέροια · τέλος κύκλου</span><span class="wi4-l2">ως ${_esc(_dow(L().athensDay(r.end.by)))} ${_esc(L().athensTime(r.end.by))}</span></span>` : '';
  return `<div class="wn5-ad"><span class="wi4-dc ${_chipCls(s.day, m.today)}${hd}">${_esc(_dl(s.day))}</span><span class="wn5-dc2${hd}">${n} ${n === 1 ? 'φορτίο' : 'φορτία'}</span></div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-afl">${_ptsHTML(s.from, ok)}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-ato">${_ptsHTML(s.to, ok)}${end}</div>`
    + `<div class="wn5-apal">${_palHTML(s)}</div>`;
}
function _ptsHTML(pts, ok) {
  if (!pts.length) return '';
  const one = pts.length === 1;
  const rest = pts.slice(VISIBLE_POINTS);
  const more = rest.length
    ? `<span class="wi4-more" title="${_esc(rest.map((p) => `${p.n}. ${p.name} · ${p.from && p.to ? p.from + '–' + p.to : '—'} · ${_pal(p.pallets)}`).join('\n'))}"><b>+${rest.length}</b></span>`
    : '';
  return `<span class="wi4-pts wn5-pts">${pts.slice(0, VISIBLE_POINTS).map((p) => _ptHTML(p, one, ok)).join('')}${more}</span>`;
}
// Each point with its own day: a delivery of Tuesday stays bold until Tuesday ends, even if its hour passed.
function _ptHTML(p, one, ok) {
  return `<span class="wi4-pt wn5-pt${p.late ? ' wn5-late' : ''}${_dc(ok && p.dim && !p.late)}" data-stop="${_id(p.stopId)}">`
    + (one ? '' : `<span class="wi4-pt-n">${p.n}</span>`)
    + `<span class="wi4-l1">${_esc(p.name)}${p.city ? `<span class="wn5-city"> · ${_esc(p.city)}</span>` : ''}</span>`
    + `<span class="wi4-l2${p.late ? ' wi4-t-amb' : ''}">${_win(p.from, p.to)} · ${_esc(_pal(p.pallets))}</span></span>`;
}
function _palHTML(s) {
  return `<span class="wi4-pal${s.over ? ' over' : ''}"${s.over ? ` title="υπέρβαση ${_esc(_pal(s.over))}"` : ''}>${_esc(String(s.pallets).replace('.', ','))}</span>`;
}
function _boxHTML(t) {
  // «ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ» opens the assignment window (wired by the actions file, Task T12).
  if (t.type === 'un') return '<button type="button" class="wi4-box un" data-act="assign"><span class="wi4-l1">ΠΡΟΣ ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ</span></button>';
  // The tile is 28px high: a long name is cut by the wi4 rule with a visible «…» and stays whole in title.
  return `<span class="wi4-box ${t.type}"><span class="wi4-l1${t.type === 'own' ? ' wi4-plate' : ''}" title="${_esc(t.line1)}">${_esc(t.line1)}</span>`
    + `<span class="wi4-l2${t.missing ? ' wn5-missing' : ''}" title="${_esc(t.line2)}">${_esc(t.line2)}</span></span>`;
}
// «↳ Φόρτωση με τοπικό» under its row (Figma 2011:7745 row 3): who, when, for which stop. It dims with the stop it
// serves (the base's flag of that stop): the board carries no flag of its own for a local move.
function _localHTML(r, lm, ok) {
  const time = [lm.time_from, lm.time_to].filter(Boolean).map((t) => String(t).slice(0, 5)).join('–');
  return `<div class="wn5-sub${_dc(ok && lm.dim)}" data-qi="${_esc(r.key)}" data-key="local:${_id(lm.local_move_id)}" data-stop="${_id(lm.stopId)}">`
    + '<span class="wn5-c-idx"></span>'
    + `<span class="wn5-sub-t">↳ <b>Φόρτωση με τοπικό</b> · ${_esc(lm.driver || 'χωρίς οδηγό')} · ${_esc(_dl(lm.move_date))}${time ? ' ' + _esc(time) : ''}`
    + `${lm.stopName ? ` · για ${_esc(lm.stopName)}${lm.stopN ? ` (στάση ${lm.stopN})` : ''}` : ''}</span></div>`;
}
// ═══ end of rows ═══
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Γράψε το test που αποτυγχάνει, `tests/wn5-search.test.js`**

```js
// node --test tests/wn5-search.test.js
// National v5 F4α Task T7 — the board searches with THE SAME fhSearchNorm / fhSearchBlob as the Weekly boards
// (Pantelis 21/10; tests/wi4-search-norm.test.js pins the functions themselves). The v5 module must call them and
// carry no normaliser of its own (principle 3); a row's search text is WN5L.searchParts(row) kept field by field, so
// a query never matches across two fields. The REAL core files run in a vm on the synthetic W42.
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = process.env.TMS_ROOT ? path.resolve(process.env.TMS_ROOT) : path.join(__dirname, '..');
const read = (f) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), 'utf8');
const FIX = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures/wn5-week.json'), 'utf8'));

test('F4α-T7: the v5 module calls fhSearchBlob/fhSearchNorm and carries no normaliser or Greek→Latin table of its own', () => {
  const V5 = read('modules/weekly_natl_v5.js');
  assert.ok(/fhSearchBlob\(/.test(V5), 'the v5 board must build its search text with fhSearchBlob');
  assert.ok(/fhSearchNorm\(/.test(V5), 'the v5 board must normalise the query with fhSearchNorm');
  assert.ok(!/function\s+_?\w*[Nn]orm\w*\s*\(/.test(V5), 'a normaliser of its own in modules/weekly_natl_v5.js');
  assert.ok(!/_FH_EL|'θ'\s*:\s*'th'|normalize\(\s*'NFD'\s*\)/.test(V5), 'a copy of the Greek→Latin table in modules/weekly_natl_v5.js');
});

test('F4α-T7: Greek finds the Latin names; «τστ 2104» finds the two cycles of TST-2104; a query never matches across two fields', () => {
  const ctx = { console: { log() {}, warn() {}, error() {} } };
  ctx.window = ctx;
  vm.createContext(ctx);
  for (const f of ['core/form-helpers.js', 'core/wi4-logic.js', 'core/wn5-logic.js']) vm.runInContext(read(f), ctx, { filename: f });
  const m = ctx.WN5L.model(FIX, { today: '2026-10-13' });
  const rows = m.days.flatMap((d) => d.rows);
  const find = (q) => Array.from(rows.filter((r) => ctx.fhSearchBlob(ctx.WN5L.searchParts(r)).includes(ctx.fhSearchNorm(q))), (r) => r.key);
  assert.ok(ctx.fhSearchNorm('Thessaloniki Test').includes(ctx.fhSearchNorm('θεσσαλονίκη')), 'Greek must find the Latin-stored place');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(find('τστ 2104'), ['rt:101', 'rt:107']);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(find('Pelagos'), ['rt:104']);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(find('pelagoss'), []);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(find('vs-t118'), ['wait:4101']);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(find('θεσσαλονίκη'), ['rt:105']);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(find('TST-2104 TRL-5102'), [], 'truck + trailer is two fields: never one match');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(find('2104 TRL'), []);
});
```

```js
// Figma 2036:7752: «/» focuses, matches raised, the rest at .35, nothing hidden; Δ12 πλακ. 6: no match said in words, the table hidden until «Καθάρισμα».
SCN.search = async (browser, origin) => {
  const scn = 'search';
  const { page, S } = await openBoard(browser, origin, { board: fixture() });
  await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur && document.activeElement.blur());
  await page.keyboard.press('/');
  ok(scn, '«/» focuses #wn5-search', await page.evaluate(() => !!document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id === 'wn5-search'));
  await page.keyboard.type('τστ 2104');
  const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const r = document.querySelector('#content .wn5');
    if (!r) return null;
    const op = (el) => Number(getComputedStyle(el).opacity);
    const rows = [...r.querySelectorAll('.wn5-row')];
    return { sm: rows.filter((e) => e.classList.contains('wi4-sm')).map((e) => e.dataset.key),
      dimmed: rows.filter((e) => e.classList.contains('wi4-dim')).length, total: rows.length,
      r101: op(r.querySelector('.wn5-row[data-key="rt:101"]')), other: op(r.querySelector('.wn5-row[data-key="rt:102"]')),
      still: [...r.querySelectorAll('.wn5-dayh, .wn5-q, .wn5-qcard, #wn5-notices, #wn5-hub')].filter((e) => e.classList.contains('wi4-dim') || op(e) < 1).length,
      n: (document.getElementById('wn5-search-n') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim() };
  });
  ok(scn, '«τστ 2104» raises the two cycles of TST-2104 (Greek → Latin, no dash)', !!st && JSON.stringify(st.sm) === '["rt:101","rt:107"]', st && st.sm);
  ok(scn, 'every other row fades (.wi4-dim), none is hidden', !!st && st.dimmed === st.total - 2 && st.total === 12, st && { dimmed: st.dimmed, total: st.total });
  ok(scn, 'the executed row 1 is raised to full strength; a faded row is at .35', !!st && st.r101 === 1 && Math.abs(st.other - 0.35) < 0.01, st && { r101: st.r101, other: st.other });
  ok(scn, 'day heads, ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ, notices and the Veroia line do not fade', !!st && st.still === 0, st && st.still);
  ok(scn, 'the counter says «1/2»', !!st && st.n === '1/2', st && st.n);
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  ok(scn, 'Enter → «2/2»', (await page.evaluate(() => (document.getElementById('wn5-search-n') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim())) === '2/2');
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  const cleared = await page.evaluate(() => ({ v: (document.getElementById('wn5-search') || {}).value, dim: document.querySelectorAll('#content .wn5 .wi4-dim, #content .wn5 .wi4-sm').length }));
  ok(scn, 'Esc clears the text and every fade', cleared.v === '' && cleared.dim === 0, cleared);
  await page.evaluate(() => { const i = document.getElementById('wn5-search'); if (i) i.focus(); });
  await page.keyboard.type('pelagoss');
  const none = await page.evaluate(() => ({ t: (document.getElementById('wn5-snone') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
    shown: [...document.querySelectorAll('#content .wn5 .wn5-row')].filter((e) => e.getClientRects().length).length,
    inDom: document.querySelectorAll('#content .wn5 .wn5-row').length }));
  ok(scn, 'no match: «ΑΝΑΖΗΤΗΣΗ · Κανένα αποτέλεσμα για «pelagoss» στη W42 Καθάρισμα ×»', none.t === 'ΑΝΑΖΗΤΗΣΗ · Κανένα αποτέλεσμα για «pelagoss» στη W42 Καθάρισμα ×', none.t);
  ok(scn, 'no match: the table hides until «Καθάρισμα ×» (Δ12 tile 6, Ε-29) — the 12 rows are still in the page', none.shown === 0 && none.inDom === 12, none);
  await page.evaluate(() => { const b = document.querySelector('#wn5-snone button'); if (b) b.click(); });
  ok(scn, '«Καθάρισμα ×» clears and the 12 rows are back', await page.evaluate(() => (document.getElementById('wn5-search') || {}).value === '' && !document.querySelector('#content .wn5 .wi4-dim')
    && [...document.querySelectorAll('#content .wn5 .wn5-row')].filter((e) => e.getClientRects().length).length === 12));
  await page.evaluate(() => { const i = document.getElementById('wn5-search'); if (i) { i.focus(); } });
  await page.keyboard.type('τστ');
  await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur && document.activeElement.blur());
  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
  const moved = await until(page, () => { const r = document.querySelector('#content .wn5'); return r && r.dataset.week === '2026-10-17' && r.dataset.state !== 'loading'; });
  const after = await page.evaluate(() => ({ v: (document.getElementById('wn5-search') || {}).value, dim: document.querySelectorAll('#content .wn5 .wi4-dim').length }));
  ok(scn, 'a week change clears the search (Ε-25)', moved && after.v === '' && after.dim === 0, { moved, after });
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await shot(page, 'search');
  await page.context().close();
};

// ── scenarios end (each Task adds its own above this line) ──
```

```js
function _onKey(e) {
  if (!active() || !document.querySelector('#content .wn5')) return;
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.getElementById('wn5-menu')) { _closeMenu(); e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); return; }
  // «/» focuses the search, as on the Weekly International — never while typing in a field.
  if (e.key === '/' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey
      && !(e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]'))) {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchFocus();
  }
}
```

(στ) Το τμήμα της αναζήτησης, αμέσως **πριν** από τη γραμμή `// ═══ Exports ═══` — old: `// ═══ Exports ═══` — new:
```js
// ═══ Search (Pantelis/owner 21/10, Figma 2036:7752) ═══
// ONE rule with the Weekly boards: fhSearchNorm / fhSearchBlob of core/form-helpers.js. Rows that do not match fade
// to .35, matches are raised — nothing is hidden while something matches; with no match at all the table hides until
// «Καθάρισμα ×» (Δ12 tile 6, Ε-29). Day heads, the notices strip, the ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ band and the Veroia line
// carry no data-qi and never fade; a «↳» sub-row carries its row's key and goes with it.
const SEARCH_ICON = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>';
function _searchHTML(known) {
  return `<label class="wi4-search wn5-search">${SEARCH_ICON}<input id="wn5-search" type="search" placeholder="Αναζήτηση" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Αναζήτηση στον πίνακα"`
    + `${known ? '' : ' disabled'} value="${_esc(_qRaw)}" oninput="WN5.search(this.value)" onkeydown="WN5._searchKey(event)">`
    + '<span id="wn5-search-n" class="wi4-search-n"><span class="wi4-key">/</span></span></label>'
    + '<span id="wn5-snone" class="wn5-snone" role="status" hidden></span>';
}
function _buildIndex(m) {
  _qi.clear();
  if (!m || typeof fhSearchBlob !== 'function') return;
  for (const d of m.days) for (const r of d.rows) _qi.set(r.key, fhSearchBlob(L().searchParts(r)));
}
function _applySearch(scroll) {
  const root = document.querySelector('#content .wn5');
  if (!root) return;
  const nq = _qRaw && typeof fhSearchNorm === 'function' ? fhSearchNorm(_qRaw) : '';
  const hits = [];
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-qi]').forEach((el) => {
    const hit = !!nq && (_qi.get(el.getAttribute('data-qi')) || '').includes(nq);
    el.classList.toggle('wi4-dim', !!nq && !hit);
    el.classList.toggle('wi4-sm', hit);
    if (hit && el.classList.contains('wn5-row')) hits.push(el);
  });
  if (_sIdx >= hits.length) _sIdx = 0;
  const n = document.getElementById('wn5-search-n');
  // no query → the «/» key cap; no match → «—» (never «0/0», Δ12 πλακ. 1), the words go to the line below
  if (n) n.innerHTML = !nq ? '<span class="wi4-key">/</span>' : hits.length ? `${_sIdx + 1}/${hits.length}` : '—';
  const none = document.getElementById('wn5-snone');
  const empty = !!nq && !hits.length;
  // Δ12 tile 6 (approved 22/10, Ε-29): with no match the table hides until «Καθάρισμα ×»; the line says why. A
  // query with matches never hides anything (faded at .35 only).
  const rowsEl = document.getElementById('wn5-rows');
  if (rowsEl) rowsEl.hidden = empty;
  if (none) {
    none.hidden = !empty;
    none.innerHTML = empty
      ? `<b>ΑΝΑΖΗΤΗΣΗ</b> · Κανένα αποτέλεσμα για «${_esc(_qRaw)}» στη W${_esc(String(window.WNATL && window.WNATL.week))} <button type="button" class="wi4-link" onclick="WN5.search('')">Καθάρισμα ×</button>`
      : '';
  }
  if (scroll && hits[_sIdx]) hits[_sIdx].scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
}
function search(q) {
  _qRaw = String(q == null ? '' : q);
  _sIdx = 0;
  const inp = document.getElementById('wn5-search');
  if (inp && inp.value !== _qRaw) inp.value = _qRaw;
  _applySearch(true);
}
function searchFocus() {
  const inp = document.getElementById('wn5-search');
  if (inp && !inp.disabled) { inp.focus(); inp.select(); }
}
function _searchKey(ev) {
  if (!ev) return;
  if (ev.key === 'Enter') {
    ev.preventDefault();
    const n = document.querySelectorAll('#content .wn5 .wn5-row.wi4-sm').length;
    if (!n) return;
    _sIdx = (_sIdx + 1) % n;
    _applySearch(true);
  } else if (ev.key === 'Escape') {
    // stop here: core/ui.js would otherwise take the same Esc for the modal
    ev.preventDefault();
    ev.stopPropagation();
    search('');
    if (ev.target && ev.target.blur) ev.target.blur();
  }
}

// ═══ Exports ═══
```

### Task T8: Λωρίδα ειδοποιήσεων

**Batch:** A · **Gate:** none

**Files:**
- Modify: `modules/weekly_natl_v5.js`, `assets/style.css`, `tests/critics/wn5-board-rig.js` (σενάριο `notices`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Model.notices` (T4), `planFetch`, `WN5Act.strip` — **όχι ακόμη** (T11)· ο T8 δείχνει το σφάλμα με τη δική του γραμμή μέσα στη λωρίδα και ο T11 τη μεταφέρει στο `WN5Act.strip`
- Produces: `#wn5-notices`, `.wn5-note[data-id]`, `#wn5-note-read`

**Tests (rig `notices`):**
- το κείμενο κάθε ειδοποίησης = `message` του board όπως είναι (sentinel)· καμία λωρίδα όταν `notices: []`· «Σημείωσα ✓» → ένα `POST /plan/notices/:id/read` ανά ορατή ειδοποίηση, σώμα `{}`, ποτέ δεύτερο· 409 `writes_closed` → η λωρίδα δείχνει το μήνυμα του Worker, οι ειδοποιήσεις μένουν· 200 → ξαναδιάβασμα board, η λωρίδα φεύγει· 422 `notice_gone` → μήνυμα, ξαναδιάβασμα· στο main ✗.

**Acceptance:** rig `notices` → `GO`.

Ο T8 βάζει τη λωρίδα ειδοποιήσεων (Figma `2011:7745`: «ΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΕΙΣ · 2 · … · Σημείωσα ✓», κάτω από τη ζώνη ΕΠΟΜΕΝΑ). Το κείμενο κάθε ειδοποίησης είναι το `message` που έγραψε η βάση (072 `plan_h_notice`, απόφαση 25) **όπως είναι**· η οθόνη δεν έχει κείμενο ανά `kind` (αρχή 3). Καμία λωρίδα όταν `notices: []`. «Σημείωσα ✓» = ένα `POST /plan/notices/:id/read` ανά ειδοποίηση της οθόνης, σώμα `{}`, μία φορά ανά πάτημα (το `planFetch` δεν ξαναστέλνει)· σταματά στο πρώτο «όχι». Ως την ημέρα L ο Worker απαντά 409 `writes_closed`: η λωρίδα δείχνει το μήνυμά του, οι ειδοποιήσεις μένουν, το κουμπί μένει απενεργό για το session (`WN5.markClosed`, Ε-6). 200 → ξαναδιάβασμα board, η λωρίδα φεύγει· 422 `notice_gone` → το μήνυμα + ξαναδιάβασμα. Ο T11 μεταφέρει τη γραμμή σφάλματος στο κοινό `WN5Act.strip` (ίδιο markup `.wn5-strip[data-kind]`).

**Νέο interface:** `WN5._noteRead()` (ο handler του κουμπιού).

**Πέντε ερωτήσεις:** endpoint `POST /plan/notices/:id/read` (και `GET /plan/board` μετά)· RPC `plan_notice_read` → `plan_notices.read_at`, `read_by` (072:2306-2339, idempotent: `already:true` στη δεύτερη)· τι γράφτηκε: στην παραγωγή **τίποτα** ως το L (409 πριν από τη βάση, μηδέν κλήσεις DB)· στο rig το καταγεγραμμένο σώμα του stub είναι `{}` ανά id και το board που επιστρέφει μετά δεν έχει πια την ειδοποίηση· αποτυχία: η λωρίδα κρατά τις ειδοποιήσεις και δείχνει το `error.message`· δικαίωμα: `PLAN_PERMS.<όλοι οι 5 ρόλοι>["notices-read"] = ["POST"]`. Μετά το L το SQL που το επιβεβαιώνει: `SELECT id, read_at, read_by FROM plan_notices WHERE id IN (<τα ids της οθόνης>)`· ως τότε `SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE read_at IS NOT NULL), count(*) FROM plan_notices` → `0, 0`.

```js
// Notices strip: the DB's text as it is; «Σημείωσα ✓» = one POST per notice, body {}, never twice; writes closed until
// day L (409) → the Worker's message, the notices stay, the button off; 422 notice_gone → its message + a re-read.
SCN.notices = async (browser, origin) => {
  const scn = 'notices';
  const strip = (page) => page.evaluate(() => {
    const n = document.getElementById('wn5-notices');
    return n ? { notes: [...n.querySelectorAll('.wn5-note[data-id]')].map((e) => [e.getAttribute('data-id'), e.textContent.trim()]),
      head: (n.querySelector('.wn5-notes-h') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim(),
      err: [...n.querySelectorAll('.wn5-strip')].map((e) => [e.getAttribute('data-kind'), e.textContent.trim()]),
      off: !!(document.getElementById('wn5-note-read') || {}).disabled } : null;
  });
  const reads = (S) => S.plan.filter((x) => x.m === 'POST' && /^\/plan\/notices\/\d+\/read$/.test(x.path));
  const press = (page) => page.evaluate(() => { const b = document.getElementById('wn5-note-read'); if (b) b.click(); return !!b; });
  // A: the texts as they came; «Σημείωσα ✓» marks both, then the board comes back without them.
  const okAnswer = (e, S) => { const id = Number(e.path.split('/')[3]); S.board.notices = S.board.notices.filter((n) => n.id !== id);
    return [200, { ok: true, op: 'plan_notice_read', dry_run: false, already: false, read_at: '2026-10-13T09:30:00+03:00', read_by: 'demo_dispatcher', ids: { notice_id: id }, warnings: [], notice_ids: [] }]; };
  const a = await openBoard(browser, origin, { board: fixture(), plan: { 'POST /plan/notices/:id/read': okAnswer } });
  const s0 = await strip(a.page);
  ok(scn, '«ΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΕΙΣ · 2» and each text = the board message as it is (sentinel)', !!s0 && s0.head === 'ΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΕΙΣ · 2'
    && JSON.stringify(s0.notes) === JSON.stringify([['9002', '· rig sentinel notice 9002'], ['9001', '· rig sentinel notice 9001']]), s0);
  const before = boardReads(a.S).length;
  await press(a.page);
  const gone = await until(a.page, () => !document.getElementById('wn5-notices') && document.querySelector('#content .wn5').dataset.state === 'ok');
  ok(scn, '«Σημείωσα ✓» → one POST per notice, body {}, nothing else', JSON.stringify(reads(a.S).map((x) => [x.path, x.raw])) === JSON.stringify([['/plan/notices/9002/read', '{}'], ['/plan/notices/9001/read', '{}']]), reads(a.S).map((x) => [x.path, x.raw]));
  ok(scn, '200 → the board is read again and the strip is gone', gone && boardReads(a.S).length === before + 1, { gone, reads: boardReads(a.S).length - before });
  ok(scn, 'no page errors (A)', !a.S.pageErrors.length, a.S.pageErrors);
  await shot(a.page, 'notices-read');
  await a.page.context().close();
  // B: writes closed until day L (the default answer of the fake = production until L).
  const one = fixture(); one.notices = one.notices.slice(0, 1);
  const b = await openBoard(browser, origin, { board: one });
  await press(b.page);
  await until(b.page, () => !!document.querySelector('#wn5-notices .wn5-strip'));
  const s1 = await strip(b.page);
  ok(scn, '409 writes_closed → one POST, the Worker message in the strip, the notice stays', reads(b.S).length === 1 && !!s1
    && JSON.stringify(s1.err) === JSON.stringify([['closed', 'rig sentinel writes_closed']]) && s1.notes.length === 1, { posts: reads(b.S).length, s1 });
  ok(scn, 'after writes_closed the button is off and WN5 knows writes are closed', !!s1 && s1.off && (await b.page.evaluate(() => WN5.snapshot().writesClosed)), s1);
  await press(b.page);
  await b.page.waitForTimeout(500);
  ok(scn, 'a second press sends nothing', reads(b.S).length === 1, reads(b.S).length);
  await shot(b.page, 'notices-closed');
  await b.page.context().close();
  // C: notice_gone (someone else got there first) → its message, a re-read, what is left stays.
  const goneAnswer = (e, S) => { const id = Number(e.path.split('/')[3]); S.board.notices = S.board.notices.filter((n) => n.id !== id); return planErr(422, 'PLAN_RULE', 'notice_gone'); };
  const c = await openBoard(browser, origin, { board: fixture(), plan: { 'POST /plan/notices/:id/read': goneAnswer } });
  const cb = boardReads(c.S).length;
  await press(c.page);
  await until(c.page, () => !!document.querySelector('#wn5-notices .wn5-strip'));
  const s2 = await strip(c.page);
  ok(scn, '422 notice_gone → one POST, its message, the board re-read, the other notice still there', reads(c.S).length === 1 && boardReads(c.S).length === cb + 1 && !!s2
    && JSON.stringify(s2.err) === JSON.stringify([['refusal', 'rig sentinel notice_gone']]) && JSON.stringify(s2.notes.map((x) => x[0])) === '["9001"]', { posts: reads(c.S).length, s2 });
  await c.page.context().close();
  // D: no notices → no strip at all.
  const none = fixture(); none.notices = [];
  const d = await openBoard(browser, origin, { board: none });
  ok(scn, 'notices: [] → no #wn5-notices', !(await d.page.$('#wn5-notices')) && !!(await d.page.$('#content .wn5[data-state="ok"]')));
  ok(scn, 'no page errors (B–D)', !b.S.pageErrors.length && !c.S.pageErrors.length && !d.S.pageErrors.length, [b.S.pageErrors, c.S.pageErrors, d.S.pageErrors]);
  await d.page.context().close();
};

// ── scenarios end (each Task adds its own above this line) ──
```

(δ) Το τμήμα των ειδοποιήσεων, αμέσως **πριν** από τη γραμμή `// ═══ Exports ═══` — old: `// ═══ Exports ═══` — new:
```js
// ═══ Notices strip (Figma 2011:7745 «ΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΕΙΣ») ═══
// The text of a notice is the DB's (072 plan_h_notice writes it in Greek, decision 25): shown as it is, the screen
// writes no text per kind (principle 3). «Σημείωσα ✓» marks every notice on screen read — one POST per notice, body
// {}, sent once per press (planFetch never re-sends), stopping at the first «no». Until day L the Worker answers 409
// writes_closed: its message is shown, the notices stay, and the button stays off for the session (Ε-6).
function _noticesHTML(m) {
  if (!m || !m.notices.length) return '';
  const off = _noteBusy || !!_closed;
  return `<div id="wn5-notices" class="wn5-notes" role="status"><b class="wn5-notes-h">ΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΕΙΣ · ${m.notices.length}</b>`
    + `<span class="wn5-notes-l">${m.notices.map((x) => `<span class="wn5-note" data-id="${_id(x.id)}"> · ${_esc(x.message)}</span>`).join('')}</span>`
    + (_noteErr ? `<span class="wn5-strip" data-kind="${_esc(_noteErr.kind || 'failed')}" role="alert">${_esc(_noteErr.message)}</span>` : '')
    + `<button type="button" id="wn5-note-read" class="wi4-link"${off ? ' disabled' : ''}${_closed ? ` title="${_esc(_closed.message)}"` : ''} onclick="WN5._noteRead()">Σημείωσα ✓</button></div>`;
}
function _paintNotices() {
  const el = document.getElementById('wn5-notices');
  if (el && _m) el.outerHTML = _noticesHTML(_m);
}
async function _noteRead() {
  if (_noteBusy || _closed || !active() || !_m) return;
  const ids = _m.notices.map((x) => x.id).filter((id) => ID_RE.test(String(id)));
  if (!ids.length) return;
  _noteBusy = true;
  _noteErr = null;
  _paintNotices();
  let again = false;
  for (const id of ids) {
    try {
      await planFetch('POST', `/plan/notices/${id}/read`, { body: {} });
      again = true;
    } catch (e) {
      if (e && e._sessionGone) { _noteBusy = false; return; }
      _noteErr = e;
      if (e && e.kind === 'closed') markClosed(e);
      // notice_gone: someone else marked it first — the board is read again, so the strip says what is left
      if (e && e.code === 'notice_gone') again = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  _noteBusy = false;
  if (again) await reload('notices'); else _paintNotices();
}

// ═══ Exports ═══
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: —
- Produces: `plan_request` → πίνακας «Κωδικός αιτήματος», εγγραφή = το `op` (π.χ. «plan_orders_create»), αλλαγή «Νέα εγγραφή», ποτέ ωμό JSON· ετικέτες `shipments`, `shipment_pieces`, `piece_legs`, `rt_stops`, `plan_notices` (+ `rt_vehicle_segments` όταν υπάρξει)· το φίλτρο πινάκων δείχνει τις ίδιες ετικέτες

**Acceptance:** `node --test tests/audit-trail-stock.test.js` πράσινο.

Η 072 γράφει για κάθε δημιουργία με `request_id` **μία** γραμμή `audit_log` (`plan_h_remember`, 072:171-180): `action='create'`, `table_name='plan_request'`, `record_id` = το uuid, `after_data = {op, request_id, body_md5, answer}`. Σήμερα το Audit Trail θα την έδειχνε «Δημιουργία · PLAN REQUEST · <uuid>» (κεφαλαίο ωμό όνομα πίνακα, χωρίς λαβή) και τους πέντε νέους πίνακες της 071 επίσης ωμούς. Ο T9 δίνει ελληνική ετικέτα «Κωδικός αιτήματος» και ως λαβή εγγραφής το `op` (π.χ. `plan_orders_create`), ποτέ το ωμό JSON (F2 σημείωση 4), και ετικέτες στους `shipments`, `shipment_pieces`, `piece_legs`, `rt_stops`, `plan_notices`. Το φίλτρο πινάκων του Audit Trail χτίζεται από το ίδιο `_auditTableLabel`, άρα δείχνει τις ίδιες λέξεις χωρίς άλλη αλλαγή. Ο `rt_vehicle_segments` (072b) **δεν** μπαίνει τώρα: ετικέτα για πίνακα που δεν υπάρχει θα ήταν νεκρός κώδικας (αρχή 8)· τον προσθέτει ο T25 μαζί με την καρτέλα κύκλου.

**Πέντε ερωτήσεις:** endpoint `GET {PROXY_URL}/audit` (owner/management, όπως σήμερα)· πίνακας `audit_log` (`table_name`, `record_id`, `after_data`)· δεν γράφει· αποτυχία: όπως σήμερα (η λωρίδα σφάλματος του Audit Trail)· δικαίωμα: `AUDIT_UI_ROLES`. Παραγωγή σήμερα: `SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE table_name = 'plan_request'` → `0` (T0)· η πρώτη γραμμή θα γραφτεί την ημέρα L.

```js
  cut(/function _auditRow\(e\) \{[\s\S]*?\n\}/, '_auditRow'),
  "const _AUDIT_ROLE = {}; function _auditWhen() { return { short: '26/10 10:00', full: '26/10/2026 10:00' }; }",
  "function _auditEsc(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/\"/g, '&quot;'); }",
  'this.row = _auditRow; this.t = _auditTableLabel;',
].join('\n'), row);

    answer: { ok: true, op: 'plan_orders_create', dry_run: false, ids: { nat_order_ids: [7] }, warnings: [], notice_ids: [] } } };

  assert.ok(!/\{&quot;|\{"|body_md5|nat_order_ids/.test(html), 'raw JSON of after_data on screen: ' + html);
  assert.ok(html.includes('Νέα εγγραφή'));

  for (const [t, label] of Object.entries(want)) assert.strictEqual(row.t(t), label, t);

});
```

### Task T11: Κοινός μηχανισμός πράξεων — ετικέτες, ροή δύο βημάτων, λωρίδες αποτελέσματος

**Batch:** B · **Gate:** none

**Files:**
