```js
const MIME = { '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.json': 'application/json',
  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.webmanifest': 'application/manifest+json' };
function serve() {
  const srv = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    const u = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
    const file = path.join(TREE, decodeURIComponent(u.pathname === '/' ? '/app.html' : u.pathname));
    if (!file.startsWith(TREE) || !fs.existsSync(file) || fs.statSync(file).isDirectory()) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end(); }
    res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': MIME[path.extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream', 'cache-control': 'no-store' });
    fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res);
  });
  return new Promise((r) => srv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => r(srv)));
}
function makeOk() {
  let fails = 0;
  const ok = (scn, name, cond, detail) => {
    if (!cond) fails++;
    console.log(`${cond ? '✓' : '✗'} ${scn} ${name}${cond || detail === undefined ? '' : '  → ' + String(typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail)).slice(0, 500)}`);
    return !!cond;
  };
  ok.fails = () => fails;
  return ok;
}
// Runs in the page before any script: a demo_* roster user (config.js USERS) or the tamper guard bounces.
function initScript(role) {
  localStorage.setItem('tms_user', JSON.stringify({ name: 'Rig Test', role, username: 'demo_' + role, loginAt: Date.now(), expiresAt: Date.now() + 8 * 3600 * 1000 }));
  localStorage.setItem('tms_jwt', 'rig.wn5.no-real-token');
  localStorage.setItem('tms_page', 'weekly_natl');
  localStorage.setItem('tms_sidebar_v2_migrated', '1');
  localStorage.setItem('tms_sidebar_collapsed', 'true');
}
function defaultPlan(e, S) {
  const r = routeOf(e.m, e.path);
  if (r === 'GET /plan/board') return [200, S.board];
  if (r === 'GET /plan/lookups') return [200, S.lookups];
  if (r === 'GET /plan/notices') return [200, { desk: e.q.desk || 'natl', unread: [], recent: [] }];
  if (e.body && e.body.dry_run === true && DRY.includes(r))
    return [200, { ok: true, op: 'rig_dry', dry_run: true, needs_confirm: false, confirm_token: 'rig-token-0', consequences: [] }];
  return planErr(409, 'WRITES_CLOSED', 'writes_closed');   // as deployed until day L
}
// opts: role · flag ('on') · board · lookups · plan {'<M> <exact path>': async (entry, S) => [status, body]} · viewport · clipboard
async function openApp(browser, origin, opts = {}) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: origin + '/', viewport: opts.viewport || { width: 1920, height: 1080 },
    serviceWorkers: 'block', timezoneId: 'Europe/Athens', locale: 'el-GR' });
  if (opts.clipboard) await ctx.grantPermissions(['clipboard-read', 'clipboard-write'], { origin });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date(NOW));   // BEFORE the session is stamped (wn-wave1-proof.js note)
  const S = { plan: [], facade: [], pageErrors: [], console: [], preflight: [], t0: Date.now(),
    board: clone(opts.board || week()), lookups: clone(opts.lookups || LOOKUPS) };
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => S.pageErrors.push(String(e).slice(0, 300)));
  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') S.console.push(m.text().slice(0, 300)); });
  page.on('dialog', (d) => d.accept());
  await page.addInitScript(initScript, opts.role || 'dispatcher');
  await page.route((u) => !u.href.startsWith(origin) && !u.href.includes(HOST), (route) => route.abort());
  await page.route((u) => u.href.startsWith(origin) && new URL(u.href).pathname === '/config.js', async (route) => {
    const r = await route.fetch();
    let body = await r.text();
    // Plain main has no WN_V5: a preflight line, never a throw (a throw would end the run before any check).
    const re = /WN_V5:\s*(?:false|true|'(?:off|pilot|on)')/;
    if (re.test(body)) body = body.replace(re, `WN_V5: '${opts.flag || 'on'}'`);
    else S.preflight.push('FEATURES.WN_V5 not found in config.js');
    await route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', body });
  });
  const cors = { 'access-control-allow-origin': '*' };
  await page.route(`**/${HOST}/**`, async (route) => {
    const req = route.request();
    const u = new URL(req.url());
    const m = req.method();
    if (m === 'OPTIONS') return route.fulfill({ status: 204, headers: Object.assign({ 'access-control-allow-headers': '*', 'access-control-allow-methods': '*' }, cors) });
    if (u.pathname.startsWith('/plan/')) {
      const raw = req.postData();
      let body = null;
      try { body = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; } catch (_) { body = '<<not json>>'; }
      const e = { m, path: u.pathname, q: Object.fromEntries(u.searchParams), raw, body, headers: req.headers(), at: Date.now() - S.t0 };
      S.plan.push(e);
      const fn = (opts.plan || {})[`${m} ${u.pathname}`] || defaultPlan;
      const [status, ans] = await fn(e, S);
      e.status = status;
      return route.fulfill({ status, contentType: 'application/json', headers: cors, body: JSON.stringify(ans) });
    }
    S.facade.push({ m, path: u.pathname });
    const tid = (u.pathname.match(/\/v0\/[^/]+\/([A-Za-z0-9]+)/) || [])[1];
    let ans = m === 'GET' ? { records: [] } : { ok: true };
    if (m === 'GET' && tid === 'tblxu8DRfTQOFRCzS') ans = { records: FACADE_LOCS };
    if (m === 'GET' && tid === 'tblFWKAQVUzAM8mCE') ans = { records: FACADE_CLIENTS };
    return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/json', headers: cors, body: JSON.stringify(ans) });
  });
  await page.goto('app.html');
  try { await page.waitForFunction(() => !!document.querySelector('#content > .wi4.wn5[data-state="ok"]'), null, { timeout: 20000 }); }
  catch (_) { S.preflight.push('the v5 board did not paint (#content > .wi4.wn5[data-state=ok])'); }
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const E = window.__ev = [];
    const wrap = (name, k, call) => {
      const fn = window[name];
      if (typeof fn !== 'function') return;
      window[name] = function () {
        E.push({ k, a: [...arguments].map((x) => { try { return typeof x === 'object' ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)) : String(x).slice(0, 300); } catch (_) { return String(x); } }) });
        return call ? fn.apply(this, arguments) : undefined;
      };
    };
    wrap('toast', 'toast', true); wrap('showErrorToast', 'errtoast', true); wrap('logError', 'logError', true); wrap('tmsSessionExpired', 'expired', false);
  }).catch(() => {});
  return { page, S };
}
const has = (page, g) => page.evaluate((x) => typeof window[x] !== 'undefined', g).catch(() => false);
const count = (page, sel) => page.evaluate((s) => document.querySelectorAll(s).length, sel);
const text = (page, sel) => page.evaluate((s) => { const el = document.querySelector(s); return el ? el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''; }, sel);
const planOf = (S, m, p) => S.plan.filter((x) => x.m === m && (p instanceof RegExp ? p.test(x.path) : x.path === p));

async function preflight(browser, origin, ok, globals) {
  const scn = 'preflight';
  const { page, S } = await openApp(browser, origin);
  const st = await page.evaluate((gs) => ({ api: typeof planFetch === 'function', root: !!document.querySelector('#content > .wi4.wn5'),
    g: gs.map((g) => typeof window[g] !== 'undefined') }), globals);
  ok(scn, 'FEATURES.WN_V5 exists in config.js', !S.preflight.some((x) => /WN_V5/.test(x)), S.preflight);
  ok(scn, 'core/plan-api.js loaded (planFetch)', st.api, st);
  ok(scn, 'the v5 board painted (#content .wn5)', st.root, S.preflight);
  ok(scn, 'board read through GET /plan/board?week=<Saturday>', S.plan.some((x) => x.m === 'GET' && x.path === '/plan/board' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(x.q.week || '')), S.plan.map((x) => x.m + ' ' + x.path));
  globals.forEach((g, i) => ok(scn, `${g} defined`, st.g[i], st));
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await page.context().close();
}
// opts: { scenarios: {name: async ({browser, origin, ok, scn, shots}) => void}, globals: [..], go: 'what holds' }
async function run(opts) {
  const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
  const at = argv.indexOf('--shots');
  const shots = at >= 0 ? argv[at + 1] : null;
  const want = argv.filter((a, i) => !a.startsWith('--') && !(at >= 0 && i === at + 1));
  const names = Object.keys(opts.scenarios);
  const bad = want.filter((w) => !names.includes(w));
  if (bad.length) { console.error('unknown scenario(s): ' + bad.join(', ') + ' — known: ' + names.join(' ')); process.exit(2); }
  const { chromium } = require(require.resolve('playwright', { paths: [process.cwd(), WT] }));
  const ok = makeOk();
  const srv = await serve();
  const origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${srv.address().port}`;
  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  try {
    await preflight(browser, origin, ok, opts.globals);   // ✗ lines on plain main, never an early exit
    for (const n of names) {
      if (want.length && !want.includes(n)) continue;
      let t = null;
      try {
        await Promise.race([opts.scenarios[n]({ browser, origin, ok, scn: n, shots }),
          new Promise((_, rej) => { t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('watchdog: still running after 120 s')), 120000); })]);
      } catch (e) {
        ok(n, 'scenario ran to the end', false, String(e && e.stack || e));
        for (const c of browser.contexts()) await c.close().catch(() => {});
      } finally { clearTimeout(t); }
    }
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
    srv.close();
    const n = ok.fails();
    console.log(n ? `\nNO-GO: ${n} check(s) failed` : `\nGO: ${opts.go}`);
    process.exit(n ? 1 : 0);
  }
}

module.exports = { WT, TREE, HOST, NOW, UUID4, LOOKUPS, FACADE_LOCS, week, leg, stop, clone, routeOf, planErr, sleep,
  openApp, has, count, text, planOf, run };
```

```js
  ok(scn, '«+» body: target {rt_id:101, side:KATHODOS}', JSON.stringify(b2.target) === JSON.stringify({ rt_id: 101, side: 'KATHODOS' }), b2.target);
  ok(scn, '«+» body: Veroia by its stop_id, Larisa as one new stop', JSON.stringify(b2.stops) === JSON.stringify([{ ref: 's1', stop_id: 1001 },
    { ref: 's2', location_id: 4, side: 'KATHODOS', planned_from: '2026-10-13T10:00:00+03:00', planned_to: '2026-10-13T12:00:00+03:00' }]), b2.stops);
  await p2.page.context().close();

  // «+ Άδειες παλέτες · 1 €» (Figma 9624; the ΠΡΟΡΥΘΜΙΣΗ of 10022, Ε-39): a prefill only — nothing is sent by it
  const p3 = await K.openApp(browser, origin);
  await p3.page.evaluate(() => WN5Form.openOrder({ side: 'ANODOS', preset: 'empties' }));
  await p3.page.waitForSelector(DLG, { timeout: 8000 }).catch(() => {});
  const pre = await p3.page.evaluate((d) => {
    const b = [...document.querySelectorAll(`${d} .wn5f-ord`)].pop();
    if (!b) return null;
    const drop = b.querySelector('.wn5f-rows[data-k="drop"] .wn5f-row');
    return { goods: b.querySelector('[data-f="goods"]').value, price: b.querySelector('[data-f="price"]').value,
      drop: drop ? (document.getElementById('lv_' + drop.dataset.pid) || {}).value : null, btn: !!document.querySelector(`${d} [data-act="add-empties"]`) };
  }, DLG);
  ok(scn, '«Άδειες παλέτες · 1 €»: goods + price 1 prefilled, Veroia the delivery point on ΑΝΟΔΟΣ, the button is in the form, nothing sent',
    !!pre && pre.goods === 'Άδειες παλέτες' && pre.price === '1' && pre.drop === HUB.rec && pre.btn && !K.planOf(p3.S, 'POST', '/plan/orders').length, pre);
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length && !p2.S.pageErrors.length && !p3.S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors.concat(p2.S.pageErrors, p3.S.pageErrors));
  await p3.page.context().close();
}

async function scnGroupage({ browser, origin, ok, scn }) {
  const { page, S } = await K.openApp(browser, origin);
  if (!(await guard(page, ok, scn))) return;
  await openForm(page, {});
  await page.click(`${DLG} [data-mode="groupage"]`);
  await fillOrder(page, 0, { client: C41, price: 640, temp: 2, pe: true, loads: [r(THE, '2026-10-12', '08:00', '10:00', 6), r(ASP, '2026-10-12', '10:30', '12:00', 4)], drops: [r(ATH, '2026-10-13', '06:00', '08:00', 10)] });
  await fillOrder(page, 1, { client: C42, price: 420, temp: 4, pe: false, loads: [r(HUB, '2026-10-12', '16:00', '18:00', 12)], drops: [r(ASP, '2026-10-13', '07:00', '09:00', 12)] });
  await fillOrder(page, 2, { client: C43, price: 380, temp: 2, pe: true, loads: [r(HUB, '2026-10-12', '16:00', '18:00', 8)], drops: [r(ATH, '2026-10-13', '09:00', '11:00', 8)] });
  const label = await K.text(page, `${DLG} [data-act="save"]`);
  ok(scn, 'title «Νέο groupage εθνικής»', (await K.text(page, `${DLG} .wi4-dlg-t`)) === 'Νέο groupage εθνικής');
  ok(scn, 'button «Αποθήκευση · 3 παραγγελίες»', label === 'Αποθήκευση · 3 παραγγελίες', label);
  const sum = await K.text(page, `${DLG} [data-sum]`);
  ok(scn, 'summary «3 παραγγελίες → 4 αποστολές»', sum.includes('3 παραγγελίες → 4 αποστολές'), sum.slice(0, 300));
  ok(scn, 'no mixed-temperature line before the save (Ε-3: only from the answer)', !/Μεικτές/.test(await K.text(page, DLG)));
  await save(page);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  const posts = K.planOf(S, 'POST', '/plan/orders');
  ok(scn, '3 orders = ONE POST /plan/orders', posts.length === 1, posts.length);
  const b = (posts[0] && posts[0].body) || {};
  ok(scn, 'body.orders has 3 orders, the first with 2 shipments', Array.isArray(b.orders) && b.orders.length === 3 && b.orders[0].shipments.length === 2, b.orders && b.orders.map((o) => o.shipments.length));
  await page.context().close();
}

async function scnUnknown({ browser, origin, ok, scn }) {
  const { page, S } = await K.openApp(browser, origin, { plan: { 'POST /plan/orders': () => K.planErr(500, 'SERVER', 'plan_unknown') } });
  if (!(await guard(page, ok, scn))) return;
  await openForm(page, {});
  await fillOrder(page, 0, ORDER_A);
  await save(page);
  await page.waitForTimeout(3500);
  let posts = K.planOf(S, 'POST', '/plan/orders');
  ok(scn, '500 plan_unknown → exactly one POST (no automatic resend)', posts.length === 1, posts.length);
  ok(scn, 'the strip «μπορεί να αποθηκεύτηκε» is the Worker message as is', /rig sentinel plan_unknown/.test(await K.text(page, `${DLG} [data-strip]`)));
  ok(scn, '«Έλεγχος στο board» is offered', await K.count(page, `${DLG} [data-act="check-board"]`) === 1);
  await save(page);
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  posts = K.planOf(S, 'POST', '/plan/orders');
  ok(scn, 'second press carries the SAME request_id', posts.length === 2 && posts[0].body.request_id === posts[1].body.request_id, posts.map((x) => x.body && x.body.request_id));
  ok(scn, 'second press carries the SAME bytes', posts.length === 2 && posts[0].raw === posts[1].raw);
  await page.click(`${DLG} .wn5f-ft [data-act="cancel"]`);
  await openForm(page, {});
  await fillOrder(page, 0, ORDER_A);
  await save(page);
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  posts = K.planOf(S, 'POST', '/plan/orders');
  ok(scn, 'after closing the form the next open mints a new request_id', posts.length === 3 && posts[2].body.request_id !== posts[0].body.request_id, posts.map((x) => x.body && x.body.request_id));
  ok(scn, 'no request_id in sessionStorage / history / URL', await noStore(page, posts[0].body.request_id));
  await page.context().close();
}

async function scnReused({ browser, origin, ok, scn }) {
  let held = false;
  const plan = {
    // the FIRST press was saved: the stub writes the order into the board, then answers request_reused (no ids)
    'POST /plan/orders': (e, S) => {
      S.board.waiting.push({ piece_id: 4901, shipment_id: 5901, kind: 'national', order_id: null, nat_order_id: 3901, order_stop_id: null, pallets: 6, leave_by: null,
        position_location_id: 3, nat_from_location_id: 3, nat_to_location_id: 2, nat_ready_day: '2026-10-14', nat_due_day: '2026-10-15', overdue: false, is_stock: false,
        client_id: 41, client: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Α', reference: null, temperature_c: 4, pallet_exchange: false, load_from: e.body.orders[0].shipments[0].load_from,
        load_to: e.body.orders[0].shipments[0].load_to, deliver_from: e.body.orders[0].shipments[0].deliver_from, deliver_to: e.body.orders[0].shipments[0].deliver_to, price: 310 });
      held = true;
      return K.planErr(422, 'PLAN_RULE', 'request_reused');
    },
    // the re-read after the refusal is held 1 s: «αποθηκεύτηκε» must wait for it
    'GET /plan/board': async (e, S) => { if (held) await K.sleep(1000); return [200, S.board]; },
  };
  const { page, S } = await K.openApp(browser, origin, { plan });
  if (!(await guard(page, ok, scn))) return;
  await openForm(page, {});
  await fillOrder(page, 0, ORDER_A);
  const n0 = K.planOf(S, 'GET', '/plan/board').length;
  await save(page);
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  ok(scn, 'while the board re-read is in flight, nothing says «αποθηκεύτηκε»', !(await page.evaluate((d) => { const x = document.querySelector(`${d} [data-done]`); return x && !x.hidden; }, DLG)));
  await page.waitForFunction((d) => { const x = document.querySelector(`${d} [data-done]`); return x && !x.hidden; }, DLG, { timeout: 8000 }).catch(() => {});
  const gets = K.planOf(S, 'GET', '/plan/board');
  const post = K.planOf(S, 'POST', '/plan/orders')[0];
  ok(scn, '422 request_reused → GET /plan/board after the POST', gets.length > n0 && post && gets[gets.length - 1].at > post.at, gets.map((x) => x.at));
  const done = await K.text(page, `${DLG} [data-done]`);
  ok(scn, '«Αποθηκεύτηκε» names the order found on the board (#3901)', /Αποθηκεύτηκε/.test(done) && done.includes('#3901'), done);
  ok(scn, 'no second POST', K.planOf(S, 'POST', '/plan/orders').length === 1);
  await page.context().close();
}

async function scnReplayed({ browser, origin, ok, scn }) {
  const plan = { 'POST /plan/orders': () => [200, { ok: true, op: 'plan_orders_create', dry_run: false, replayed: true,
    ids: { nat_order_ids: [3902], shipment_ids: [5902], piece_ids: [4902], rt_id: null, stop_ids: [], leg_ids: [] },
    warnings: [{ code: 'mixed_temp', rt_id: 101, side: 'KATHODOS', delta_c: 2 }], notice_ids: [] }] };
  const { page, S } = await K.openApp(browser, origin, { plan });
  if (!(await guard(page, ok, scn))) return;
  await openForm(page, {});
  await fillOrder(page, 0, ORDER_A);
  await save(page);
  await page.waitForFunction((d) => { const x = document.querySelector(`${d} [data-done]`); return x && !x.hidden; }, DLG, { timeout: 8000 }).catch(() => {});
  const done = await K.text(page, `${DLG} [data-done]`);
  ok(scn, '200 replayed:true → «Αποθηκεύτηκε» with the first ids', done.includes('#3902') && /πρώτο πάτημα/.test(done), done);
  ok(scn, 'mixed_temp from the answer → a warning line after the save (Ε-3)', await K.count(page, `${DLG} .wn5-strip[data-kind="warning"]`) >= 1);
  ok(scn, 'the save button is gone (nothing to resend)', await page.evaluate((d) => document.querySelector(`${d} [data-act="save"]`).hidden, DLG));
  ok(scn, 'one POST, then a board re-read', K.planOf(S, 'POST', '/plan/orders').length === 1);
  await page.context().close();
}

async function scnEdit({ browser, origin, ok, scn }) {
  const plan = { 'PATCH /plan/orders/3101': () => [200, { ok: true, op: 'plan_order_update', dry_run: false, ids: { nat_order_id: 3101, shipment_ids: [] }, warnings: [], notice_ids: [] }] };
  const { page, S } = await K.openApp(browser, origin, { plan });
  if (!(await guard(page, ok, scn))) return;
  await openForm(page, { natOrderId: 3101 });
  ok(scn, 'edit opens on the waiting order with its price', (await page.evaluate((d) => document.querySelector(`${d} [data-f="price"]`).value, DLG)) === '310');
  await page.fill(`${DLG} [data-f="price"]`, '330');
  await save(page);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  const p = K.planOf(S, 'PATCH', '/plan/orders/3101');
  ok(scn, 'one PATCH /plan/orders/3101 with only {set:{price:330}}', p.length === 1 && JSON.stringify(p[0].body) === JSON.stringify({ set: { price: 330 } }), p.map((x) => x.body));
  ok(scn, 'an edit carries no request_id (only the 3 creations do)', p[0] && !('request_id' in p[0].body));
  await page.context().close();
}

K.run({
  scenarios: { order: scnOrder, groupage: scnGroupage, unknown: scnUnknown, reused: scnReused, replayed: scnReplayed, edit: scnEdit },
  globals: ['WN5Form'],
  go: 'the v5 order forms send one body per press, from the form only, with one request_id per open form',
}).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });
```

1. **Endpoint:** `POST /plan/orders` (δημιουργία, με `request_id`), `PATCH /plan/orders/:id` (επεξεργασία, χωρίς).
2. **RPC / πίνακες / στήλες:** `plan_orders_create` → `national_orders` (client_id, price, reference, goods, temperature_c, pallet_exchange, notes, pallets, loading/delivery_datetime, pickup/delivery_location_1_id· ποτέ truck_id/partner_id/status), `shipments`, `shipment_pieces`, με `target` και `rt_stops`, `piece_legs`· μία γραμμή `audit_log` `table_name='plan_request'`. `plan_order_update` → `national_orders` (set), `shipments` (παλέτες, παράθυρα).
3. **Τι γράφτηκε όντως:** στην παραγωγή **τίποτα** (κλειστές εγγραφές ως το L: 409 με 0 κλήσεις στη βάση). Απόδειξη μόνο SELECT (MCP `execute_sql`):
   ```sql
   SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM shipments) AS shipments,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM shipment_pieces) AS pieces,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM national_orders n WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.nat_order_id = n.id)) AS v5_orders,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE table_name = 'plan_request') AS plan_requests;
   ```
   Expected `0 · 0 · 0 · 0`. Η διαδρομή εγγραφής αποδεικνύεται **μόνο στο stub** ως το L: το σώμα στο `S.plan` του rig (σενάρια `order`, `groupage`, `edit`) και, για τον πραγματικό Worker, το test του T1 `wn5-plan-api-worker.test.mjs` (το `p` που φτάνει στη βάση = το σώμα + `request_id`).
4. **Αποτυχία:** 422 → λωρίδα με το `error.message`, φόρμα ανοιχτή, ίδιο `request_id`· 500 `plan_unknown` / 409 `busy_retry` / 503 → λωρίδα, ίδιο `request_id`, «Έλεγχος στο board»· 422 `request_reused` → ξαναδιάβασμα και «αποθηκεύτηκε» μόνο αν βρεθεί· 409 `writes_closed` → λωρίδα, «Αποθήκευση» κλειδωμένη· 500 `amount_leak` → κλειδωμένη (η εγγραφή έμεινε).

```js
// T21 — the leg form. A second national order on the KATHODOS of RT-T101, so «two blocks changed» can be tried.
function legWeek() {
  const b = K.week();
  const ND = { nat_order_id: 3004, reference: 'N-T004', client_id: 43, client: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Γ', temperature_c: 4 };
  b.cycles[0].stops[0].legs.push(K.leg(5004, 4005, 'load', 4, ND));
  b.cycles[0].stops[2].legs.push(K.leg(5004, 4005, 'unload', 4, ND));
  return b;
}
const LEG = '.wi4-dlg[role="dialog"][data-wn5="leg"]';
async function openLegBy(page, rt, side) {
  // the owner's rule (Figma 2011:7737 #3): a click on the leg opens the form — try the real click first
  const sel = `#content .wn5-row[data-rt="${rt}"] [data-leg="${side}"]`;
  const clicked = await page.click(sel, { timeout: 3000 }).then(() => true, () => false);
  await page.waitForSelector(LEG, { timeout: 6000 }).catch(() => {});
  return clicked;
}
async function scnLeg({ browser, origin, ok, scn }) {
  let patchN = 0;
  const plan = { 'PATCH /plan/orders/3001': () => (++patchN === 1
    ? [200, { ok: true, op: 'plan_order_update', dry_run: false, ids: { nat_order_id: 3001, shipment_ids: [] }, warnings: [{ code: 'mixed_temp', rt_id: 101, side: 'KATHODOS', delta_c: 2 }], notice_ids: [] }]
    : K.planErr(422, 'PLAN_RULE', 'vs_locked')) };
  const { page, S } = await K.openApp(browser, origin, { board: legWeek(), plan });
  if (!(await guard(page, ok, scn))) return;
  ok(scn, 'a click on the KATHODOS leg of RT-T101 opens the leg form', await openLegBy(page, 101, 'KATHODOS') && await K.count(page, LEG) === 1);
  const t = await K.text(page, `${LEG} .wi4-dlg-hd`);
  ok(scn, 'title «Σκέλος · ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ TST-2104 · Δευ 12/10 · 3 αποστολές»', t.includes('Σκέλος · ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ TST-2104 · Δευ 12/10') && t.includes('· 3 αποστολές'), t);
  ok(scn, 'capacity badge «21 + 6 + 4 = 31/33»', t.includes('21 + 6 + 4 = 31/33'), t);
  const vs = await K.text(page, `${LEG} [data-vs="2101"]`);
  ok(scn, 'the VS block is locked: «τιμή και τιμολόγηση στη διεθνή παραγγελία», no price field', vs.includes('τιμή και τιμολόγηση στη διεθνή παραγγελία') && await K.count(page, `${LEG} [data-vs="2101"] [data-f="price"]`) === 0, vs.slice(0, 200));
  ok(scn, '«Μεταφορά σε…» on each VS delivery row', await K.count(page, `${LEG} [data-vs="2101"] [data-act="move"]`) === 1);
  ok(scn, '«Άνοιγμα καρτέλας ›» instead of a delete', await K.count(page, `${LEG} [data-act="card"]`) === 2 && !/Διαγραφή/.test(await K.text(page, `${LEG} .wn5f-body`)));
  ok(scn, '«ΣΕΙΡΑ ΣΤΑΣΕΩΝ ΚΑΤΑ ΩΡΑ» lists the 3 stops of the side', await K.count(page, `${LEG} .wn5f-seq li`) === 3);
  ok(scn, 'no mixed-temperature line before a save (no threshold on screen)', !/Μεικτές/.test(await K.text(page, LEG)));
  const disabled = () => page.evaluate((d) => document.querySelector(`${d} [data-act="save"]`).disabled, LEG);
  ok(scn, 'nothing changed → «Αποθήκευση» disabled', await disabled());
  await page.fill(`${LEG} [data-nat="3001"] [data-f="price"]`, '310');
  await page.fill(`${LEG} [data-nat="3004"] [data-f="price"]`, '200');
  ok(scn, 'two orders changed → disabled, with the line that says why', await disabled() && /μία «Αποθήκευση» στέλνει μία/.test(await K.text(page, `${LEG} [data-err]`)));
  await page.fill(`${LEG} [data-nat="3004"] [data-f="price"]`, '');
  ok(scn, 'one order changed → enabled', !(await disabled()));
  await page.click(`${LEG} [data-act="save"]`);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  const p = K.planOf(S, 'PATCH', /^\/plan\/orders\/\d+$/);
  ok(scn, 'one save = ONE PATCH /plan/orders/3001 {set:{price:310}}', p.length === 1 && p[0].path === '/plan/orders/3001' && JSON.stringify(p[0].body) === JSON.stringify({ set: { price: 310 } }), p.map((x) => [x.path, x.body]));
  ok(scn, 'mixed_temp from the answer → warning line after the save', await K.count(page, `${LEG} .wn5-strip[data-kind="warning"]`) >= 1);
  ok(scn, 'the VS never sends PATCH /plan/orders', !S.plan.some((x) => x.m === 'PATCH' && x.path === '/plan/orders/2101'));
  // a refusal keeps the form open with the Worker's text
  await page.click(`${LEG} .wn5f-ft [data-act="cancel"]`);
  await openLegBy(page, 101, 'KATHODOS');
  await page.fill(`${LEG} [data-nat="3001"] [data-f="price"]`, '315');
  await page.click(`${LEG} [data-act="save"]`);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  ok(scn, '422 vs_locked → the Worker message, form open', /rig sentinel vs_locked/.test(await K.text(page, `${LEG} [data-strip]`)) && await K.count(page, LEG) === 1);
  await page.click(`${LEG} [data-vs="2101"] [data-act="move"]`);
  await page.waitForSelector('.wi4-dlg[data-wn5="move"]', { timeout: 6000 }).catch(() => {});
  ok(scn, '«Μεταφορά σε…» closes the leg form and opens the move window', await K.count(page, LEG) === 0 && await K.count(page, '.wi4-dlg[data-wn5="move"]') === 1);
  ok(scn, 'no page errors', !S.pageErrors.length, S.pageErrors);
  await page.context().close();
}
async function scnLegAnodos({ browser, origin, ok, scn }) {
  const { page, S } = await K.openApp(browser, origin);
  if (!(await guard(page, ok, scn))) return;
  await openLegBy(page, 102, 'ANODOS');
  ok(scn, 'the ANODOS leg form of RT-T102 opened', await K.count(page, LEG) === 1);
  const h = await K.text(page, `${LEG} .wn5f-head`);
  ok(scn, 'header «Κάθοδος» «Χωρίς κάθοδο»', h.includes('Κάθοδος') && h.includes('Χωρίς κάθοδο'), h);
  ok(scn, 'header «Άφιξη Βέροιας» «Τετ 14/10 · 22:00»', h.includes('Άφιξη Βέροιας') && h.includes('Τετ 14/10 · 22:00'), h);
  const b = await K.text(page, `${LEG} [data-nat="3003"]`);
  ok(scn, '«ΠΡΟΟΡΙΣΜΟΣ» with «Άφιξη ως *»', b.includes('ΠΡΟΟΡΙΣΜΟΣ') && b.includes('Άφιξη ως *'), b.slice(0, 300));
  const seq = await K.text(page, `${LEG} .wn5f-seq`);
  ok(scn, 'the order of stops ends «ως Τετ 22:00 · Βέροια · τέλος κύκλου»', seq.includes('ως Τετ 22:00') && seq.includes('Βέροια · τέλος κύκλου'), seq);
  await page.click(`${LEG} [data-act="time"]`);
  await page.waitForSelector('[data-wn5="date"]', { timeout: 6000 }).catch(() => {});
  ok(scn, '«Αλλαγή ώρας ›» opens the day panel (Δ4), not a save of this form', await K.count(page, '[data-wn5="date"]') === 1 && !S.plan.some((x) => x.m === 'PATCH' && /^\/plan\/orders\//.test(x.path)));
  await page.context().close();
}
```

Με το εργαλείο Edit, αντικατέστησε τη γραμμή
`  window.WN5Form = Object.freeze({ openOrder, _body, _check, _patchBody, _findOrders, _iso, _parts });`
με:

```js
  // ── the leg form (T21): Figma 2011:9294, Δ7 2069:7746 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // A VS is the international's (price, invoicing, its pallets and windows change there: decision 21, vs_locked);
  // a national order is edited here, ONE order per «Αποθήκευση» (Ε-4: one save = one RPC = one transaction);
  // moving goes through «Μεταφορά σε…» (WN5Act.move, its own dry run and list), never a delete; the stop times
  // change from the day panel (Δ4, WN5Act.datePanel), never from this save.
  function _hubId() { try { return PlanIds.id('location', _hubRec()); } catch (_) { return null; } }
  const _hm = (iso) => (_parts(iso) || {}).hm || '—';
  // Pure: the cycle of the board (072 plan_board shape) → what the form shows. hubId = the hub's numeric id or null.
  function _legModel(cyc, side, hubId) {
    const all = (cyc.stops || []).slice().sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
    const stops = all.filter((s) => s.side === side);
    const isHub = (s) => hubId != null && s.location_id === hubId;
    const blocks = new Map();
    const pieces = new Set();
    let total = 0;
    for (const s of stops) for (const l of s.legs || []) {
      pieces.add(l.piece_id);
      const vs = l.kind === 'vs_import' || l.kind === 'vs_export';
      const key = vs ? 'vs:' + l.order_id : 'n:' + l.nat_order_id;
      let b = blocks.get(key);
      if (!b) {
        b = { key, vs, order_id: l.order_id, nat_order_id: l.nat_order_id, reference: l.reference || '', client: l.client || '', client_id: l.client_id,
          temps: [], loads: [], drops: [], pallets: 0, pieces: [], price: l.price === undefined ? null : l.price,
          pallet_exchange: typeof l.pallet_exchange === 'boolean' ? l.pallet_exchange : null };
        blocks.set(key, b);
      }
      if (l.temperature_c != null && !b.temps.includes(l.temperature_c)) b.temps.push(l.temperature_c);
      if (!b.pieces.includes(l.piece_id)) b.pieces.push(l.piece_id);
      const row = { stop_id: s.stop_id, location: s.location, location_id: s.location_id, day: s.stop_day, from: s.planned_from, to: s.planned_to,
        pallets: l.pallets, piece_id: l.piece_id, hub: isHub(s), order_stop_id: l.order_stop_id === undefined ? null : l.order_stop_id };
      if (l.act === 'load') { b.loads.push(row); b.pallets += l.pallets; total += l.pallets; } else b.drops.push(row);
    }
    const hubStop = stops.find(isHub) || null;
    const end = side === 'ANODOS' ? (stops.filter(isHub).pop() || null) : null;
    const others = all.filter((s) => s.side !== side);
    const vehicle = cyc.trip_type === 'PARTNER' ? (cyc.partner || 'Συνεργάτης') : (cyc.truck || 'χωρίς φορτηγό');
    const first = side === 'KATHODOS' ? (hubStop || stops[0]) : stops[0];
    const bl = [...blocks.values()];
    const loaded = bl.filter((b) => b.pallets > 0);
    const seq = stops.slice().sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a.planned_from) - Date.parse(b.planned_from)).map((s) => {
      const legs = s.legs || [];
      const isEnd = !!end && s.stop_id === end.stop_id;
      return { stop_id: s.stop_id, when: isEnd ? `ως ${_dow(s.stop_day)} ${_hm(s.planned_to)}` : `${_dow(s.stop_day)} ${_hm(s.planned_from)}–${_hm(s.planned_to)}`,
        place: isHub(s) ? (isEnd ? 'Βέροια · τέλος κύκλου' : 'Βέροια') : s.location,
        what: [...new Set(legs.map((l) => l.reference).filter(Boolean))].join(' · ') + (isEnd ? ' · άφιξη' : legs.some((l) => l.act === 'load') ? ' · φόρτωση' : ' · παράδοση'),
        pallets: legs.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.act === (isEnd || !legs.some((x) => x.act === 'load') ? 'unload' : 'load') ? l.pallets : 0), 0) };
    });
    return {
      side, stops, blocks: bl, shipments: pieces.size, total, hubStop, end, vehicle, seq,
      plates: cyc.trip_type === 'PARTNER' ? (cyc.partner || '—') : [cyc.truck, cyc.trailer].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—',
      day: first ? first.stop_day : null,
      cap: (loaded.length > 1 ? loaded.map((b) => _pal(b.pallets)).join(' + ') + ' = ' : '') + `${_pal(total)}/33`,
      head: side === 'KATHODOS'
        ? [['Κατεύθυνση', 'ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ'], ['Φόρτωση Βέροιας', hubStop ? _dlab(hubStop.stop_day) : '—'],
           ['Παράθυρο Βέροιας', hubStop ? `${_hm(hubStop.planned_from)}–${_hm(hubStop.planned_to)}` : '—']]
        : [['Κατεύθυνση', 'ΑΝΟΔΟΣ'], ['Κάθοδος', others.length ? 'ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ ' + _dlab(others[0].stop_day) : 'Χωρίς κάθοδο'],
           ['Άφιξη Βέροιας', end ? `${_dlab((_parts(end.planned_to) || {}).day)} · ${_hm(end.planned_to)}` : '—']],
    };
  }
  const _tempTxt = (ts) => (ts.length ? ts.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).map((t) => (t > 0 ? '+' : '') + t).join(' / ') + ' °C' : '—');
  function _roRowHTML(r, withMove) {
    return `<div class="wn5f-row ro" data-piece="${r.piece_id}"><span>${_esc(r.hub ? 'Βέροια' : r.location)}</span><span>${_esc(_dlab(r.day))}</span>`
      + `<span>${_hm(r.from)} – ${_hm(r.to)}</span><span>${_pal(r.pallets)}</span>`
      + (withMove ? `<button type="button" class="wi4-btn sm" data-act="move" data-piece="${r.piece_id}">Μεταφορά σε…</button>` : '<span></span>') + '</div>';
  }
  function _vsBlockHTML(f, b) {
    const rows = f.m.side === 'KATHODOS' ? b.drops.filter((r) => !r.hub) : b.loads.filter((r) => !r.hub);
    return `<div class="wn5f-ord wn5f-lock" data-vs="${b.order_id}">`
      + `<div class="wn5f-ord-h"><span><b>${_esc(b.reference || 'VS')} · ${_esc(b.client)}</b> <span class="wn5f-sub">· από διεθνή παραγγελία · ${_tempTxt(b.temps)}</span></span>`
      + `<span class="wn5f-badge">ημέρα · προορισμός · παράθυρο κλειδωμένο</span></div>`
      + `<div class="wn5f-sec">${f.m.side === 'KATHODOS' ? 'ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΕΙΣ' : 'ΦΟΡΤΩΣΕΙΣ'}</div>`
      + `<div class="wn5f-th ro"><span>Τοποθεσία</span><span>Ημέρα</span><span>Παράθυρο από – έως *</span><span>Παλέτες</span><span></span></div>`
      + rows.map((r) => _roRowHTML(r, true)).join('')
      + `<div class="wn5f-note">${_pal(b.pallets || rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r.pallets, 0))}π · τιμή και τιμολόγηση στη διεθνή παραγγελία · δεν διαγράφεται από εδώ · ημέρα και προορισμός: όποιος μάθει πρώτος — γράφεται και στη διεθνή, ο διεθνών ειδοποιείται</div></div>`;
  }
  function _natBlockHTML(f, b) {
    const id = b.nat_order_id;
    const anodosEnd = f.m.side === 'ANODOS' ? b.drops.filter((r) => r.hub) : [];
    const drops = f.m.side === 'ANODOS' ? b.drops.filter((r) => !r.hub) : b.drops;
    return `<div class="wn5f-ord" data-nat="${id}">`
      + `<div class="wn5f-grid4"><div class="wn5f-f"><span>Πελάτης *</span><span class="wn5f-ro">${_esc(b.client || '—')}</span></div>`
      + `<label class="wn5f-f"><span>Τιμή € (χωρίς ΦΠΑ) *</span><input class="form-input" data-f="price" inputmode="decimal" value="${b.price == null ? '' : _esc(b.price)}" placeholder="${b.price == null ? 'χωρίς αλλαγή' : ''}"></label>`
      + `<label class="wn5f-f"><span>Θερμοκρασία °C</span><input class="form-input" data-f="temp" inputmode="decimal" value="${b.temps.length === 1 ? _esc(b.temps[0]) : ''}"></label>`
      + `<div class="wn5f-f"><span>PE</span>${_peHTML(b.pallet_exchange)}</div></div>`
      + `<div class="wn5f-grid3"><label class="wn5f-f"><span>Αναφορά</span><input class="form-input" data-f="ref" value="${_esc(b.reference)}"></label>`
      + `<label class="wn5f-f"><span>Είδος</span><input class="form-input" data-f="goods"></label><label class="wn5f-f"><span>Σημειώσεις</span><input class="form-input" data-f="notes"></label></div>`
      + (b.price == null ? '<div class="wn5f-note">Η τιμή δεν έρχεται με το board για παραγγελία σε κύκλο — γράψε τιμή μόνο για να την αλλάξεις.</div>' : '')
      + `<div class="wn5f-sec">ΣΗΜΕΙΑ ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗΣ</div>` + b.loads.map((r) => _roRowHTML(r, false)).join('')
      + (drops.length ? `<div class="wn5f-sec">ΣΗΜΕΙΑ ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΗΣ</div>` + drops.map((r) => _roRowHTML(r, false)).join('') : '')
      + (anodosEnd.length ? `<div class="wn5f-sec">ΠΡΟΟΡΙΣΜΟΣ</div><div class="wn5f-th ro"><span>Τοποθεσία</span><span>Ημέρα</span><span>Άφιξη ως *</span><span>Παλέτες</span><span></span></div>`
        + anodosEnd.map((r) => `<div class="wn5f-row ro"><span>Βέροια</span><span>${_esc(_dlab(r.day))}</span><span>${_hm(r.to)}</span><span>${_pal(r.pallets)}</span>`
          + `<button type="button" class="wi4-btn sm" data-act="time">Αλλαγή ώρας ›</button></div>`).join('') : '')
      + `<div class="wn5f-acts"><button type="button" class="wi4-btn sm" data-act="move-order" data-nat="${id}">Μεταφορά σε… (όλη η παραγγελία)</button>`
      + `<button type="button" class="wi4-btn sm" data-act="card" data-nat="${id}">Άνοιγμα καρτέλας ›</button></div>`
      + `<div class="wn5f-note">#${_esc(b.reference || id)} · ${_pal(b.pallets)}π · τιμολογείται χωριστά · η διαγραφή γίνεται από την καρτέλα: λίστα παραστατικών + επιβεβαίωση, χωρίς επαναφορά</div></div>`;
  }
  function _legHTML(f) {
    const m = f.m;
    return `<div class="wn5f-head">` + m.head.concat([['Φορτηγό', m.plates]]).map(([k, v]) => `<div class="wn5f-f"><span>${k}</span><span class="wn5f-ro">${_esc(v)}</span></div>`).join('') + `</div>`
      + m.blocks.map((b) => (b.vs ? _vsBlockHTML(f, b) : _natBlockHTML(f, b))).join('')
      + `<div class="wn5f-sum"><div class="wn5f-sum-h"><b>${m.shipments} ${m.shipments === 1 ? 'αποστολή' : 'αποστολές'} · ίδιο σκέλος · ${_esc(m.vehicle)}</b><span>${_esc(m.cap)}</span></div>`
      + `<div class="wn5f-sec">ΣΕΙΡΑ ΣΤΑΣΕΩΝ ΚΑΤΑ ΩΡΑ</div><ol class="wn5f-seq">`
      + m.seq.map((x) => `<li><span>${_esc(x.when)}</span><span>${_esc(x.place)}</span><span>${_esc(x.what)}</span><span>${_pal(x.pallets)}π</span></li>`).join('')
      + `</ol><div class="wn5f-note">Σε άλλο φορτηγό: «Μεταφορά σε…» — VS ανά παράδοση, εθνική όλη η παραγγελία· η ίδια παραγγελία μετακινείται, δεν σβήνεται, δεν ξαναγράφεται.</div></div>`;
  }
  function _legState(f, id) {
    const el = f.el.querySelector(`[data-nat="${id}"]`);
    const v = (k) => el.querySelector(`[data-f="${k}"]`).value;
    const peh = el.querySelector('[data-peh]').dataset.peh;
    return { price: _num(v('price')), temperature_c: _num(v('temp')), reference: v('ref').trim(), goods: v('goods').trim(), notes: v('notes').trim(),
      pallet_exchange: peh === 'yes' ? true : peh === 'no' ? false : null, ships: [] };
  }
  function _legChanged(f) {
    return Object.keys(f.orig).map(Number).filter((id) => {
      const b = _patchBody(f.orig[id], _legState(f, id));
      return !!(b.set || b.shipments);
    });
  }
  function _legRefresh(f) {
    const ch = _legChanged(f);
    f.blocked = ch.length !== 1;
    _lines(f, ch.length > 1 ? [`Άλλαξαν ${ch.length} παραγγελίες — μία «Αποθήκευση» στέλνει μία: κράτησε τις αλλαγές της μίας, αποθήκευσε, μετά την επόμενη`] : []);
  }
  async function _saveLeg(f) {
    if (f.busy || f.done || f.locked || f.blocked) return;
    const ch = _legChanged(f);
    if (ch.length !== 1) return;
    const id = ch[0];
    const st = _legState(f, id);
    if (st.price !== null && !(Number.isFinite(st.price) && st.price > 0)) { _lines(f, ['Τιμή € (χωρίς ΦΠΑ) *: αριθμός πάνω από 0']); return; }
    if (Number.isNaN(st.temperature_c)) { _lines(f, ['Θερμοκρασία °C: αριθμός']); return; }
    const body = _patchBody(f.orig[id], st);
    f.busy = true;
    _setSave(f);
    try {
      const ans = await planFetch('PATCH', '/plan/orders/' + id, { body });
      _done(f, ans, null);
      f.el.querySelector('[data-done]').textContent = `Αποθηκεύτηκε · #${f.orig[id].reference || id}`;
    } catch (e) { await _failed(f, e, null); }
    finally { f.busy = false; _setSave(f); }
  }
  function _legAct(f, a, t) {
    const rt = f.rtId;
    const anchor = () => document.querySelector(`#content .wn5-row[data-rt="${rt}"]`) || document.querySelector('#content .wn5');
    if (a === 'move') { _close(f); WN5Act.move({ piece_ids: [Number(t.dataset.piece)], rt_id: rt }, { side: f.side, entry: 'leg' }); return; }
    if (a === 'move-order') {
      // a national order moves whole (Figma 9294): every piece of it on this cycle, both sides
      const id = Number(t.dataset.nat);
      const ids = [];
      for (const s of f.cyc.stops || []) for (const l of s.legs || []) if (l.nat_order_id === id && !ids.includes(l.piece_id)) ids.push(l.piece_id);
      _close(f);
      WN5Act.move({ piece_ids: ids, rt_id: rt }, { side: f.side, entry: 'leg' });
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'card') { _close(f); WN5Act.orderCard(Number(t.dataset.nat)); return; }
    if (a === 'time') { _close(f); WN5Act.datePanel(rt, 'ANODOS', anchor()); }
  }
  async function openLeg(rtId, side) {
    const board = await _board();
    const cyc = board && (board.cycles || []).find((c) => c.rt_id === rtId);
    if (!cyc || (side !== 'KATHODOS' && side !== 'ANODOS')) {
      if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Ο κύκλος δεν βρέθηκε στην εβδομάδα που φαίνεται — ανανέωσε', 'warn');
      return false;
    }
    const ids = await PlanIds.load();
    const m = _legModel(cyc, side, _hubId());
    const f = { kind: 'leg', rtId, side, cyc, m, busy: false, done: false, locked: false, blocked: true, orig: {},
      onSave: _saveLeg, onRefresh: _legRefresh, onAct: _legAct };
    for (const b of m.blocks) if (!b.vs) f.orig[b.nat_order_id] = { nat_order_id: b.nat_order_id, price: b.price, reference: b.reference,
      temperature_c: b.temps.length === 1 ? b.temps[0] : null, pallet_exchange: b.pallet_exchange, goods: '', notes: '', ships: [] };
    _open(f, `Σκέλος · ${SIDE_GR[side]} ${_esc(m.vehicle)} · ${_esc(m.day ? _dlab(m.day) : '—')}`,
      `· ${m.shipments} ${m.shipments === 1 ? 'αποστολή' : 'αποστολές'}`, _legHTML(f), 'Μία «Αποθήκευση» = μία συναλλαγή.');
    f.el.querySelector('[data-cap]').textContent = m.cap;
    if (!ids.ok) WN5Act.strip(_strip(f), ids.err);
    if (_closedErr) { WN5Act.strip(_strip(f), _closedErr); f.locked = true; }
    _refresh(f);
    return true;
  }

  window.WN5Form = Object.freeze({ openOrder, openLeg, _body, _check, _patchBody, _findOrders, _iso, _parts, _legModel });
```

### Task T22: VS — ημέρα, προορισμός, ειδοποίηση

**Batch:** C · **Gate:** none

**Files:**
- Modify: `modules/wn5_forms.js` (μπλοκ VS της φόρμας σκέλους), `tests/critics/wn5-form-rig.js` (σενάριο `vs`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `planFetch` (T1), `PlanIds.id('location', …)` (T12)
- Produces: `WN5Form.vsDay(orderId, day)` → `POST /plan/vs/day` `{order_id, day}` (κελί «Ημέρα» του μπλοκ VS, Ε-13)· `WN5Form.vsPlace(orderStopId, locationId)` → `POST /plan/vs/place`· μετά το 200: «η ημέρα γράφτηκε και στη διεθνή, ο διεθνών ειδοποιήθηκε» από τα `notice_ids`

**Tests (rig `vs`):**
- κάθε αλλαγή = ένα POST, εκτός της «Αποθήκευσης» της φόρμας· `vs_day_differs` → γραμμή προειδοποίησης· `vs_not_bridge` / `order_gone` → μήνυμα· ο προορισμός δεν δέχεται τη Βέροια (επιλογέας χωρίς τον κόμβο)· στο main ✗.

**Acceptance:** rig `vs` → `GO`.

**Τι κάνει αυτός ο Task:** στο μπλοκ VS της φόρμας σκέλους, τα δύο πράγματα που αλλάζει ο εθνικός «όποιος μάθει πρώτος» (S-104, S-107): η **ημέρα** του VS (`WN5Form.vsDay(orderId, day)` → `POST /plan/vs/day {order_id, day}`, μία στήλη `orders.cross_dock_date`) και ο **προορισμός** μετά τη Βέροια (`WN5Form.vsPlace(orderStopId, locationId)` → `POST /plan/vs/place {order_stop_id, location_id}`). Κάθε αλλαγή = **ένα** POST, με δικό της κουμπί, ποτέ μέσα στην «Αποθήκευση» της φόρμας (Ε-4). Μετά το 200 η φόρμα λέει από τα `notice_ids` ότι «η ημέρα γράφτηκε και στη διεθνή, ο διεθνών ειδοποιήθηκε»· `vs_day_differs` = γραμμή προειδοποίησης.

**Αποφάσεις του Task:**
- Ο επιλογέας προορισμού **δεν** προσφέρει τη Βέροια (`WN5Form._locDropNoHub`, ίδιος κανόνας αναζήτησης με το `fhLocDrop`)· αν φτάσει ο κόμβος από αλλού (επικόλληση), η φόρμα αρνείται τοπικά και δεν στέλνει τίποτα (072 `plan_vs_set_place`: «location_id (not the hub)»).
- Το 072 board **δεν** φέρνει `order_stop_id` στα σκέλη κύκλων (μόνο στα `waiting[]`/`hub[]`): όσο λείπει, το «Αλλαγή προορισμού» μένει ανενεργό με γραμμή που το λέει (αρχή 1)· μόλις ο Worker το φέρει στα `legs[]` (αίτημα στην αλυσίδα, βλ. Doubts), ενεργοποιείται χωρίς αλλαγή κώδικα. Η ημέρα θέλει μόνο το `order_id`, που υπάρχει.
- Προορισμός αλλάζει μόνο σε VS εισαγωγής (ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ): το `plan_vs_set_place` είναι «ο προορισμός μετά τη Βέροια» (072:2064).
- «Ίδια ημέρα» = `notice_ids` κενό: η βάση δεν ειδοποιεί όταν η ημέρα δεν αλλάζει (072:2045)· η οθόνη το λέει, δεν το μαντεύει.

```js
      const box = t.closest('[data-vs]');
      vsDay(Number(t.dataset.order), box.querySelector('[data-f="vsday"]').value);
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'vs-place') {
      const rec = (document.getElementById('lv_' + t.dataset.pid) || {}).value || '';
      if (!rec) { _lines(f, ['Προορισμός: διάλεξε τοποθεσία από τη λίστα']); return; }
      let loc;
      try { loc = PlanIds.id('location', rec); }
      catch (e) { WN5Act.strip(_strip(f), e); return; }
      vsPlace(Number(t.dataset.osid), loc);
    }
```

(γ) Με Edit, αντικατέστησε τη γραμμή εξαγωγής του T21
`  window.WN5Form = Object.freeze({ openOrder, openLeg, _body, _check, _patchBody, _findOrders, _iso, _parts, _legModel });`
με:

```js
  // ── VS day / destination (T22) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The places list without the hub: Veroia is never a VS destination after Veroia (072 plan_vs_set_place).
  // Same filter rule as fhLocDrop (form-helpers.js: _fhNorm over the label), only the hub left out.
  function _locDropNoHub(id, q) {
    const hub = _hubRec();
    const nq = typeof _fhNorm === 'function' ? _fhNorm(String(q || '').trim()) : String(q || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const pool = _fhLocationsArr.filter((o) => o.id !== hub && (!nq || (o._n || (o._n = _fhNorm(o.label))).includes(nq))).slice(0, 25);
    fhShowDrop('ls_' + id + '_d', id, pool);
  }
  // The outcome line of a VS change, from the answer: a notice means the international desk was told; none means
  // the base changed nothing there (072:2045 «the same day again … tells nobody»).
  function _vsOk(f, ans, withNotice, without, sel) {
    const line = f.el.querySelector(sel);
    if (line) line.textContent = Array.isArray(ans.notice_ids) && ans.notice_ids.length ? withNotice : without;
    if (Array.isArray(ans.warnings) && ans.warnings.length) WN5Act.strip(_strip(f), ans.warnings);
    else _strip(f).innerHTML = '';
    _lines(f, []);
  }
  async function _vsSend(path, body, withNotice, without, where, sel) {
    const f = _f && _f.kind === 'leg' ? _f : null;
    if (f) { if (f.busy) return null; f.busy = true; _setSave(f); }
    try {
      const ans = await planFetch('POST', path, { body });
      if (f) _vsOk(f, ans, withNotice, without, sel);
      WN5.reload(where);
      return ans;
    } catch (e) {
      if (f) await _failed(f, e, null);
      else {
        // vsDay / vsPlace are public: called with no leg form open, the answer still reaches the user — the board's
        // strip with the Worker's words (principle 1). A PlanError was already logged by planFetch when it is not a
        // designed refusal (a 422/409 is never an app error); only a fault of this screen's own code is logged here.
        const host = WN5Act._kit && typeof WN5Act._kit.boardHost === 'function' ? WN5Act._kit.boardHost() : null;
        if (host) WN5Act.strip(host, e);
        if (!(typeof PlanError === 'function' && e instanceof PlanError)) _log(e, 'WN5Form.' + where);
      }
      return null;
    } finally {
      if (f) { f.busy = false; _setSave(f); }
    }
  }
  function vsDay(orderId, day) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(orderId) || !DAY.test(String(day || ''))) {
      if (_f && _f.kind === 'leg') _lines(_f, ['Ημέρα: διάλεξε ημέρα']);
      return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    return _vsSend('/plan/vs/day', { order_id: orderId, day }, 'Η ημέρα γράφτηκε και στη διεθνή, ο διεθνών ειδοποιήθηκε',
      'Ίδια ημέρα — η διεθνής δεν άλλαξε, καμία ειδοποίηση', 'vs-day', `[data-vs="${orderId}"] [data-vsok]`);
  }
  function vsPlace(orderStopId, locationId) {
    const f = _f && _f.kind === 'leg' ? _f : null;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(orderStopId) || !Number.isSafeInteger(locationId)) { if (f) _lines(f, ['Προορισμός: διάλεξε τοποθεσία από τη λίστα']); return Promise.resolve(null); }
    if (locationId === _hubId()) { if (f) _lines(f, ['Η Βέροια δεν είναι προορισμός VS — διάλεξε τον τόπο παράδοσης μετά τη Βέροια']); return Promise.resolve(null); }
    return _vsSend('/plan/vs/place', { order_stop_id: orderStopId, location_id: locationId }, 'Ο προορισμός γράφτηκε και στη διεθνή, ο διεθνών ειδοποιήθηκε',
      'Ίδιος προορισμός — η διεθνής δεν άλλαξε', 'vs-place', `[data-vs]:has([data-osid="${orderStopId}"]) [data-vsok]`);
  }

  window.WN5Form = Object.freeze({ openOrder, openLeg, vsDay, vsPlace, _locDropNoHub, _body, _check, _patchBody, _findOrders, _iso, _parts, _legModel });
```

```js
// node --test tests/wn5-sheet.test.js

// Why: the sheet leaves the building — no price, no partner rate, no amount, and Veroia only as «Αποθήκη
// Βέροιας» (the hub is never shown to a client); every unknown is «—», never an empty cell (Δ12, principle 2);
// a <table> with table-layout:fixed and a colspan larger than its colgroup adds phantom columns (S4 15/9).
// The REAL core/wi4-logic.js, modules/wn5_forms.js (time helpers) and modules/wn5_sheet.js run in a vm.
// On plain main: ENOENT … modules/wn5_sheet.js.
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = process.env.TMS_ROOT ? path.resolve(process.env.TMS_ROOT) : path.join(__dirname, '..');
const FILE = 'modules/wn5_sheet.js';
const SRC = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, FILE), 'utf8');
const J = (x) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));

function load(withDeps) {
  const acts = [];
  const rec = (w) => () => { acts.push(w); return 0; };
  const win = { addEventListener: rec('window.addEventListener') };
  const ctx = { console: { log() {}, info() {}, warn() {}, error() {}, debug() {} }, window: win, Intl, Date, Math, JSON, Object, Array, String, Number, Map, Set, Promise, Error, RegExp, Symbol,
    setTimeout: rec('setTimeout'), setInterval: rec('setInterval'), fetch: rec('fetch'), addEventListener: rec('addEventListener'),
    MutationObserver: function () { acts.push('MutationObserver'); },
    document: { addEventListener: rec('document.addEventListener'), createElement: rec('document.createElement'), querySelector: rec('document.querySelector'), body: { appendChild: rec('body.appendChild') } } };
  vm.createContext(ctx);
  if (withDeps) {
    vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'core/wi4-logic.js'), 'utf8'), ctx, { filename: 'core/wi4-logic.js' });
    ctx.WI4 = win.WI4;
    vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'modules/wn5_forms.js'), 'utf8'), ctx, { filename: 'modules/wn5_forms.js' });
    ctx.WN5Form = win.WN5Form;
  }
  const before = Object.keys(win);
  vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { filename: FILE });
  return { acts, added: Object.keys(win).filter((k) => !before.includes(k)), S: win.WN5Sheet };
}
const { S } = load(true);

const L = (leg_id, piece_id, act, pallets, o) => Object.assign({ leg_id, piece_id, act, pallets, kind: 'national', order_id: null, nat_order_id: 1, reference: 'N-T1', client_id: 41, client: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Α', temperature_c: 2 }, o);
const ST = (stop_id, seq, side, location_id, from, to, legs) => ({ stop_id, seq, side, location_id, location: 'LOC ' + location_id, planned_from: from, planned_to: to, stop_day: from.slice(0, 10), legs });
const VS = { kind: 'vs_import', order_id: 2101, nat_order_id: null, reference: 'REF-INT-118', client: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Β', temperature_c: 2 };
const CYC = { rt_id: 101, code: 'RT-T101', trip_type: 'OWNED', truck: 'TST-2104', trailer: 'TRL-5102', driver: 'Driver Test 01', partner: null, partner_rate: 777.5,
  stops: [

    ST(1002, 2, 'KATHODOS', 2, '2026-10-13T06:00:00+03:00', '2026-10-13T08:00:00+03:00', [L(1, 11, 'unload', 21, VS)]),
    ST(1003, 3, 'KATHODOS', 3, '2026-10-13T07:00:00+03:00', '2026-10-13T09:00:00+03:00', [L(2, 12, 'unload', 6, { reference: 'N-T001', temperature_c: null })]),
    ST(1004, 4, 'ANODOS', 3, '2026-10-13T12:00:00+03:00', '2026-10-13T14:00:00+03:00', [L(3, 13, 'load', 20, { reference: 'N-T002', client: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Γ', temperature_c: 4 })]),
    ST(1005, 5, 'ANODOS', 1, '2026-10-13T20:00:00+03:00', '2026-10-13T22:00:00+03:00', [L(3, 13, 'unload', 20, { reference: 'N-T002', client: 'ΠΕΛΑΤΗΣ Γ', temperature_c: 4 })])] };
const PL = { hubId: 1, byId: {
  1: { name: 'ΒΕΡΟΙΑ TEST', address: 'Test Industrial Area 1, 59100', city: 'Veria', phone: 'TEST-PHONE-01' },

  const s3 = ls.find((l) => l.stop_id === 1003);   // location 3 is not in the catalogue, the leg has no temperature
  assert.deepStrictEqual([s3.address, s3.phone, s3.temp, s3.pe], ['—', '—', '—', '—']);
  for (const l of ls) for (const k of ['name', 'address', 'phone', 'window', 'temp', 'pe', 'refs']) assert.ok(String(l[k]).trim() !== '', `${l.stop_id}.${k} empty`);
});

test('F4α-T23: every <table> colspan equals its <colgroup> count', () => {
  const a4 = S.html(S.lines(CYC, PL, 'ALL'), META, '');
  const tables = a4.split('<table').slice(1);
  assert.ok(tables.length >= 2, 'one table per section');
  for (const t of tables) {
    const cols = (t.split('</colgroup>')[0].match(/<col\b/g) || []).length;
    const spans = [...t.matchAll(/colspan="(\d+)"/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
    assert.ok(cols > 0, 'a table without colgroup');
    for (const s of spans) assert.strictEqual(s, cols, `colspan ${s} ≠ ${cols} cols`);
  }
});

test('F4α-T23: a VS stop carries the reference of the international (legs[].reference), nothing derived', () => {
  const ls = J(S.lines(CYC, PL, 'KATHODOS')).filter((l) => l.t === 'stop');
  assert.strictEqual(ls.find((l) => l.stop_id === 1002).refs, 'REF-INT-118');
});

test('F4α-T23: the module has no hex colour (the A4 takes the tokens\' values)', () => {
  assert.ok(!/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/.test(SRC.replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g, '')), 'hex in modules/wn5_sheet.js');
});
```

Create `modules/wn5_sheet.js`:

```js
// National v5 F4α — the driver sheet per cycle (A4) and the same as a WhatsApp text (Figma KO7l2AfucR3HJEDIg1Yptr
// 2011:10998, Δ10; per segment = T27, H5 2128:7735). One global: WN5Sheet. Read only.
// Rules (Δ10, spec §L): no price, no partner rate, no amount — the sheet leaves the building; Veroia only as «Αποθήκη
// Βέροιας», our own warehouse for the driver (the hub is never shown to a client); per stop: address, phone,
// window from–to, pallets, temperature, pallet return, reference (a VS: the international's, legs[].reference);
// every unknown is «—», never an empty cell. The pure core (lines / text / html) runs in node tests; print() reads
// the board and the catalogues (PlanIds, Ε-2) and opens the print window; nothing happens at load.
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const SIDE_GR = Object.freeze({ KATHODOS: 'ΚΑΘΟΔΟΣ', ANODOS: 'ΑΝΟΔΟΣ' });
  // The print window loads no style.css: these tokens' values travel with it, so the A4 keeps one colour source.
  const TOKENS = ['--surface-dark', '--surface-card', '--accent', '--accent-text', '--text-mid', '--text-dim', '--border'];
  const _esc = (s) => String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[c]);
  const _log = (e, where) => { try { if (typeof logError === 'function') logError(e, where); } catch (_) { /* the sheet's own failure stays visible */ } };
  const _parts = (iso) => (typeof WN5Form !== 'undefined' ? WN5Form._parts(iso) : null);
  const _dlab = (day) => (typeof WI4 !== 'undefined' && WI4.dayLabel ? WI4.dayLabel(day) : String(day || ''));
  const _dow = (day) => _dlab(day).split(' ')[0];
  const _hm = (iso) => (_parts(iso) || {}).hm || '—';
  const _pal = (n) => String(Math.round((Number(n) || 0) * 10) / 10).replace('.', ',');
  const _temp = (ts, sp) => (ts.length ? ts.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).map((t) => (t > 0 ? '+' : '') + t).join(sp ? ' / ' : '/') + (sp ? ' °C' : '°C') : '—');
  const _dash = (v) => (v == null || String(v).trim() === '' ? '—' : String(v));

  // The stops of one side, by seq (the order of the cycle).
  function _partStops(cycle, side) {
    return (cycle.stops || []).filter((s) => s.side === side).sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
  }
  function _stopLine(s, side, P, n) {
    const legs = s.legs || [];
    const loads = legs.filter((l) => l.act === 'load');
    const unloads = legs.filter((l) => l.act !== 'load');
    const hub = P.hubId != null && s.location_id === P.hubId;
    const end = hub && side === 'ANODOS' && !loads.length;
    const use = loads.length ? loads : unloads;
    const place = P.byId[s.location_id] || null;
    const temps = [...new Set(use.map((l) => l.temperature_c).filter((t) => t !== null && t !== undefined))];
    const clients = [...new Set(use.map((l) => l.client).filter(Boolean))];
    return {
      t: 'stop', n, side, stop_id: s.stop_id, location_id: s.location_id, hub, end,
      act: loads.length ? 'ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ' : end ? 'ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ' : 'ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΗ',
      name: hub ? 'Αποθήκη Βέροιας' + (end ? ' · τέλος κύκλου' : '') : (clients.join(' · ') || _dash(s.location)),
      address: _dash(place && place.address), city: (place && place.city) || '', phone: _dash(place && place.phone),
      window: end ? `ως ${_dow(s.stop_day)} ${_hm(s.planned_to)}` : `${_dow(s.stop_day)} ${_hm(s.planned_from)}–${_hm(s.planned_to)}`,
      pallets: use.reduce((a, l) => a + (Number(l.pallets) || 0), 0),
      temp: _temp(temps, true), tempWa: _temp(temps, false),
      pe: '—',   // Ε-12: the board carries no pallet return per stop yet (T28, F3)
      refs: _dash([...new Set(use.map((l) => l.reference).filter(Boolean))].join(' · ')),
    };
  }
  // part: 'KATHODOS' | 'ANODOS' | 'ALL'. places: { byId: {<location_id>: {name, address, city, phone}}, hubId }.
  function lines(cycle, places, part) {
    const P = { byId: (places && places.byId) || {}, hubId: places && places.hubId != null ? places.hubId : null };
    const partner = cycle.trip_type === 'PARTNER';
    const kStops = _partStops(cycle, 'KATHODOS');
    const vStop = kStops.find((s) => P.hubId != null && s.location_id === P.hubId && (s.legs || []).some((l) => l.act === 'load'));
    const out = [{ t: 'head', partner: partner ? _dash(cycle.partner) : null, driver: partner ? null : _dash(cycle.driver),
      truck: partner ? null : _dash(cycle.truck), trailer: partner ? null : _dash(cycle.trailer),
      veroia: vStop ? `${_dlab(vStop.stop_day)} · ${_hm(vStop.planned_from)}–${_hm(vStop.planned_to)}` : '—' }];
    let n = 0;
    let firstPallets = null;
    for (const side of part === 'ALL' ? ['KATHODOS', 'ANODOS'] : [part]) {
      const stops = _partStops(cycle, side);
      if (!stops.length) continue;
      const ls = stops.map((s) => _stopLine(s, side, P, ++n));
      // the heading names what the driver does at the stops that are not Veroia (Figma: «3 παραδόσεις», «3 φορτώσεις»)
      const own = ls.filter((l) => !l.hub);
      const count = own.length;
      const noun = own.length && own.every((l) => l.act === 'ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ') ? (count === 1 ? 'φόρτωση' : 'φορτώσεις')
        : own.length && own.every((l) => l.act === 'ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΗ') ? (count === 1 ? 'παράδοση' : 'παραδόσεις') : (count === 1 ? 'στάση' : 'στάσεις');
      const sum = (load) => stops.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.legs || []).filter((l) => (l.act === 'load') === load).reduce((b, l) => b + (Number(l.pallets) || 0), 0), 0);
      const pallets = sum(true) || sum(false);   // what is loaded on this side, or what is delivered when nothing is
      if (firstPallets === null) firstPallets = pallets;
      out.push({ t: 'side', side, title: SIDE_GR[side], count, noun, pallets, fromHub: !!ls[0].hub && ls[0].act === 'ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ' });
      out.push(...ls);
    }
    out.push({ t: 'check', pallets: firstPallets || 0 });
    return out;
  }
  const _street = (s) => String(s.address === '—' ? '' : s.address).split(',')[0].trim();
  // The WhatsApp text, line by line as Figma 2011:10998 («*» = bold in WhatsApp).
  function text(ls, meta) {
    const m = meta || {};
    const h = ls.find((l) => l.t === 'head') || {};
    const out = [h.partner ? `*${h.partner}*` : `*${[h.truck, h.trailer, h.driver].filter((x) => x && x !== '—').join(' · ')}*`,
      [m.week, m.cycleNo ? 'κύκλος ' + m.cycleNo : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')];
    for (const l of ls) {
      if (l.t === 'side') {
        out.push('', `*${l.title}* · ${l.fromHub ? 'φόρτωση Βέροια' : `${l.count} ${l.noun}`} · ${_pal(l.pallets)}π`);
      } else if (l.t === 'stop') {
        const tel = l.phone === '—' ? '' : ` · Τηλ. ${l.phone}`;
        if (l.hub) {
          out.push(`${l.n}) ${l.name} · ${l.window} · ${_pal(l.pallets)}π`);
          out.push(`   ${_street(l) || '—'}${tel}`);
          out.push(`   ${l.refs}`);
        } else {
          const where = [_street(l), l.city].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
          out.push(`${l.n}) ${l.name}${where ? ' · ' + where : ''}${tel}`);
          out.push('   ' + [l.window, `${_pal(l.pallets)}π`, l.tempWa === '—' ? '' : l.tempWa, l.refs === '—' ? '' : l.refs, l.pe === '—' ? '' : l.pe + 'π'].filter(Boolean).join(' · '));
        }
      }
    }
    out.push('', 'Χάρτης ανά στάση: στον σύνδεσμο της εφαρμογής');
    return out.join('\n');
  }
  // The A4. One table per section: 7 columns, and its section row spans exactly those 7.
  function html(ls, meta, cssVars) {
    const m = meta || {};
    const h = ls.find((l) => l.t === 'head') || {};
    const chk = ls.find((l) => l.t === 'check') || { pallets: 0 };
    const band = (h.partner ? [['ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΤΗΣ', h.partner]] : [['ΟΔΗΓΟΣ', h.driver], ['ΦΟΡΤΗΓΟ', h.truck], ['ΡΥΜΟΥΛΚΑ', h.trailer]])
      .concat([['ΚΥΚΛΟΣ', _dash(m.cycleNo)], ['ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΒΕΡΟΙΑ', h.veroia]]);
    const COLS = '<colgroup><col style="width:8mm"><col><col style="width:30mm"><col style="width:15mm"><col style="width:20mm"><col style="width:24mm"><col style="width:36mm"></colgroup>';
    const TH = '<tr><th>#</th><th>ΣΤΑΣΗ</th><th>ΠΑΡΑΘΥΡΟ</th><th>ΠΑΛΕΤΕΣ</th><th>ΘΕΡΜ.</th><th>ΕΠΙΣΤΡΟΦΗ ΠΑΛΕΤΩΝ</th><th>ΑΝΑΦΟΡΑ</th></tr>';
    let body = '';
    let open = false;
    for (const l of ls) {
      if (l.t === 'side') {
        if (open) body += '</tbody></table>';
        body += `<table class="s-t">${COLS}<thead>${TH}</thead><tbody><tr><td colspan="7" class="s-sec">${_esc(l.title)} · ${l.count} ${_esc(l.noun)} · ${_pal(l.pallets)} παλέτες</td></tr>`;
        open = true;
      } else if (l.t === 'stop') {
        body += `<tr class="s-stop" data-side="${l.side}"><td><span class="s-n">${l.n}</span></td>`
          + `<td><span class="s-act">${l.act}</span> <b>${_esc(l.name)}</b><div class="s-adr">${_esc(l.address)}  ·  Τηλ. ${_esc(l.phone)}</div></td>`
          + `<td>${l.end ? 'Άφιξη<br>' : ''}${_esc(l.window)}</td><td>${_pal(l.pallets)}</td><td class="s-temp">${_esc(l.temp)}</td>`
          + `<td>${_esc(l.pe)}</td><td>${_esc(l.refs)}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }
    if (open) body += '</tbody></table>';
    return `<style>:root{${cssVars || ''}}
      .s{width:190mm;margin:0 auto;font:12px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--surface-dark)}
      .s-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:2px solid var(--surface-dark);padding-bottom:8px}
      .s-brand b{font:700 18px 'Syne',sans-serif;display:block}.s-brand span,.s-meta span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-mid)}
      .s-meta{text-align:right}.s-meta b{font:700 13px 'Syne',sans-serif;display:block}
      .s-band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(${band.length},1fr);gap:8px;background:var(--surface-dark);color:var(--surface-card);padding:8px 10px;margin:10px 0;border-radius:4px}
      .s-band div{color:var(--surface-card)}.s-band span{display:block;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-dim)}
      .s-t{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed;margin:6px 0 12px}
      .s-t th{font-size:9px;color:var(--text-mid);text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:2px 4px}
      .s-t td{vertical-align:top;padding:5px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
      .s-sec{font:700 12px 'Syne',sans-serif}
      .s-n{display:inline-block;width:18px;height:18px;line-height:18px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--surface-card);text-align:center;font-weight:700}
      .s-act{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:var(--surface-card);background:var(--accent);padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px}
      .s-adr{font-size:10px;color:var(--text-mid)}.s-temp{color:var(--accent-text)}
      .s-chk div{margin:3px 0}.s-sig{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;margin-top:28px}
      .s-sig div{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:4px;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-mid)}.s-sig b{display:block;color:var(--surface-dark)}
      </style><div class="s">`
      + `<div class="s-hd"><div class="s-brand"><b>PETRAS GROUP</b><span>INTERNATIONAL ROAD TRANSPORT SERVICES</span><span>Αποθήκη Βέροιας</span></div>`
      + `<div class="s-meta"><b>ΦΥΛΛΟ ΟΔΗΓΟΥ · ΕΘΝΙΚΟ</b><span>${_esc([m.week, m.cycleNo ? 'Κύκλος ' + m.cycleNo : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</span><span>Έκδοση ${_esc(m.issued || '—')}</span></div></div>`
      + `<div class="s-band">${band.map(([k, v]) => `<div><span>${k}</span>${_esc(_dash(v))}</div>`).join('')}</div>`
      + body
      + `<div class="s-chk"><b>ΠΡΙΝ ΤΗΝ ΑΝΑΧΩΡΗΣΗ</b><div>☐ Θερμογράφος σε λειτουργία</div><div>☐ Ρυμούλκα καθαρή / προψυγμένη</div>`
      + `<div>☐ Παλέτες μετρημένες (${_pal(chk.pallets)})</div><div>☐ CMR υπογεγραμμένα</div></div>`
      + `<div class="s-sig"><div><b>PETRAS GROUP</b>ΚΙΝΗΣΗ · ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΗ ΦΥΛΛΟΥ<br>Υπογραφή & ημερομηνία</div>`
      + `<div><b>${_esc(h.partner || h.driver || '—')}</b>ΟΔΗΓΟΣ · ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗ<br>Υπογραφή & ημερομηνία</div></div></div>`;
  }

  // ── the browser side ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let _last = null;   // the last sheet built: whatsapp() answers from it, never from a second read
  function _tokens() {
    try {
      const cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
      return TOKENS.map((t) => { const v = cs.getPropertyValue(t).trim(); return v ? `${t}:${v};` : ''; }).join('');
    } catch (e) { _log(e, 'WN5Sheet tokens'); return ''; }
  }
  function _issued() {
    // the moment of printing: the sheet's own stamp, never part of a /plan body
    const d = new Date();
    const day = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    let who = '';
    try { const u = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tms_user') || '{}'); who = String(u.name || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map((w) => w.charAt(0) + '.').join(''); } catch (_) { who = ''; }
    return `${_dlab(day)}/${d.getFullYear()} ${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}${who ? ' · ' + who : ''}`;
  }
  async function _ctx(rtId) {
    const ids = await PlanIds.load();
    if (!ids.ok) {
      if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Οι κατάλογοι δεν είναι διαθέσιμοι ακόμη — το φύλλο θέλει διευθύνσεις και τηλέφωνα', 'danger');
      return null;
    }
    let hubId = null;
    try { hubId = PlanIds.id('location', F.VEROIA_LOC); }
    catch (e) {
      // without the hub's number the sheet would print Veroia under its catalogue name (Δ10): it does not print
      if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Η Βέροια λείπει από τους καταλόγους — το φύλλο δεν τυπώθηκε', 'danger');
      _log(e, 'WN5Sheet hub');
      return null;
    }
    let board = null;
    try { board = await WN5.findAfterReuse((b) => b); } catch (e) { _log(e, 'WN5Sheet board'); }
    const cycle = board && (board.cycles || []).find((c) => c.rt_id === rtId);
    if (!cycle) { if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Ο κύκλος δεν βρέθηκε στην εβδομάδα που φαίνεται — ανανέωσε', 'warn'); return null; }
    const byId = {};
    for (const s of cycle.stops || []) { const p = PlanIds.place(s.location_id); if (p) byId[s.location_id] = p; }
    const nums = WN5L.cycleNumbers(board.cycles || []);
    const cn = nums && typeof nums.get === 'function' ? nums.get(rtId) : null;
    const wk = TmsWeek.numOf(new Date(board.week + 'T12:00:00'));
    return { cycle, places: { byId, hubId }, meta: { week: wk ? 'W' + wk : '', cycleNo: cn ? `${cn.n}/${cn.m}` : '', issued: _issued() } };
  }
  async function _copy(txt) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);
      if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Αντιγράφηκε το μήνυμα WhatsApp', 'success');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      window.prompt('Μήνυμα WhatsApp (Ctrl+C):', txt);   // a refused clipboard is never a silent nothing (copyPlates rule)
      return false;
    }
  }
  async function print(rtId, part) {
    const p = part === 'KATHODOS' || part === 'ANODOS' ? part : 'ALL';
    const ctx = await _ctx(rtId);
    if (!ctx) return false;
    const ls = lines(ctx.cycle, ctx.places, p);
    _last = { rtId, part: p, lines: ls, meta: ctx.meta };
    if (typeof _printWeekShell === 'function') _printWeekShell(`Φύλλο οδηγού · ${ctx.cycle.code || 'RT-' + rtId}`, html(ls, ctx.meta, _tokens()));
    await _copy(text(ls, ctx.meta));
    return true;
  }
  function whatsapp(rtId, part) {
    const p = part === 'KATHODOS' || part === 'ANODOS' ? part : 'ALL';
    if (!_last || _last.rtId !== rtId || _last.part !== p) return '';
    return text(_last.lines, _last.meta);
  }

  window.WN5Sheet = Object.freeze({ print, whatsapp, lines, text, html });
})();
```

```js
  ok(scn, '✈ labels = Figma 2011:8858, in order', JSON.stringify(labels) === JSON.stringify(['Άνοιγμα παραγγελιών', 'Ανάθεση / αλλαγή φορτηγού ή συνεργάτη',
    'Νέα παραγγελία σε αυτό το σκέλος › Κάθοδος · Άνοδος', 'Φόρτωση με τοπικό', 'Σπάσιμο παραγγελιών', 'Εκτύπωση / WhatsApp › Κάθοδος · Άνοδος · Όλο το δρομολόγιο',
    'Αντιγραφή πινακίδων', 'Καθαρισμός ανάθεσης']), labels);
  await page.click('#content .wn5-row[data-rt="101"] .wi4-plane').catch(() => {});
  const nOrders = await page.$eval('#wn5-menu [data-item="orders"] .wn5-m-n', (e) => e.textContent).catch(() => null);
  ok(scn, '«Άνοιγμα παραγγελιών» carries the number of the cycle\'s orders', nOrders !== null && /^\d+$/.test(nOrders), nOrders);
  await page.click('#wn5-menu [data-item="sheet"]').catch(() => {});
  const item = await page.$eval('#wn5-menu [data-sub="sheet"]', (e) => !e.hidden && !!e.querySelector('[data-item="sheet-k"]')).catch(() => false);
  ok(scn, '✈ «Εκτύπωση / WhatsApp ›» opens its submenu with «Κάθοδος»', item === true);
  const [pop] = await Promise.all([
    page.waitForEvent('popup', { timeout: 8000 }).catch(() => null),
    item ? page.click('#wn5-menu [data-item="sheet-k"]') : page.evaluate(() => WN5Sheet.print(101, 'KATHODOS')),
  ]);

  if (pop) {

    ok(scn, 'the A4 holds the KATHODOS stops only', a4.sides.length === 3 && a4.sides.every((s) => s === 'KATHODOS'), a4.sides);
    ok(scn, 'Veroia only as «Αποθήκη Βέροιας», no price', a4.body.includes('Αποθήκη Βέροιας') && !a4.body.includes('ΒΕΡΟΙΑ TEST') && !/€/.test(a4.body));
```

**Gate: 072b live.** Ο κώδικας και τα tests γράφονται και τρέχουν σε stub· το merge περιμένει τη 072b ζωντανή (SQL + Worker) και τον έλεγχο των κλειδιών `segments[]` πάνω στο ζωντανό `plan_board`.

**Τι κάνει αυτός ο Task:** κύκλος με αλλαγή οχήματος στο board (Figma H1 `2120:7738`, H3 `2123:7735` + Ε5 `2140:7810`): ένα **πλακίδιο ανά τμήμα** στη στήλη ΑΝΑΘΕΣΗ (266px), δίπλα-δίπλα, χωρίς «/»· ΑΡΧΙΚΟ με ίσια γραμμή 3px 2px έξω από το κουτί, τα επόμενα με **πλάγια αριστερή πλευρά 16°** στο χρώμα τους (ΕΝΔΙΑΜΕΣΟ amber, ΤΕΛΙΚΟ μπλε), κενό 4px, σκούρο κείμενο ετικέτας (Ε-14)· `⇄` στη θέση του `→` του σκέλους όπου γίνεται η αλλαγή· σειρά `↳ ⇄ <σημείο> · <ώρα> · <λόγος>`· γραμμή 24×2 κάτω από κάθε στάση στο χρώμα του τμήματός της **μόνο** από τα `segments[].stop_ids` (H-9). Κύκλος ενός τμήματος = ακριβώς όπως σήμερα (R-59). Ο χάρτης λόγων `WN5Lab.REASON` (H-19) με drift test προς το CHECK `seg_reason_list`.

**Αποφάσεις του Task:**
- Πλακίδια μόνο όταν `Row.segSource === 'segments'` **και** υπάρχουν ≥ 2 τμήματα. Ένα τμήμα (με ή χωρίς κλειδί `segments`) = το κουτί του T5 χωρίς αλλαγή.
- Στο πλακίδιο: ετικέτα + πινακίδα, από κάτω ο οδηγός· συνεργάτης: όνομα + κόμιστρο (Ε-13: μένει, απόφαση 41) ή «κόμιστρο λείπει». Καμία ώρα, καμία ρυμούλκα, κανένα «κύκλος n/m» (H1).
- Το ΑΡΧΙΚΟ είναι πάντα το πρώτο πλακίδιο: η ίσια γραμμή του ζει στο δοχείο (`.wn5-tiles::before`), γιατί η πλάγια κοπή (`clip-path`) του ίδιου του πλακιδίου θα έκοβε ό,τι βγαίνει έξω του.
- Λόγος που δεν είναι στον χάρτη → «άλλος λόγος · <code>» + ένα `logError` (αρχή 1), ποτέ σιωπηλό κενό.
- Χρώματα: `--wn5-seg-initial: #64748b`, `--wn5-seg-intermediate: #d97706` (τα εγκεκριμένα hex της γραμμής, `2140:7735`), `--wn5-seg-final: var(--accent)`· κείμενο ετικέτας `var(--text-mid)` (#475569), `var(--warn)` (#92400E), `var(--accent-text)` (#0369A1) — κάθε τιμή που υπάρχει ήδη ως token είναι `var()` (μία τιμή, μία πηγή).

```js
// WCAG 2.x relative luminance / contrast of two hex colours (no dependency).
function wcag(a, b) {
  const lum = (h) => { const c = [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255).map((v) => (v <= 0.03928 ? v / 12.92 : ((v + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)); return 0.2126 * c[0] + 0.7152 * c[1] + 0.0722 * c[2]; };
  const [x, y] = [lum(a), lum(b)].sort((p, q) => q - p);
  return (x + 0.05) / (y + 0.05);
}
// A token's value as style.css defines it first, following var(--x) to the end.
function token(css, name, depth = 0) {
  // a definition (name: #hex | var(--x);), never a mention in a comment
  const m = new RegExp(name + '\\s*:\\s*(#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}|var\\(--[\\w-]+\\))\\s*;').exec(css);
  if (!m || depth > 8) return null;
  const v = m[1].trim();
  const r = /^var\((--[\w-]+)\)$/.exec(v);
  return r ? token(css, r[1], depth + 1) : v.toLowerCase();
}
test('F4α-T24: label text on the own (#EEF2F6) and partner (#DDEFE3) tiles ≥ 4.5:1 for the three segment inks', () => {
  const css = require('fs').readFileSync(require('path').join(__dirname, '..', 'assets', 'style.css'), 'utf8');
  for (const ink of ['--wn5-seg-initial-ink', '--wn5-seg-intermediate-ink', '--wn5-seg-final-ink']) {
    const v = token(css, ink);
    assert.ok(/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/.test(v || ''), `${ink} = ${v}`);
    for (const bg of ['--wi4-own', '--wi4-partner']) {
      const r = wcag(v, token(css, bg));
      assert.ok(r >= 4.5, `${ink} on ${bg}: ${r.toFixed(2)}:1`);
    }
  }
});
```

```js
const WN5L_T24 = require(require('path').join(__dirname, '..', 'core', 'wn5-logic.js'));
function segCycle() {
  const st = (stop_id, seq, side, from, to) => ({ stop_id, seq, side, location_id: stop_id, location: 'LOC ' + stop_id, planned_from: from, planned_to: to,
    stop_day: from.slice(0, 10), executed: false, has_vehicle: true, has_late: false, dim: false, side_dim: false, cycle_dim: false, local_loading: null, legs: [] });
  return { rt_id: 7, code: 'RT-T7', trip_type: 'OWNED', truck_id: 1, truck: 'TST-1', trailer_id: null, trailer: null, driver_id: 1, driver: 'Driver Test 01',
    partner_id: null, partner: null, partner_rate: null, start_at: '2026-10-12T06:00:00+03:00', end_at: '2026-10-15T22:00:00+03:00',
    date_start: '2026-10-12', date_end: '2026-10-15', ended: false,
    stops: [st(1, 1, 'KATHODOS', '2026-10-12T06:00:00+03:00', '2026-10-12T08:00:00+03:00'),
            st(2, 2, 'KATHODOS', '2026-10-13T18:00:00+03:00', '2026-10-13T20:00:00+03:00'),
            st(3, 3, 'ANODOS', '2026-10-15T10:00:00+03:00', '2026-10-15T12:00:00+03:00')],
    segments: [
      { segment_id: 70, label: 'initial', from_at: '2026-10-12T06:00:00+03:00', to_at: '2026-10-13T14:30:00+03:00', trip_type: 'OWNED', truck_id: 1, truck: 'TST-1', trailer_id: null, trailer: null,
        driver_id: 1, driver: 'Driver Test 01', partner_id: null, partner: null, partner_rate: null, place_note: null, reason: null, reason_note: null, has_vehicle: true, stop_ids: [1] },
      // stop 3 lies inside this segment's TIME window but in no stop_ids: it must get no segment
      { segment_id: 71, label: 'final', from_at: '2026-10-13T14:30:00+03:00', to_at: '2026-10-15T22:00:00+03:00', trip_type: 'OWNED', truck_id: 2, truck: 'TST-2', trailer_id: null, trailer: null,
        driver_id: 2, driver: 'Driver Test 02', partner_id: null, partner: null, partner_rate: null, place_note: 'Λαμία', reason: 'vehicle_breakdown', reason_note: null, has_vehicle: true, stop_ids: [2] }] };
}
test('F4α-T24: a stop is coloured only from segments[].stop_ids (a stop in no stop_ids gets no segment)', () => {
  const m = WN5L_T24.stopSegments(segCycle());
  assert.deepStrictEqual(m.get(1), { segmentId: 70, label: 'initial' });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(m.get(2), { segmentId: 71, label: 'final' });
  assert.strictEqual(m.get(3), undefined);
  const one = segCycle(); one.segments = [Object.assign({}, one.segments[0], { label: null, stop_ids: [1, 2, 3] })];
  assert.strictEqual(WN5L_T24.stopSegments(one).size, 0, 'one segment = exactly today: no label (R-59)');
});
test('F4α-T24: the handover sits between the last stop of the segment before and the first stop after', () => {
  assert.deepStrictEqual(WN5L_T24.handoversOf(segCycle()), [{ at: '2026-10-13T14:30:00+03:00', place_note: 'Λαμία', reason: 'vehicle_breakdown', segmentId: 71, label: 'final', beforeStopId: 1, afterStopId: 2 }]);
  const no = segCycle(); delete no.segments;
  assert.deepStrictEqual(WN5L_T24.handoversOf(no), []);
});
test('F4α-T24: the board model carries segLabel per point and the handovers per row', () => {
  const mdl = WN5L_T24.model({ week: '2026-10-10', cycles: [segCycle()], waiting: [], hub: [], notices: [] }, { today: '2026-10-13' });
  const row = mdl.days.flatMap((d) => d.rows).find((r) => r.rtId === 7);
  const pts = [row.kath, row.anod].filter(Boolean).flatMap((s) => s.from.concat(s.to));
  const lab = Object.fromEntries(pts.map((p) => [p.stopId, p.segLabel]));
  assert.deepStrictEqual([lab[1], lab[2], lab[3]], ['initial', 'final', null]);
  assert.strictEqual(row.handovers.length, 1);
  assert.strictEqual(row.tiles.length, 2);
});
```
